इति धिष्ण्यान् //
2.3.7.m:
"Homage today be to the dread seers, / whose eye and heat of asceticism are lofty and terrible!

O Bṛhaspati, great, radiant, homage! / Homage to Viśvakarman; may he protect us!"

2.3.7.s: svasti vayaṃ tvayā vasema deva soma sūrya gāyatryā tvā śam̐sīmahi \\ ity ādityam /
2.3.7.d: स्वस्ति वयं त्वया वसेम देव सोम सूर्य गायत्र्या त्वा शम्̐सीमहि \\ इत्य् आदित्यम् /
2.3.7.m: With "May we dwell in well-being with you, O divine Soma; O Sūrya, with the gāyatrī may we praise you," [he looks at] the sun.

2.3.7.s:
upa mā dyāvāpṛthivī hvayetām \ upāstāvāḥ kalásāḥ somadhānāḥ /
upa mā hotrā upahave hvayantām \ upahūtā gāva upahūto 'haṃ gavām //
iti prāṅmukhāḥ kalaśān /
2.3.7.d:
उप मा द्यावापृथिवी ह्वयेताम् \ उपास्तावाः कल्áसाः सोमधानाः /
उप मा होत्रा उपहवे ह्वयन्ताम् \ उपहूता गाव उपहूतो ऽहं गवाम् //
इति प्राङ्मुखाः कलशान् /
2.3.7.m:
"May Heaven and Earth invite me! / May the laud-chanting cups holding soma invite me!

May the hotrās invite me at the invitation! / Invited are the cows; invited am I of the cows!"

Facing east, [they address] the jars [with this formula].

2.3.7.s: sadaḥ prasṛpyopaviśanti / dakṣiṇataḥpurastād dhotrīyasya yajamāna upaviśaty uttarāv adhvaryū /
2.3.7.d: सदः प्रसृप्योपविशन्ति / दक्षिणतःपुरस्ताद् धोत्रीयस्य यजमान उपविशत्य् उत्तराव् अध्वर्यू /
2.3.7.m: Having crept into the sadas, they sit down. To the south and east of the hotṛ's post the sacrificer sits down, and the two adhvaryu priests to the north.

2.3.7.s: pratiprasthātā pātryām upastīrya savanīyān udvāsayati pūrvārdhe dhānā dakṣiṇārdhe saktūn karambhāya dadhnā prayutān sarpiṣā vā paścārdhe saktūn parivāpāya madhye puroḍāśam̐ visrāvyāmikṣām uttarārdhe /
2.3.7.d: प्रतिप्रस्थाता पात्र्याम् उपस्तीर्य सवनीयान् उद्वासयति पूर्वार्धे धाना दक्षिणार्धे सक्तून् करम्भाय दध्ना प्रयुतान् सर्पिषा वा पश्चार्धे सक्तून् परिवापाय मध्ये पुरोडाशम्̐ विस्राव्यामिक्षाम् उत्तरार्धे /
2.3.7.m: The pratiprasthātṛ, having spread an underlayer [of clarified butter] in the dish, takes off the press-day oblations: parched grains in the eastern half; barley meal mixed with curd or melted butter for groats in the southern half; barley meal for puffed grains in the western half; the sacrificial cake in the middle; having drained [the whey], the clotted curd in the northern half.

2.3.7.s: alaṃkṛtya juhūpabhṛtor avadāya prātaḥ prātaḥsāvasyendrāya puroḍāśānām anubrūhi \\ ity anuvācayaty āśrāvya prātaḥ prātaḥsāvasyendrāya puroḍāśān preṣya \\ iti pracarati /
2.3.7.d: अलंकृत्य जुहूपभृतोर् अवदाय प्रातः प्रातःसावस्येन्द्राय पुरोडाशानाम् अनुब्रूहि \\ इत्य् अनुवाचयत्य् आश्राव्य प्रातः प्रातःसावस्येन्द्राय पुरोडाशान् प्रेष्य \\ इति प्रचरति /
2.3.7.m: Having garnished them and cut portions into the juhū and upabhṛt spoons, he causes [the hotṛ] to recite the invitatory verse: "For Indra of the morning pressing, recite for the sacrificial cakes [and other oblations]." Having made the call, he proceeds [with the offering]: "For Indra of the morning pressing, summon [the hotṛ to recite the offering verse] for the sacrificial cakes."

2.3.7.s: aupabhṛtaṃ juhvām ānīya \\ agnaye puroḍāśānām anubrūhi \\ agnaye puroḍāśān prasthitān preṣya \\ iti pracarati /
2.3.7.d: औपभृतं जुह्वाम् आनीय \\ अग्नये पुरोडाशानाम् अनुब्रूहि \\ अग्नये पुरोडाशान् प्रस्थितान् प्रेष्य \\ इति प्रचरति /
2.3.7.m: Having poured the portion from the upabhṛt into the juhū, he proceeds [with the offering]: "For Agni recite for the sacrificial cakes; for Agni summon [the hotṛ to recite the offering verse] for the sacrificial cakes that have been brought forward."
[The procedure is] established up to the disposal of the potsherds, except for the invitation to the iḍā.

2.3.7.s: srucau camasm̐ vāyavyam̐ vādāya vācam̐ yachaty ā yaja \\ iti vacanāt /
2.3.7.d: स्रुचौ चमस्म्̐ वायव्यम्̐ वादाय वाचम्̐ यछत्य् आ यज \\ इति वचनात् /
2.3.7.m: Taking the two offering ladles, a cup, or a vāyavya beaker, he restrains speech until the utterance "Recite the offering verse."

2.3.7.s: āgnīdhre sphyasaṃmārgapāṇir āgnīdhraḥ paścād āsandīm ārabhyordhvas tiṣṭhann astu śrauṣat \\ iti pratyāśrāvayati /
2.3.7.d: आग्नीध्रे स्फ्यसंमार्गपाणिर् आग्नीध्रः पश्चाद् आसन्दीम् आरभ्योर्ध्वस् तिष्ठन्न् अस्तु श्रौषत् \\ इति प्रत्याश्रावयति /
2.3.7.m: In the āgnīdhra shed, holding the wooden sword and sweeping-brush in hand, taking hold of the chair from behind and standing upright, the āgnīdhra priest responds to the call with: "Let it be heard!"

2.3.7.s: pratyāśrute dakṣiṇaṃ paridhisaṃdhiṃ pratyavasthāya juhoty adhvaryur uttaraṃ pratiprasthātā madhye 'gner ājyāhutīḥ puroḍāśāhutīḥ paśvāhutīś cābhitaḥ somāhutīḥ /
2.3.7.d: प्रत्याश्रुते दक्षिणं परिधिसंधिं प्रत्यवस्थाय जुहोत्य् अध्वर्युर् उत्तरं प्रतिप्रस्थाता मध्ये ऽग्नेर् आज्याहुतीः पुरोडाशाहुतीः पश्वाहुतीश् चाभितः सोमाहुतीः /
2.3.7.m: When the call has been responded to, stepping down opposite the southern junction of the enclosing sticks, the adhvaryu offers, and the pratiprasthātṛ opposite the northern [junction]: clarified-butter offerings in the middle of the fire, sacrificial-cake offerings and animal offerings on either side, soma offerings [all around].

2.3.8.s: dvidevatyaiḥ pracarataḥ /
2.3.8.d: द्विदेवत्यैः प्रचरतः /
2.3.8.m: The two proceed with the cups for two deities.

2.3.8.s: pratiprasthātādityapātreṇa pratinigrāhyān grāham asannāñ juhoti //
2.3.8.d: प्रतिप्रस्थातादित्यपात्रेण प्रतिनिग्राह्यान् ग्राहम् असन्नाञ् जुहोति //
2.3.8.m: With the āditya cup, taking the pratinigrāhya cups, the pratiprasthātṛ offers those that are not set down.

2.3.8.s: upayāmagṛhīto 'si \ vāyava indravāyubhyāṃ tvā \\ iti gṛhṇāti /
2.3.8.d: उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \ वायव इन्द्रवायुभ्यां त्वा \\ इति गृह्णाति /
2.3.8.m: He draws [the soma] with: "You are taken with a support; for Vāyu, for Indra and Vāyu, [I take] you."

2.3.8.s:
mukhyam ādāyādhvaryuḥ pariplavayā droṇakalaśāt
adhvaryo 'yam̐ yajño 'stu devās\ oṣadhībhyaḥ paśubhyo me dhanāya /
viśvasmai bhūtāya dhruvo 'stu devāḥ \ sa pinvasva ghṛtavad devayajyāyai svāhā //
iti somam āghāram āghārayati //
2.3.8.d:
मुख्यम् आदायाध्वर्युः परिप्लवया द्रोणकलशात्
अध्वर्यो ऽयम्̐ यज्ञो ऽस्तु देवास्\ ओषधीभ्यः पशुभ्यो मे धनाय /
विश्वस्मै भूताय ध्रुवो ऽस्तु देवाः \ स पिन्वस्व घृतवद् देवयज्यायै स्वाहा //
इति सोमम् आघारम् आघारयति //
2.3.8.m:
Having taken the principal [vessel], the adhvaryu, with the pariplavā ladle from the droṇakalaśa trough,

"O adhvaryu, may this sacrifice be, O gods, / for herbs, for cattle, for my wealth!

For every living being may it be firm, O gods! / Swell, full of clarified butter, for worship of the gods, svāhā!"

— with this he pours a continuous stream of soma.

2.3.8.s: vāyava indravāyubhyām anubrūhi \\ ity anuvācayatyāśrāvya vāyava indravāyubhyāṃ preṣya \\ iti pracarati /
2.3.8.d: वायव इन्द्रवायुभ्याम् अनुब्रूहि \\ इत्य् अनुवाचयत्याश्राव्य वायव इन्द्रवायुभ्यां प्रेष्य \\ इति प्रचरति /
2.3.8.m: He causes [the hotṛ] to recite the invitatory verse, saying: 'Recite for Vāyu and Indra-Vāyu.' Having called for [the āgnīdhra's] response, he proceeds [to offer], saying: 'Prompt [the hotṛ to recite the offering verse] for Vāyu and Indra-Vāyu.'

2.3.8.s: vaṣaṭkṛte juhutaḥ /
2.3.8.d: वषट्कृते जुहुतः /

2.3.8.s: punarvaṣaṭkṛte hutvā vyavanayataḥ /
2.3.8.d: पुनर्वषट्कृते हुत्वा व्यवनयतः /
2.3.8.m: When the second vaṣaṭ-call is uttered, having offered, they pour out [residues] into each other's cups.

2.3.8.s: pratiprasthātādhvaryupātre sarvam ānayati /
2.3.8.d: प्रतिप्रस्थाताध्वर्युपात्रे सर्वम् आनयति /
2.3.8.m: The pratiprasthātṛ pours everything into the adhvaryu's vessel.

2.3.8.s: tasyāgram adhvaryuḥ pratiprasthāne 'vanīya tvaramāṇo bhakṣam̐ harati //
2.3.8.d: तस्याग्रम् अध्वर्युः प्रतिप्रस्थाने ऽवनीय त्वरमाणो भक्षम्̐ हरति //
2.3.8.m: The adhvaryu, having poured off the first portion of it into the pratiprasthātṛ's [vessel], brings the portion for consumption in haste.

2.3.8.s: ayam̐ vasuḥ purovasur iti hotre prayachati //
2.3.8.d: अयम्̐ वसुः पुरोवसुर् इति होत्रे प्रयछति //
2.3.8.m: He hands [it] over to the hotṛ with: 'This is the good, possessing foremost wealth.'

2.3.8.s: upayāmagṛhīto 'si \ devebhyas tvā \\ iti pratiprasthātādityapātreṇādityasthālyām̐ saṃpātam avanayati //
2.3.8.d: उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \ देवेभ्यस् त्वा \\ इति प्रतिप्रस्थातादित्यपात्रेणादित्यस्थाल्याम्̐ संपातम् अवनयति //
2.3.8.m: With: 'You are taken with a base; for the gods, you,' the pratiprasthātṛ pours the remnant into the āditya pot by means of the āditya cup.

2.3.8.s: upayāmagṛhīto 'si \ mitrāvaruṇābhyāṃ tvā \\ iti gṛhṇāti /
2.3.8.d: उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \ मित्रावरुणाभ्यां त्वा \\ इति गृह्णाति /
2.3.8.m: He draws [the cup] with: 'You are taken with a base; for Mitra and Varuṇa, you.'

2.3.8.s: mukhyam ādāyādhvaryur yathādevatam anuvācayati /
2.3.8.d: मुख्यम् आदायाध्वर्युर् यथादेवतम् अनुवाचयति /
2.3.8.m: Taking the primary [vessel], the adhvaryu causes [the hotṛ] to recite the invitatory verse according to the deity.

2.3.8.s: siddham ā pradānāt //
2.3.8.d: सिद्धम् आ प्रदानात् //

2.3.8.s: ayam̐ vasur vidadvasur iti hotre prayachati //
2.3.8.d: अयम्̐ वसुर् विदद्वसुर् इति होत्रे प्रयछति //
2.3.8.m: He hands [it] over to the hotṛ with: 'This is the good, obtaining wealth.'

2.3.8.s: upayāmagṛhīto 'si \ viśvadevebhyas tvā \\ iti pratiprasthātādityapātreṇādityasthālyām̐ saṃpātam avanayati //
2.3.8.d: उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \ विश्वदेवेभ्यस् त्वा \\ इति प्रतिप्रस्थातादित्यपात्रेणादित्यस्थाल्याम्̐ संपातम् अवनयति //
2.3.8.m: With: 'You are taken with a base; for the Viśvedevas, you,' the pratiprasthātṛ pours the remnant into the āditya pot by means of the āditya cup.

2.3.8.s: upayāmagṛhīto 'si \\ aśvibhyāṃ tvā \\ iti gṛhṇāti /
2.3.8.d: उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \\ अश्विभ्यां त्वा \\ इति गृह्णाति /
2.3.8.m: He draws [the cup] with: 'You are taken with a base; for the Aśvins, you.'

2.3.8.s: mukhyam ādāyādhvaryur yathādevatam anuvācayati /
2.3.8.d: मुख्यम् आदायाध्वर्युर् यथादेवतम् अनुवाचयति /
2.3.8.m: Taking the primary [vessel], the adhvaryu causes [the hotṛ] to recite the invitatory verse according to the deity.

2.3.8.s: siddham ā pradānāt //
2.3.8.d: सिद्धम् आ प्रदानात् //

2.3.8.s: ayam̐ vasuḥ sam̐yadvasur iti hotre prayachati //
2.3.8.d: अयम्̐ वसुः सम्̐यद्वसुर् इति होत्रे प्रयछति //
2.3.8.m: He hands [it] over to the hotṛ with: 'This is the good, holding wealth together.'

2.3.8.s: upayāmagṛhīto 'si \ viśvebhyas tvā devebhyas \\ iti pratiprasthātādityapātreṇādityasthālyām̐ saṃpātam avanayati //
2.3.8.d: उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \ विश्वेभ्यस् त्वा देवेभ्यस् \\ इति प्रतिप्रस्थातादित्यपात्रेणादित्यस्थाल्याम्̐ संपातम् अवनयति //
2.3.8.m: With: 'You are taken with a base; for all the gods, you,' the pratiprasthātṛ pours the remnant into the āditya pot by means of the āditya cup.

2.3.8.s: diteḥ putrāṇām ity ādityasthālīm abhipūrayati pariplavayā droṇakalaśāt //
2.3.8.d: दितेः पुत्राणाम् इत्य् आदित्यस्थालीम् अभिपूरयति परिप्लवया द्रोणकलशात् //
2.3.8.m: With: '[Sons] of Diti...', he fills the āditya pot from the droṇakalaśa by means of the dipping ladle.

2.3.8.s: upayāmagṛhīto 'si \ viṣṇos tvorukrame gṛhṇāmi \\ ity ādityasthālīm abhimṛśati //
2.3.8.d: उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \ विष्णोस् त्वोरुक्रमे गृह्णामि \\ इत्य् आदित्यस्थालीम् अभिमृशति //
2.3.8.m: With: 'You are taken with a base; I grasp you in the wide stride of Viṣṇu,' he touches the āditya pot.

2.3.8.s: viṣṇa urukramaiṣa te somas \\ iti pratiprasthātādityapātreṇādityasthālīm apidadhāty apidadhāti /
2.3.8.d: विष्ण उरुक्रमैष ते सोमस् \\ इति प्रतिप्रस्थातादित्यपात्रेणादित्यस्थालीम् अपिदधात्य् अपिदधाति /
2.3.8.m: With: 'O wide-striding Viṣṇu, this is your Soma,' the pratiprasthātṛ covers, covers the āditya pot with the āditya cup.

2.4.1.s: pūtabhṛto 'nte madhyataḥkāricamasān upasādayati hotur brahmaṇa udgātur yajamānasya /
2.4.1.d: पूतभृतो ऽन्ते मध्यतःकारिचमसान् उपसादयति होतुर् ब्रह्मण उद्गातुर् यजमानस्य /
2.4.1.m: At the rim of the pūtabhṛt [vat], he places the cups of the principal officiants: of the hotṛ, the brahman, the udgātṛ, and the sacrificer.

2.4.1.s: hotṛkacamasām̐ś cānyānṛte 'chāvākacamasād unnayati //
2.4.1.d: होतृकचमसाम्̐श् चान्यानृते ऽछावाकचमसाद् उन्नयति //
2.4.1.m: And he draws [Soma into] the cups of the subordinate hotṛ priests, except the cup of the acchāvāka.

2.4.1.s: unnīyamānebhyo 'nubrūhi \\ ity anuvācayati /
2.4.1.d: उन्नीयमानेभ्यो ऽनुब्रूहि \\ इत्य् अनुवाचयति /
2.4.1.m: He causes [the hotṛ] to recite the invitatory verse, saying: 'Recite for [the cups] being drawn.'

2.4.1.s: ubhayataḥśukrān unnetonnayati /
2.4.1.d: उभयतःशुक्रान् उन्नेतोन्नयति /
2.4.1.m: The unnetṛ draws [the cups], having śukra [drawn] on both sides.

2.4.1.s: droṇakalaśād upastīrya pūtabhṛta upabilān kṛtvā droṇakalaśād abhipūrayati //
2.4.1.d: द्रोणकलशाद् उपस्तीर्य पूतभृत उपबिलान् कृत्वा द्रोणकलशाद् अभिपूरयति //
2.4.1.m: Having made an underlayer from the droṇakalaśa, and having filled up to the brim from the pūtabhṛt, he tops [them] off from the droṇakalaśa.

2.4.1.s: tutho 'si janadhāyās \\ devās tvā śukrapāḥ praṇayantu \\ iti śukram ādatte // tutho 'si janadhāyās \\ devās tvā manthipāḥ praṇayantu \\ iti manthinaṃ pratiprasthātā //
2.4.1.d: तुथो ऽसि जनधायास् \\ देवास् त्वा शुक्रपाः प्रणयन्तु \\ इति शुक्रम् आदत्ते // तुथो ऽसि जनधायास् \\ देवास् त्वा मन्थिपाः प्रणयन्तु \\ इति मन्थिनं प्रतिप्रस्थाता //
2.4.1.m: With: 'You are Tutha, the supporter of people; may the gods who drink śukra lead you forward,' [the adhvaryu] takes the śukra [cup]; with: 'You are Tutha, the supporter of people; may the gods who drink manthin lead you forward,' the pratiprasthātṛ takes the manthin [cup].

2.4.1.s: apanuttau śaṇḍāmarkau \\ iti pām̐sūn apadhvam̐sayataḥ /
2.4.1.d: अपनुत्तौ शण्डामर्कौ \\ इति पाम्̐सून् अपध्वम्̐सयतः /
2.4.1.m: With: 'Śaṇḍa and Marka are expelled,' the two brush away the dust.

2.4.1.s: adhastād yūpaśakalāv upayachete /
2.4.1.d: अधस्ताद् यूपशकलाव् उपयछेते /
2.4.1.m: Underneath, they hold two chips of the sacrificial post.

2.4.1.s: prokṣitedhmaśakalābhyām achinnasya te deva soma \\ ity apidhattaḥ /
2.4.1.d: प्रोक्षितेध्मशकलाभ्याम् अछिन्नस्य ते देव सोम \\ इत्य् अपिधत्तः /
2.4.1.m: With two sprinkled chips of firewood, they cover [the cups] with: 'Of you unbroken, O divine Soma...'

2.4.1.s: ādānābhyām upaniṣkrāmataḥ //
2.4.1.d: आदानाभ्याम् उपनिष्क्रामतः //
2.4.1.m: They step out together holding [the cups].

2.4.1.s: āyuḥ saṃdhattam \\ prāṇam̐ saṃdhattam \\ cakṣuḥ saṃdhattam \\ śrotram̐ saṃdhattam \\ manaḥ saṃdhattam \\ vācam̐ saṃdhattam iti paścād uttaravedera vayamya grahāv aratnī saṃdhattaḥ //
2.4.1.d: आयुः संधत्तम् \\ प्राणम्̐ संधत्तम् \\ चक्षुः संधत्तम् \\ श्रोत्रम्̐ संधत्तम् \\ मनः संधत्तम् \\ वाचम्̐ संधत्तम् इति पश्चाद् उत्तरवेदेर वयम्य ग्रहाव् अरत्नी संधत्तः //
2.4.1.m: With: 'Unite life; unite breath; unite sight; unite hearing; unite mind; unite speech,' having held down [the cups] to the west of the high altar, they join their elbows.

2.4.1.s: anādhṛṣṭāsi \\ ity aṅguṣṭhābhyām uttaravedim ākrāmata upari likhantāv uttaravediṃ parikrāmataḥ /
2.4.1.d: अनाधृष्टासि \\ इत्य् अङ्गुष्ठाभ्याम् उत्तरवेदिम् आक्रामत उपरि लिखन्ताव् उत्तरवेदिं परिक्रामतः /
2.4.1.m: With: 'You are unassailable,' they step onto the high altar with their thumbs, and scratch above as they step around the high altar.

2.4.1.s: śukram̐ yajamāno 'nvārabhate //
2.4.1.d: शुक्रम्̐ यजमानो ऽन्वारभते //
2.4.1.m: The sacrificer takes hold of the śukra [cup] from behind.

2.4.1.s: suvīrāḥ prajās \\ iti dakṣiṇenādhvaryuḥ [ gachati ] // suprajāḥ prajās \\ ity uttareṇa pratiprasthātā //
2.4.1.d: सुवीराः प्रजास् \\ इति दक्षिणेनाध्वर्युः [ गछति ] // सुप्रजाः प्रजास् \\ इत्य् उत्तरेण प्रतिप्रस्थाता //
2.4.1.m: With: '[May] progeny [be] rich in heroes,' the adhvaryu [walks] along the south; with: '[May] progeny [be] well-off,' the pratiprasthātṛ [walks] along the north.

2.4.1.s: indreṇa manyunā \\ iti yajamāno japati /
2.4.1.d: इन्द्रेण मन्युना \\ इति यजमानो जपति /
2.4.1.m: The sacrificer mutters: 'With Indra's wrath...'

2.4.1.s: purastāt pratyañcāv avatiṣṭhete //
2.4.1.d: पुरस्तात् प्रत्यञ्चाव् अवतिष्ठेते //
2.4.1.m: The two stand in front, facing west.

2.4.1.s: saṃjagmānau \\ ity aratnī saṃdhattaḥ //
2.4.1.d: संजग्मानौ \\ इत्य् अरत्नी संधत्तः //
2.4.1.m: With: 'Meeting together,' they join their elbows.

2.4.1.s: śukrasyādhiṣṭhānam asi \\ itīdhmaśakalam agnāv adhyasyati // manthino 'dhiṣṭhānam asi \\ iti pratiprasthātā //
2.4.1.d: शुक्रस्याधिष्ठानम् असि \\ इतीध्मशकलम् अग्नाव् अध्यस्यति // मन्थिनो ऽधिष्ठानम् असि \\ इति प्रतिप्रस्थाता //
2.4.1.m: With: 'You are the resting place of śukra,' he throws the chip of firewood onto the fire; the pratiprasthātṛ [does likewise] with: 'You are the resting place of manthin.'

2.4.1.s: nirastaḥ śaṇḍas \\ iti yūpaśakalaṃ bahirvedi nirasyati // nirasto markas \\ iti pratiprasthātā /
2.4.1.d: निरस्तः शण्डस् \\ इति यूपशकलं बहिर्वेदि निरस्यति // निरस्तो मर्कस् \\ इति प्रतिप्रस्थाता /
2.4.1.m: With: 'Śaṇḍa is cast out,' he casts the chip of the sacrificial post outside the altar ground; the pratiprasthātṛ [does likewise] with: 'Marka is cast out.'

2.4.1.s: prāñcaś camasaiś caranti pratyañcau śukrāmanthibhyām /
2.4.1.d: प्राञ्चश् चमसैश् चरन्ति प्रत्यञ्चौ शुक्रामन्थिभ्याम् /
2.4.1.m: They move facing east with the cups, and the two [move] facing west with the śukra and manthin [cups].

2.4.1.s: āśrāvyādhvaryuḥ prātaḥ prātaḥsāvasya śukravato manthivato madhuścuta indrāya somān prasthitān preṣya \ hotar yaja \ madhyataḥkāriṇāṃ camasādhvaryavo vaṣaṭkṛtānuvaṣaṭkṛte juhuta \ hotṛkāṇāṃ camasādhvaryavaḥ [ sakṛt ] sakṛd dhutām̐ś camasān śukrasyābhyunnīyopāvartadhvam iti preṣyati /
2.4.1.d: आश्राव्याध्वर्युः प्रातः प्रातःसावस्य शुक्रवतो मन्थिवतो मधुश्चुत इन्द्राय सोमान् प्रस्थितान् प्रेष्य \ होतर् यज \ मध्यतःकारिणां चमसाध्वर्यवो वषट्कृतानुवषट्कृते जुहुत \ होतृकाणां चमसाध्वर्यवः [ सकृत् ] सकृद् धुताम्̐श् चमसान् शुक्रस्याभ्युन्नीयोपावर्तध्वम् इति प्रेष्यति /
2.4.1.m: Having called for [the āgnīdhra's] response, the adhvaryu gives the prompts: 'At the morning pressing, prompt [the hotṛ to recite] for Indra the Soma libations that have set forth, accompanied by śukra, accompanied by manthin, dripping sweetness! Hotṛ, recite the offering verse! Camasādhvaryus of the principal officiants, make the offerings at the vaṣaṭ-call and the second vaṣaṭ-call! Camasādhvaryus of the subordinate hotṛ priests, having once drawn Soma [for] the cups from the śukra, turn back!'

2.4.1.s: yathāpreṣitaṃ camasānām /
2.4.1.d: यथाप्रेषितं चमसानाम् /
2.4.1.m: The [handling] of the cups is according to the prompt.

2.4.1.s: śukrāmanthinau pratinigadya homau //
2.4.1.d: शुक्रामन्थिनौ प्रतिनिगद्य होमौ //
2.4.1.m: The two offerings of śukra and manthin take place after reciting the prompt.

2.4.1.s: yā prathamā sam̐skṛtir ity ubhau nigadya tasmā indrāya sutam ājuhota \\ ity adhvaryuḥ sarvahutaṃ karoti // tasmai sūryāya sutam ājuhota \\ iti pratiprasthātā /
2.4.1.d: या प्रथमा सम्̐स्कृतिर् इत्य् उभौ निगद्य तस्मा इन्द्राय सुतम् आजुहोत \\ इत्य् अध्वर्युः सर्वहुतं करोति // तस्मै सूर्याय सुतम् आजुहोत \\ इति प्रतिप्रस्थाता /
2.4.1.m: Both having recited: 'The first arrangement...', the adhvaryu makes a complete offering with: 'Pour out the pressed [Soma] to that Indra!'; the pratiprasthātṛ [does so] with: 'Pour out the pressed [Soma] to that Sūrya!'

2.4.1.s: hutvā rudrāya svāhā \\ iti śeṣam uttarārdhapūrvārdhe juhoti //
2.4.1.d: हुत्वा रुद्राय स्वाहा \\ इति शेषम् उत्तरार्धपूर्वार्धे जुहोति //
2.4.1.m: Having offered, he offers the remnant on the north-eastern part with: 'To Rudra, svāhā!'

2.4.1.s: praitu hotuś camasaḥ pra brahmaṇaḥ prodgātuḥ pra yajamānasya \\ iti preṣyati /
2.4.1.d: प्रैतु होतुश् चमसः प्र ब्रह्मणः प्रोद्गातुः प्र यजमानस्य \\ इति प्रेष्यति /
2.4.1.m: He gives the prompt: 'Let the cup of the hotṛ go forward; let that of the brahman go forward; let that of the udgātṛ go forward; let that of the sacrificer go forward!'

2.4.1.s: pratiparikramya yathāsthānaṃ pātre sādayataḥ /
2.4.1.d: प्रतिपरिक्रम्य यथास्थानं पात्रे सादयतः /
2.4.1.m: Having stepped back, the two place the vessels in their respective places.

2.4.1.s: punarabhyunnītānām ekaikaṃ grāham āśrāvam \\ praśāstar yaja \ brahman yaja \ potar yaja \ neṣṭar yaja \\ agnīd yaja \\ iti preṣyati /
2.4.1.d: पुनरभ्युन्नीतानाम् एकैकं ग्राहम् आश्रावम् \\ प्रशास्तर् यज \ ब्रह्मन् यज \ पोतर् यज \ नेष्टर् यज \\ अग्नीद् यज \\ इति प्रेष्यति /
2.4.1.m: Taking one cup at a time of those that were refilled, and having called for the response, he prompts: 'Praśāstṛ, recite the offering verse! Brahman, recite the offering verse! Potṛ, recite the offering verse! Neṣṭṛ, recite the offering verse! Agnīdh, recite the offering verse!'

2.4.1.s: vaṣaṭkṛtānuvaṣaṭkṛte hutvā harati bhakṣān //
2.4.1.d: वषट्कृतानुवषट्कृते हुत्वा हरति भक्षान् //
2.4.1.m: Having offered at the vaṣaṭ-call and the second vaṣaṭ-call, he takes the portions for consumption.

2.4.1.s: ayāḍ agnīd iti ced dhotā pṛched ayāḍ iti pratyāha /
2.4.1.d: अयाड् अग्नीद् इति चेद् धोता पृछेद् अयाड् इति प्रत्याह /
2.4.1.m: If the hotṛ should ask: 'Has the agnīdh made the offering?', he replies: 'He has made the offering.'

2.4.1.s: somabhakṣān sadasi bhakṣayanti vaṣaṭkartā homābhiṣavakārī camasinaś ca \\ upahūtopahvayasva \\ ity uktvā \\ upahūtā upahvayadhvam iti vā /
2.4.1.d: सोमभक्षान् सदसि भक्षयन्ति वषट्कर्ता होमाभिषवकारी चमसिनश् च \\ उपहूतोपह्वयस्व \\ इत्य् उक्त्वा \\ उपहूता उपह्वयध्वम् इति वा /
2.4.1.m: In the sadas hut, the utterer of the vaṣaṭ-call, the performers of the offering and the pressing, and the cup-bearers consume the Soma portions, having said: 'Invited, invite me,' or: 'Invited, invite [us]!'

2.4.1.s: dvidevatyān bhakṣayitvā hotā prayachati //
2.4.1.d: द्विदेवत्यान् भक्षयित्वा होता प्रयछति //
2.4.1.m: Having consumed the [cups] dedicated to two deities, the hotṛ hands [them] over.

2.4.1.s: bhakṣehi māviśa dīrghāyutvāya śaṃtanutvāya \\ ehi vaso purovaso \ priyo me hito bhava \\ aśvinos tvā bāhubhyāṃ saghyāsam iti pratigṛhṇāti yam̐yam̐ hotā prayachati //
2.4.1.d: भक्षेहि माविश दीर्घायुत्वाय शंतनुत्वाय \\ एहि वसो पुरोवसो \ प्रियो मे हितो भव \\ अश्विनोस् त्वा बाहुभ्यां सघ्यासम् इति प्रतिगृह्णाति यम्̐यम्̐ होता प्रयछति //
2.4.1.m: With: 'O portion for consumption, enter into me for long life, for bodily welfare! Come, O good, foremost in wealth, be dear to me, beneficial! May I grasp you with the arms of the Aśvins,' he receives each one that the hotṛ hands over.

2.4.1.s: nṛcakṣasaṃ tvā deva soma sucakṣā avakśeṣam ity avekṣate /
2.4.1.d: नृचक्षसं त्वा देव सोम सुचक्षा अवक्शेषम् इत्य् अवेक्षते /
2.4.1.m: He looks at it with: 'May I, clear-sighted, look upon you, the man-beholding divine Soma.'

2.4.1.s:
hinva me gātrā harivas\ gaṇān me mā vitītṛṣat /
śivo me sapta ṛṣīn upatiṣṭha \ mā me 'vāṅ nābhim atigāḥ //
iti dvir aindravāyavaṃ bhakṣayataḥ prāṇeṣūpaniyamya /
2.4.1.d:
हिन्व मे गात्रा हरिवस्\ गणान् मे मा वितीतृषत् /
शिवो मे सप्त ऋषीन् उपतिष्ठ \ मा मे ऽवाङ् नाभिम् अतिगाः //
इति द्विर् ऐन्द्रवायवं भक्षयतः प्राणेषूपनियम्य /
2.4.1.m:
'Invigorate my limbs, O lord of the bays; do not torment my vital organs with thirst!

Benevolent to me, attend upon the seven seers; do not pass downward beyond my navel!'

Holding [the cup] near their vital breaths, they consume the cup for Indra and Vāyu twice with this [formula].

2.4.1.s: avyatihāraṃ cakṣuṣor upaniyamya maitrāvaruṇam \\ mandrā vibhūtiḥ ketur yajñiyā vāg juṣāṇā somasya pibatu \\ iti bhakṣayataḥ /
2.4.1.d: अव्यतिहारं चक्षुषोर् उपनियम्य मैत्रावरुणम् \\ मन्द्रा विभूतिः केतुर् यज्ञिया वाग् जुषाणा सोमस्य पिबतु \\ इति भक्षयतः /
2.4.1.m: Holding [it] near the two eyes without interchange, they consume the cup for Mitra and Varuṇa with: 'Pleasing, powerful, the sign, worthy of sacrifice, may Speech enjoy and drink the Soma.'

2.4.1.s: sarvata āśvinaṃ parihāram̐ śrotrayor upaniyamya pratiparyāhṛtya mandrā svarvācy aditir anāhataśīrṣṇī vāg juṣāṇā somasya pibatu \\ iti bhakṣayataḥ /
2.4.1.d: सर्वत आश्विनं परिहारम्̐ श्रोत्रयोर् उपनियम्य प्रतिपर्याहृत्य मन्द्रा स्वर्वाच्य् अदितिर् अनाहतशीर्ष्णी वाग् जुषाणा सोमस्य पिबतु \\ इति भक्षयतः /
2.4.1.m: Bringing [it] around completely, holding [it] near the ears, and turning it back around, they consume the cup for the Aśvins with: 'Pleasing, heaven-sounding, Aditi, whose head is uninjured, may Speech enjoy and drink the Soma.'

2.4.1.s: hotṛcamase saṃpātam avanayati bhakṣayitvābhakṣayitvā /
2.4.1.d: होतृचमसे संपातम् अवनयति भक्षयित्वाभक्षयित्वा /
2.4.1.m: Having consumed [each], he pours the remnant into the hotṛ's cup after each consumption.

2.4.1.s:
mā mā rājan vibībhiṣas\ mā me hārdi dviṣā vadhīḥ /
vṛṣaṇam̐ śuṣmam āyuṣe varcase kṛdhi //
iti taṃtaṃ bhakṣayitvā hṛdayadeśam ārabhya japati /
2.4.1.d:
मा मा राजन् विबीभिषस्\ मा मे हार्दि द्विषा वधीः /
वृषणम्̐ शुष्मम् आयुषे वर्चसे कृधि //
इति तंतं भक्षयित्वा हृदयदेशम् आरभ्य जपति /

2.4.1.s: nānavadhāyāvasṛjed aindravāyave puroḍāśavṛgalaṃ maitrāvaruṇe payasyāṃ dhānā āśvine /
2.4.1.d: नानवधायावसृजेद् ऐन्द्रवायवे पुरोडाशवृगलं मैत्रावरुणे पयस्यां धाना आश्विने /
2.4.1.m: He should not release [them] without putting in: into [the cup] for Indra and Vāyu, a crumb of the sacrificial cake; into [the cup] for Mitra and Varuṇa, curd offering; into [the cup] for the Aśvins, parched grains.

2.4.1.s: dakṣiṇasya havirdhānasyottarasyā vartanyāḥ paścād dvidevatyapātrāṇi sādayati /
2.4.1.d: दक्षिणस्य हविर्धानस्योत्तरस्या वर्तन्याः पश्चाद् द्विदेवत्यपात्राणि सादयति /
2.4.1.m: He places the vessels for the dual deities behind the northern track of the southern cart-shed.

2.4.1.s: hotre 'vāntareḍām avadyati /
2.4.1.d: होत्रे ऽवान्तरेडाम् अवद्यति /
2.4.1.m: He cuts off the intermediate iḍā for the hotṛ.

2.4.1.s: upahūyamānāyām asam̐sparśayantaś camasān upodyachanti /
2.4.1.d: उपहूयमानायाम् असम्̐स्पर्शयन्तश् चमसान् उपोद्यछन्ति /
2.4.1.m: While it is being invoked, they raise the cups without letting them touch one another.

2.4.1.s: hotrā samudyamya samupahūya vasumadgaṇasya soma deva te matividaḥ prātaḥsavanasya gāyatrachandaso 'gnihuta indrapītasya madhumata upahūta upahūtaṃ bhakṣayāmi \\ iti camasān bhakṣayanti /
2.4.1.d: होत्रा समुद्यम्य समुपहूय वसुमद्गणस्य सोम देव ते मतिविदः प्रातःसवनस्य गायत्रछन्दसो ऽग्निहुत इन्द्रपीतस्य मधुमत उपहूत उपहूतं भक्षयामि \\ इति चमसान् भक्षयन्ति /
2.4.1.m: Having raised them together with the hotṛ and mutually invited [one another], they consume the cups with: "Of you, O divine Soma, who belong to the troop of the Vasus, knower of prayers, belonging to the morning pressing, whose meter is gāyatrī, offered in the fire, drunk by Indra, sweet—being invited, I consume what is invited."

2.4.1.s:
śaṃ no bhava hṛda ā pīta indo \ piteva soma sūnave suśevaḥ /
sakheva sakhya uruśaṃma dhīraḥ \ pra ṇa āyur jīvase soma tārīḥ //
iti taṃtaṃ bhakṣayitvā hṛdayadeśam ārabhya japati //
2.4.1.d:
शं नो भव हृद आ पीत इन्दो \ पितेव सोम सूनवे सुशेवः /
सखेव सख्य उरुशंम धीरः \ प्र ण आयुर् जीवसे सोम तारीः //
इति तंतं भक्षयित्वा हृदयदेशम् आरभ्य जपति //
2.4.1.m:
"Be auspicious to our heart when drunk, O drop! As a father is most gentle to his son, O Soma,

as a friend to a friend, O wide-sheltering, wise one: prolong our life that we may live, O Soma!"

Having consumed each [portion] with this [verse], he mutters while touching the heart region.

2.4.1.s: āpyāyasva \ saṃ te payām̐si \\ iti bhakṣaśeṣān [ āpyāyayanti ] /
2.4.1.d: आप्यायस्व \ सं ते पयाम्̐सि \\ इति भक्षशेषान् [ आप्याययन्ति ] /
2.4.1.m: [They swell] the remnants of the consumed [draughts] with: "Swell up," "May your juices gather together."

2.4.1.s: dakṣiṇasya havirdhānasya paścādakṣaṃ nārāśam̐sacamasān sādayanti /
2.4.1.d: दक्षिणस्य हविर्धानस्य पश्चादक्षं नाराशम्̐सचमसान् सादयन्ति /
2.4.1.m: They place the nārāśaṃsa cups behind the axle of the southern cart-shed.

2.4.1.s: upaviśaty achāvāko 'greṇa svaṃ dhiṣṇyaṃ bahiḥ sadasaḥ /
2.4.1.d: उपविशत्य् अछावाको ऽग्रेण स्वं धिष्ण्यं बहिः सदसः /
2.4.1.m: The acchāvāka priest sits down in front of his own hearth outside the sadas.

2.4.1.s: tasmai puroḍāśavṛgalaṃ pradāya \\ achāvāka vada \\ ity anuvācayati //
2.4.1.d: तस्मै पुरोडाशवृगलं प्रदाय \\ अछावाक वद \\ इत्य् अनुवाचयति //
2.4.1.m: Having handed him a crumb of the sacrificial cake, he causes him to recite: "Speak, O acchāvāka!"

2.4.1.s: upo asmān brāhmaṇān brāhmaṇā hvayadhvam ity ucyamāne puṇyam ayaṃ brāhmaṇa upahavakāmo vadatīmam̐ hotar upahvayasva \\ iti preṣyati //
2.4.1.d: उपो अस्मान् ब्राह्मणान् ब्राह्मणा ह्वयध्वम् इत्य् उच्यमाने पुण्यम् अयं ब्राह्मण उपहवकामो वदतीमम्̐ होतर् उपह्वयस्व \\ इति प्रेष्यति //
2.4.1.m: When he says, "Invite us, O Brahmins, Brahmins!," he prompts: "This Brahmin desiring an invitation speaks auspiciously; invite him, O hotṛ!"

2.4.1.s: unnīyamānāyānubrūhi \\ ity anuvācayati /
2.4.1.d: उन्नीयमानायानुब्रूहि \\ इत्य् अनुवाचयति /
2.4.1.m: He causes him to recite: "Recite [the invitatory verse] for [the cup] being drawn!"

2.4.1.s: ubhayataḥ śukram achāvākacamasam unnayati /
2.4.1.d: उभयतः शुक्रम् अछावाकचमसम् उन्नयति /
2.4.1.m: He draws the acchāvāka's cup with pure [soma] on both sides.

2.4.1.s: āśrāvya \\ achāvāka yaja \\ iti preṣyati /
2.4.1.d: आश्राव्य \\ अछावाक यज \\ इति प्रेष्यति /
2.4.1.m: Having called for recitation, he prompts: "O acchāvāka, recite the offering verse!"

2.4.1.s: vaṣaṭkṛtānuvaṣaṭkṛte hutvā harati bhakṣam /
2.4.1.d: वषट्कृतानुवषट्कृते हुत्वा हरति भक्षम् /
2.4.1.m: Having offered at the vaṣaṭ and the secondary vaṣaṭ, he carries the portion to be consumed.

2.4.1.s: na tena saṃbhakṣayed yady asminn upahavam ichet \\ bhakṣaya \\ iti brūyāt /
2.4.1.d: न तेन संभक्षयेद् यद्य् अस्मिन्न् उपहवम् इछेत् \\ भक्षय \\ इति ब्रूयात् /
2.4.1.m: He should not consume together with him; if he desires an invitation from him, he should say, "Consume!"

2.4.1.s: vyākhyātaṃ bhakṣaṇam āpyāyanaṃ ca /
2.4.1.d: व्याख्यातं भक्षणम् आप्यायनं च /
2.4.1.m: The consuming and the swelling have been explained.

2.4.1.s: antarā neṣṭuś camasam āgnīdhrasya cāchāvākacamasam̐ sādayati /
2.4.1.d: अन्तरा नेष्टुश् चमसम् आग्नीध्रस्य चाछावाकचमसम्̐ सादयति /
2.4.1.m: He places the cup of the acchāvāka between the cup of the neṣtṛ and [that] of the āgnīdhra.

2.4.1.s: āgnīdhre savanīyān bhakṣayanty antarvedi bahirvedi mārjayante / bahirvedi vā bhakṣayitvāntarvedi mārjayante /
2.4.1.d: आग्नीध्रे सवनीयान् भक्षयन्त्य् अन्तर्वेदि बहिर्वेदि मार्जयन्ते / बहिर्वेदि वा भक्षयित्वान्तर्वेदि मार्जयन्ते /
2.4.1.m: In the āgnīdhra shed they consume the press-offerings; they purify themselves inside the altar [ground] or outside the altar [ground]; or having consumed outside the altar [ground], they purify themselves inside the altar [ground].

2.4.1.s: anusavanam \\ brāhmaṇām̐s tarpaya \\ iti preṣyati /
2.4.1.d: अनुसवनम् \\ ब्राह्मणाम्̐स् तर्पय \\ इति प्रेष्यति /
2.4.1.m: At each pressing, he prompts: "Satisfy the Brahmins!"

2.4.2.s: ṛtugrahaiḥ pracarataḥ //
2.4.2.d: ऋतुग्रहैः प्रचरतः //
2.4.2.m: The two perform the ritual with the season-cups.

2.4.2.s: upayāmagṛhīto 'si \ madhave tvā \\ itiprabhṛtayo grahaṇāḥ /
2.4.2.d: उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \ मधवे त्वा \\ इतिप्रभृतयो ग्रहणाः /
2.4.2.m: The drawings begin with: "You are taken with a support;" "For Madhu, thee!"

2.4.2.s: saha prathamau gṛhṇītaḥ / pariplavām uduhya madhave tvā \\ ity adhvaryur upayāmagṛhīto 'si \ sam̐sarpo 'si \\ am̐haspatyāya tvā \\ iti pratiprasthātā /
2.4.2.d: सह प्रथमौ गृह्णीतः / परिप्लवाम् उदुह्य मधवे त्वा \\ इत्य् अध्वर्युर् उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \ सम्̐सर्पो ऽसि \\ अम्̐हस्पत्याय त्वा \\ इति प्रतिप्रस्थाता /
2.4.2.m: Together the two take the first two [cups]. Having moved the pariplavā ladle, the adhvaryu [takes] with: "For Madhu, thee!"; the pratiprasthātṛ [takes] with: "You are taken with a support; you are the Saṃsarpa; for Aṃhaspatya, thee!"

2.4.2.s: āśrāvya preṣyaty adhvaryus tasya praiṣe yugapaj juhutaḥ /
2.4.2.d: आश्राव्य प्रेष्यत्य् अध्वर्युस् तस्य प्रैषे युगपज् जुहुतः /
2.4.2.m: Having called for recitation, the adhvaryu prompts; at his prompt, the two offer simultaneously.

2.4.2.s: na ṛtugraheṣv anuvaṣaṭkaroti /
2.4.2.d: न ऋतुग्रहेष्व् अनुवषट्करोति /
2.4.2.m: He does not utter the secondary vaṣaṭ for the season-cups.

2.4.2.s: hutvā gṛhītvā ca pratiprasthātā dakṣiṇenādhvaryum abhiprayamya pātram̐ harati /
2.4.2.d: हुत्वा गृहीत्वा च प्रतिप्रस्थाता दक्षिणेनाध्वर्युम् अभिप्रयम्य पात्रम्̐ हरति /
2.4.2.m: Having offered and having taken [the draught], the pratiprasthātṛ, moving towards the adhvaryu from the south, carries the vessel.

2.4.2.s: nānyo'nyam abhiprapadyete /
2.4.2.d: नान्योऽन्यम् अभिप्रपद्येते /
2.4.2.m: The two do not cross each other's path.

2.4.2.s: śeṣe pūrvasyottaram abhiparigṛhṇītaḥ /
2.4.2.d: शेषे पूर्वस्योत्तरम् अभिपरिगृह्णीतः /
2.4.2.m: In the remainder, the two take each the next after the preceding.

2.4.2.s: pūrvaḥ pratiprasthātā mādhavāya tvā \\ iti gṛhṇāti / vyatyāsam uttaraiḥ / samānam āśrāvayatoḥ sthānam //
2.4.2.d: पूर्वः प्रतिप्रस्थाता माधवाय त्वा \\ इति गृह्णाति / व्यत्यासम् उत्तरैः / समानम् आश्रावयतोः स्थानम् //
2.4.2.m: The pratiprasthātṛ takes first with: "For Mādhava, thee!" Alternately with the following ones. The standing place of the two who call for recitation is the same.

2.4.2.s: ṛtunā preṣya \\ iti ṣaḍbhiḥ pracarato / yato hutaṃ tataḥ pātre gṛhītvā ṛtubhiḥ preṣya \\ iti caturbhir yathāditas tathā gṛhītvā ṛtunā preṣya \\ iti dvābhyām /
2.4.2.d: ऋतुना प्रेष्य \\ इति षड्भिः प्रचरतो / यतो हुतं ततः पात्रे गृहीत्वा ऋतुभिः प्रेष्य \\ इति चतुर्भिर् यथादितस् तथा गृहीत्वा ऋतुना प्रेष्य \\ इति द्वाभ्याम् /
2.4.2.m: They proceed with six [cups] with: "Prompt with the season!"; having taken into the vessel from where the offering was made, with four [cups] with: "Prompt with the seasons!"; having taken just as at first, with two [cups] with: "Prompt with the season!"

2.4.2.s:
ekādaśe praiṣe adhvaryū yajatam ity ukte tayor anyataro madhyamasya paridheḥ paścād upaviśya ye3 yajāmahe \\ aśvinādhvaryū ādhvaryavāt \\ ṛtunā somaṃ pibatām \\ vauṣaṭ \\ iti yajed atha ced ṛcā ye3 yajāmahe
aśvinā pibataṃ madhu \ dīdyagnī śucivratā \ ṛtunā yajñavāhasā //
vauṣaṭ \\ ity anavānam̐ yajati //
2.4.2.d:
एकादशे प्रैषे अध्वर्यू यजतम् इत्य् उक्ते तयोर् अन्यतरो मध्यमस्य परिधेः पश्चाद् उपविश्य ये3 यजामहे \\ अश्विनाध्वर्यू आध्वर्यवात् \\ ऋतुना सोमं पिबताम् \\ वौषट् \\ इति यजेद् अथ चेद् ऋचा ये3 यजामहे
अश्विना पिबतं मधु \ दीद्यग्नी शुचिव्रता \ ऋतुना यज्ञवाहसा //
वौषट् \\ इत्य् अनवानम्̐ यजति //
2.4.2.m: At the eleventh prompt, when "O two adhvaryus, offer!" is said, one of the two, having sat down behind the middle enclosing stick, should recite the offering verse: "We who sacrifice […] May the Aśvins, the two adhvaryus, by virtue of their adhvaryu-ship, drink Soma according to the season! Vauṣaṭ!"; or if with a verse, he recites the offering verse without taking breath: "We who sacrifice […]: / O Aśvins, drink the sweet [soma], / shining with fires, of pure vows, / bringing the sacrifice according to the season! / Vauṣaṭ!"

2.4.2.s: hotar etad yaja \\ iti vātipreṣyaty uttame praiṣe yajamānasya yājyātipraiṣo vā /
2.4.2.d: होतर् एतद् यज \\ इति वातिप्रेष्यत्य् उत्तमे प्रैषे यजमानस्य याज्यातिप्रैषो वा /
2.4.2.m: Or at the last prompt he prompts beyond with: "O hotṛ, recite the offering verse for this!"; or there is an extra prompting of the offering verse for the sacrificer.

2.4.2.s: sahottamau gṛhṇītas tapasyāya tvā \\ iti pratiprasthātā sam̐sarpeṇādhvaryuḥ /
2.4.2.d: सहोत्तमौ गृह्णीतस् तपस्याय त्वा \\ इति प्रतिप्रस्थाता सम्̐सर्पेणाध्वर्युः /
2.4.2.m: Together the two take the last two [cups]: the pratiprasthātṛ with: "For Tapasya, thee!"; the adhvaryu with the Saṃsarpa [formula].

2.4.2.s: dakṣiṇataḥ pratiprasthātāvatiṣṭhate / tasya praiṣe yugapaj juhutaḥ /
2.4.2.d: दक्षिणतः प्रतिप्रस्थातावतिष्ठते / तस्य प्रैषे युगपज् जुहुतः /
2.4.2.m: The pratiprasthātṛ stands to the south. At his prompt, the two offer simultaneously.

2.4.2.s: hutvā vyavanayataḥ /
2.4.2.d: हुत्वा व्यवनयतः /

2.4.2.s: adhvaryuḥ pratiprasthāne sarvam ānayati /
2.4.2.d: अध्वर्युः प्रतिप्रस्थाने सर्वम् आनयति /
2.4.2.m: The adhvaryu pours everything into the vessel of the pratiprasthātṛ.

2.4.2.s: tasyāgraṃ pratiprasthātādhvaryupātre 'vanīya \\ indrāgnī āgatam̐ sutam iti pratiprasthātādhvaryupātra aindrāgnaṃ gṛhṇāti \\ eṣa te yonir \ indrāgnibhyāṃ tvā \\ iti sādayati /
2.4.2.d: तस्याग्रं प्रतिप्रस्थाताध्वर्युपात्रे ऽवनीय \\ इन्द्राग्नी आगतम्̐ सुतम् इति प्रतिप्रस्थाताध्वर्युपात्र ऐन्द्राग्नं गृह्णाति \\ एष ते योनिर् \ इन्द्राग्निभ्यां त्वा \\ इति सादयति /
2.4.2.m: The pratiprasthātṛ, having poured the foremost portion of it into the vessel of the adhvaryu, draws [the cup] for Indra and Agni into the vessel of the adhvaryu with: "O Indra and Agni, come to the pressed [soma]!"; he puts it down with: "This is your womb; for Indra and Agni, thee!"

2.4.2.s: pratiprasthānenādhvaryurbhakṣam̐ harati //
2.4.2.d: प्रतिप्रस्थानेनाध्वर्युर्भक्षम्̐ हरति //
2.4.2.m: The adhvaryu carries the portion to be consumed with the vessel of the pratiprasthātṛ.

2.4.2.s: vāg devī somasya pibatu \\ iti bhakṣayanti samupahūya yathejyam̐ vyatihāram /
2.4.2.d: वाग् देवी सोमस्य पिबतु \\ इति भक्षयन्ति समुपहूय यथेज्यम्̐ व्यतिहारम् /
2.4.2.m: Having mutually invited [each other], they consume with: "May the divine speech drink of Soma!" alternately according to the order of offering.

2.4.2.s: prasadasi pātram ādadhāti /
2.4.2.d: प्रसदसि पात्रम् आदधाति /
2.4.2.m: He places the vessel in front of the sadas.

2.4.2.s: pratiprasthātā savanīyān nirvapati /
2.4.2.d: प्रतिप्रस्थाता सवनीयान् निर्वपति /
2.4.2.m: The pratiprasthātṛ apportions the press-offerings.

2.4.2.s: yathā vaiśvadevasya stotropākaraṇakāle haviṣkṛd āhūyeta /
2.4.2.d: यथा वैश्वदेवस्य स्तोत्रोपाकरणकाले हविष्कृद् आहूयेत /
2.4.2.m: Just as the havis-preparer would be summoned at the time of the preliminary performance of the stotra of the vaiśvadeva [śastra].

2.4.2.s: agreṇa hotāraṃ bahiḥ sadasaḥ prāṅmukhaḥ pratigarāyopaviśati //
2.4.2.d: अग्रेण होतारं बहिः सदसः प्राङ्मुखः प्रतिगरायोपविशति //
2.4.2.m: In front of the hotṛ, outside the sadas, facing east, he sits down for the response.

2.4.2.s: adhvaryo śom̐3sāvo3m ity ucyamāne śom̐3sāvo daivóm iti pratiparyāvartate /
2.4.2.d: अध्वर्यो शोम्̐3सावो3म् इत्य् उच्यमाने शोम्̐3सावो दैव्óम् इति प्रतिपर्यावर्तते /
2.4.2.m: When "O adhvaryu, let us two praise, om!" is said, he turns around with: "Let us two praise, divine one!"

2.4.2.s: ṛtupātram ārabhyordhvas tiṣṭhan sadobile samānasvaram̐ hotrā vyavasāneṣu pratigṛṇāti \\ othā modaiva \\ ity apraṇuteṣu \\ othā modaivo3m iti praṇuteṣv ṛganteṣu ca /
2.4.2.d: ऋतुपात्रम् आरभ्योर्ध्वस् तिष्ठन् सदोबिले समानस्वरम्̐ होत्रा व्यवसानेषु प्रतिगृणाति \\ ओथा मोदैव \\ इत्य् अप्रणुतेषु \\ ओथा मोदैवो3म् इति प्रणुतेष्व् ऋगन्तेषु च /
2.4.2.m: Having touched the season-vessel, standing upright at the opening of the sadas, he responds at the pauses in a tone identical with the hotṛ: with "Othā modaiva" at the unprolated [pauses], and with "Othā modaivom" at the prolated [pauses] and at the ends of verses.

2.4.2.s: yathā vā hotā brūyād āhutaḥ śom̐3sāvo daivo3m iti pratyāhvayati /
2.4.2.d: यथा वा होता ब्रूयाद् आहुतः शोम्̐3सावो दैवो3म् इति प्रत्याह्वयति /
2.4.2.m: Or, as the hotṛ might say when addressed, he calls back with: "Let us two praise, divine one, om!"

2.4.2.s: samāpte śastre graham ādatte 'dhvaryuś camasādhvaryavaś camasān /
2.4.2.d: समाप्ते शस्त्रे ग्रहम् आदत्ते ऽध्वर्युश् चमसाध्वर्यवश् चमसान् /
2.4.2.m: When the śastra is finished, the adhvaryu takes the cup, and the cup-adhvaryus take their cups.

2.4.2.s: āśrāvya \\ ukthaśā yaja somasya \\ iti preṣyati /
2.4.2.d: आश्राव्य \\ उक्थशा यज सोमस्य \\ इति प्रेष्यति /
2.4.2.m: Having called for recitation, he prompts: "O uktha-reciter, recite the offering verse of Soma!"

2.4.2.s: vaṣaṭkṛtānuvaṣaṭkṛte juhoti /
2.4.2.d: वषट्कृतानुवषट्कृते जुहोति /
2.4.2.m: He offers at the vaṣaṭ and the secondary vaṣaṭ.

2.4.2.s: camasādhvaryavo dviś camasān anu prāṅ nayanti //
2.4.2.d: चमसाध्वर्यवो द्विश् चमसान् अनु प्राङ् नयन्ति //
2.4.2.m: The cup-adhvaryus bring the cups forward along [the altar] twice.

2.4.2.s: vāg devī somasya pibatu \\ ity aindrāgnam̐ sarvabhakṣaṃ bhakṣayataḥ //
2.4.2.d: वाग् देवी सोमस्य पिबतु \\ इत्य् ऐन्द्राग्नम्̐ सर्वभक्षं भक्षयतः //
2.4.2.m: With: "May the divine speech drink of Soma!," the two consume the entire draught of the [cup] for Indra and Agni.

2.4.2.s: narāśam̐sapītasya soma deva te matividaḥ prātaḥsavanasya gāyatrachandasaḥ pitṛpītasya \\ iti vikṛto bhakṣamantraḥ /
2.4.2.d: नराशम्̐सपीतस्य सोम देव ते मतिविदः प्रातःसवनस्य गायत्रछन्दसः पितृपीतस्य \\ इति विकृतो भक्षमन्त्रः /
2.4.2.m: The modified consumption mantra is: "Of you, O divine Soma, who belong to the morning pressing, whose meter is gāyatrī, drunk by Narāśaṃsa, knower of prayers, drunk by the fathers..."

2.4.2.s: siddham ā sādanāt /
2.4.2.d: सिद्धम् आ सादनात् /

2.4.2.s: ṛtupātre mārjālīye prakṣālya yathāsthānam̐ sādayati //
2.4.2.d: ऋतुपात्रे मार्जालीये प्रक्षाल्य यथास्थानम्̐ सादयति //
2.4.2.m: Having washed the two season-vessels at the mārjālīya [hearth], he places them down in their proper places.

2.4.2.s: omāsaś carṣaṇīdhṛtas \\ iti śukrapātre vaiśvadevaṃ gṛhṇāti \\ eṣa te yonir \ viśvebhyas tvā devebhyas \\ iti sādayati /
2.4.2.d: ओमासश् चर्षणीधृतस् \\ इति शुक्रपात्रे वैश्वदेवं गृह्णाति \\ एष ते योनिर् \ विश्वेभ्यस् त्वा देवेभ्यस् \\ इति सादयति /
2.4.2.m: With "Protectors of men, supporters of folks...," he draws the cup for the All-gods in the śukra vessel; he places it down with: "This is your womb; for the All-gods, thee!"

2.4.2.s: pratiprasthātā droṇakalaśaṃ pūtabhṛty avanīya daśayā parimṛjya yathāsthānaṃ nyubjati /
2.4.2.d: प्रतिप्रस्थाता द्रोणकलशं पूतभृत्य् अवनीय दशया परिमृज्य यथास्थानं न्युब्जति /
2.4.2.m: The pratiprasthātṛ priest, having poured [the soma from] the droṇakalaśa trough into the pūtabhṛt vat and wiped it all around with the fringe, sets it turned upside down in its proper place.

2.4.2.s: caturhotāram̐ yajamāno japati purastād ājyānām iḍāyai hiṅkuru \\ iti ca /
2.4.2.d: चतुर्होतारम्̐ यजमानो जपति पुरस्ताद् आज्यानाम् इडायै हिङ्कुरु \\ इति च /
2.4.2.m: Before the ājyastotras, the sacrificer murmurs the Caturhotṛ formula and: 'Utter the sound hiṅ for the iḍā.'

2.4.2.s: dakṣiṇena hotrīyaṃ prastotre darbhau prayachann upāvartadhvam \ abhisarpa yajamāna \\ iti stotram upākaroti /
2.4.2.d: दक्षिणेन होत्रीयं प्रस्तोत्रे दर्भौ प्रयछन्न् उपावर्तध्वम् \ अभिसर्प यजमान \\ इति स्तोत्रम् उपाकरोति /
2.4.2.m: Giving two darbha-blades to the prastotṛ priest along the south of the hotṛ's post, he brings near the stotra with: 'Turn towards [us]; glide forward, O sacrificer.'

2.4.2.s: evam ata ūrdhvam̐ stotrāṇy upākaroty anyatra pavamānābhyām //
2.4.2.d: एवम् अत ऊर्ध्वम्̐ स्तोत्राण्य् उपाकरोत्य् अन्यत्र पवमानाभ्याम् //
2.4.2.m: From here onwards he brings near the stotras in this manner, except for the two pavamāna chants.

2.4.2.s: eṣa \\ ity ukte pratigarāyopaviśati / sa vyākhyātaḥ /
2.4.2.d: एष \\ इत्य् उक्ते प्रतिगरायोपविशति / स व्याख्यातः /
2.4.2.m: When 'eṣa' has been spoken, he sits down to make the response; that has been explained.

2.4.2.s: praugam̐ śastraṃ pratigīrya grahādānaprabhṛti samānam aindrāgnenā bhakṣaṇāt //
2.4.2.d: प्रौगम्̐ शस्त्रं प्रतिगीर्य ग्रहादानप्रभृति समानम् ऐन्द्राग्नेना भक्षणात् //
2.4.2.m: Having responded to the Prauga recitation, [the procedure] from the taking of the drawing onwards is identical with that of the [offering] to Indra and Agni up to the consuming.

2.4.2.s: narāśam̐sapītasya \\ iti vikṛto bhakṣamantraḥ /
2.4.2.d: नराशम्̐सपीतस्य \\ इति विकृतो भक्षमन्त्रः /
2.4.2.m: '[Of that which has been] drunk by Narāśaṃsa...' is the modified consuming formula.

2.4.2.s: siddham ā sādanāt /
2.4.2.d: सिद्धम् आ सादनात् /

2.4.2.s: mārjālīye prakṣālya pūtabhṛto 'nte sādayanti yathāsthānaṃ pātram /
2.4.2.d: मार्जालीये प्रक्षाल्य पूतभृतो ऽन्ते सादयन्ति यथास्थानं पात्रम् /
2.4.2.m: Having rinsed [the cups] at the mārjālīya fire, they set down the cup next to the pūtabhṛt vat in its proper place.

2.4.3.m: The two perform the rites with the portions of the ukthya vessel.

2.4.3.s: upayāmagṛhīto 'si \ mitrāvaruṇābhyāṃ tvā \\ iti gṛhṇāty ukthyasthālyās tṛtīyam ukthyapātra // eṣa te yonir \ mitrāvaruṇābhyāṃ tvā \\ iti sādayati //
2.4.3.d: उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \ मित्रावरुणाभ्यां त्वा \\ इति गृह्णात्य् उक्थ्यस्थाल्यास् तृतीयम् उक्थ्यपात्र // एष ते योनिर् \ मित्रावरुणाभ्यां त्वा \\ इति सादयति //
2.4.3.m: With: 'You are taken with a support; for Mitra and Varuṇa [I take] you,' he draws one third of the ukthya vessel into the ukthya cup. With: 'This is your womb; for Mitra and Varuṇa [I set] you,' he sets it down.

2.4.3.s: upayāmagṛhīto 'si \ devebhyas tvā devāyuvaṃ gṛhṇāmi \ punarhavir asi \\ ity ukthyasthālīm abhimrśati /
2.4.3.d: उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \ देवेभ्यस् त्वा देवायुवं गृह्णामि \ पुनर्हविर् असि \\ इत्य् उक्थ्यस्थालीम् अभिम्र्शति /
2.4.3.m: With: 'You are taken with a support; I take you seeking the gods for the gods; you are an oblation renewed,' he touches the ukthya vessel.
From the pūtabhṛt vat, he draws [soma] beginning with the Maitrāvaruṇa's goblet.

2.4.3.s: maitrāvaruṇāya pratigīrya graham ādatte 'dhvaryuś camasādhvaryavaś camasān /
2.4.3.d: मैत्रावरुणाय प्रतिगीर्य ग्रहम् आदत्ते ऽध्वर्युश् चमसाध्वर्यवश् चमसान् /
2.4.3.m: Having responded to the Maitrāvaruṇa, the adhvaryu priest takes the cup, and the camasādhvaryu priests take the goblets.

2.4.3.s: āśrāvya \\ ukthaśā yaja somānām iti preṣyati /
2.4.3.d: आश्राव्य \\ उक्थशा यज सोमानाम् इति प्रेष्यति /
2.4.3.m: Having called for the śrauṣaṭ, he summons with: 'Reciter of the uktha, offer of the somas.'
At the vaṣaṭ and the second vaṣaṭ, he offers, and the camasādhvaryu priests [also offer].

2.4.3.s: sada ālabhya devebhyas tvā devāyuvaṃ pṛṇacami \\ ity ukthyapātreṇa maitrāvaruṇacamase saṃpātam avanayati //
2.4.3.d: सद आलभ्य देवेभ्यस् त्वा देवायुवं पृणचमि \\ इत्य् उक्थ्यपात्रेण मैत्रावरुणचमसे संपातम् अवनयति //
2.4.3.m: Touching the sadas with: 'I unite you seeking the gods with the gods,' he pours the residue with the ukthya cup into the Maitrāvaruṇa's goblet.

2.4.3.s: vāg devī somasya pibatu \\ iti bhakṣayanti /
2.4.3.d: वाग् देवी सोमस्य पिबतु \\ इति भक्षयन्ति /
2.4.3.m: They consume it with: 'May the goddess Vāc drink of the soma.'
Having rinsed them at the mārjālīya fire, they set down the goblets in their proper places.
The pratiprasthātṛ priest performs the rite with the remaining two [portions].

2.4.3.s: upayāmagṛhīto 'si \\ indrāya tvā \\ iti gṛhṇāty ukthyasthālyā ardham ukthyapātra // eṣa te yonir \ indrāya tvā \\ iti sādayati /
2.4.3.d: उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \\ इन्द्राय त्वा \\ इति गृह्णात्य् उक्थ्यस्थाल्या अर्धम् उक्थ्यपात्र // एष ते योनिर् \ इन्द्राय त्वा \\ इति सादयति /
2.4.3.m: With: 'You are taken with a support; for Indra [I take] you,' he draws half of [what remains in] the ukthya vessel into the ukthya cup. With: 'This is your womb; for Indra [I set] you,' he sets it down.
In the very same way he makes it a renewed oblation.
From the pūtabhṛt vat, he draws [soma] beginning with the Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin's goblet.

2.4.3.s: brāhmaṇācham̐sī śam̐sati / tasya camase saṃpātam avanayati /
2.4.3.d: ब्राह्मणाछम्̐सी शम्̐सति / तस्य चमसे संपातम् अवनयति /
2.4.3.m: The Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin recites. He pours the residue into his goblet.
He places the pressed residue on the black antelope skin.
He takes down King Soma on the pressing-stones with a garment.
He pours the jar of the midday pressing into the ādhavanīya vat.

2.4.3.s: upayāmagṛhīto 'si \\ indrāgnibhyāṃ tvā \\ iti gṛhṇāty ukthyasthālyāḥ sarvam ukthyapātra // eṣa te yonir \ indrāgnibhyāṃ tvā \\ iti sādayati /
2.4.3.d: उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \\ इन्द्राग्निभ्यां त्वा \\ इति गृह्णात्य् उक्थ्यस्थाल्याः सर्वम् उक्थ्यपात्र // एष ते योनिर् \ इन्द्राग्निभ्यां त्वा \\ इति सादयति /
2.4.3.m: With: 'You are taken with a support; for Indra and Agni [I take] you,' he draws all that remains of the ukthya vessel into the ukthya cup. With: 'This is your womb; for Indra and Agni [I set] you,' he sets it down.
He does not make it a renewed oblation.
He draws all that is in the pūtabhṛt vat into [the goblets] beginning with the Acchāvāka's goblet.

2.4.3.s: achāvākāya pratigīrya \\ ukthaśās \\ iti brūyāt tasya camase saṃpātam avanayati /
2.4.3.d: अछावाकाय प्रतिगीर्य \\ उक्थशास् \\ इति ब्रूयात् तस्य चमसे संपातम् अवनयति /
2.4.3.m: Having responded to the Acchāvāka, he should say: 'Reciter of the uktha...'; he pours the residue into his goblet.
Having filled the hotṛ priest's goblet with the vasatīvarī waters, he sets it down in its proper place.

2.4.3.s:
agniḥ prātaḥsavanād iti savanakaraṇiṃ juhoti /
yas te drapsa skandati yas te am̐śur \ bāhucyuto dhiṣaṇāyā upasthāt /
adhvaryor vā pari vā yaḥ pavitrāt \ taṃ te juhomi manasā vaṣaṭkṛtam //
iti dvitīyām //
2.4.3.d:
अग्निः प्रातःसवनाद् इति सवनकरणिं जुहोति /
यस् ते द्रप्स स्कन्दति यस् ते अम्̐शुर् \ बाहुच्युतो धिषणाया उपस्थात् /
अध्वर्योर् वा परि वा यः पवित्रात् \ तं ते जुहोमि मनसा वषट्कृतम् //
इति द्वितीयाम् //
2.4.3.m: With: 'Agni from the morning pressing...', he offers the libation that effects the press-session. With: 'That drop of yours which falls away, that stalk of yours which, loosened from the arm, from the lap of the pressing board, / or from the adhvaryu priest or from the strainer, that I offer unto you with mind consecrated by vaṣaṭ,' he offers the second.
He summons: 'O director, impel!'

2.4.4.m: They glide forward for the midday pressing.

2.4.4.s: nigrābhyāḥ stha \\ iti yajamānam̐ vācayitvā somopanahanaṃ grāvastute prayachaty unnetre ca vasane /
2.4.4.d: निग्राभ्याः स्थ \\ इति यजमानम्̐ वाचयित्वा सोमोपनहनं ग्रावस्तुते प्रयछत्य् उन्नेत्रे च वसने /
2.4.4.m: Having made the sacrificer recite: 'You are the nigrābhya waters,' he hands the soma wrapping-cloth to the grāvastut priest, and the two garments to the unnetṛ priest.
Without being prompted, the grāvastut recites the verses to the pressing-stones.
Having led forth King [Soma], they press.
They press with: 'Here, here!'

2.4.4.s: uttamasya paryāyasya madhyame paryāye bṛhad bṛhad ity abhiṣuṇvanti /
2.4.4.d: उत्तमस्य पर्यायस्य मध्यमे पर्याये बृहद् बृहद् इत्य् अभिषुण्वन्ति /
2.4.4.m: In the middle turn of the last turn, they press with: 'Great, great!'
[The procedure is] established up to the continuous stream of the śukra cup.
He draws [the cups] beginning with the śukra and manthin cups.

2.4.4.s: ya āgrāyaṇasthālyām̐ somastam̐ hotṛcamase 'vanīyādhavanīyāc codañcanena ye devā divy ekādaśa stha \\ ity āgrāyaṇaṃ tisṛbhyo dhārābhyo gṛhṇāty uccaistarām̐ hiṅkaroti /
2.4.4.d: य आग्रायणस्थाल्याम्̐ सोमस्तम्̐ होतृचमसे ऽवनीयाधवनीयाच् चोदञ्चनेन ये देवा दिव्य् एकादश स्थ \\ इत्य् आग्रायणं तिसृभ्यो धाराभ्यो गृह्णात्य् उच्चैस्तराम्̐ हिङ्करोति /
2.4.4.m: Having poured the soma that is in the āgrāyaṇa vessel into the hotṛ priest's goblet, he draws from the ādhavanīya vat with the dipping ladle the āgrāyaṇa drawing from three streams with: 'O gods who are eleven in heaven...', and utters the sound hiṅ very loudly.

2.4.4.s: ṛtupātrābhyāṃ marutvatīyau gṛhṇīta indra marutva iha pāhi somam ity adhvaryur janiṣṭhā ugras \\ iti pratiprasthātā \\ eṣa te yonir \ indrāya tvā marutvate \\ iti sādayati /
2.4.4.d: ऋतुपात्राभ्यां मरुत्वतीयौ गृह्णीत इन्द्र मरुत्व इह पाहि सोमम् इत्य् अध्वर्युर् जनिष्ठा उग्रस् \\ इति प्रतिप्रस्थाता \\ एष ते योनिर् \ इन्द्राय त्वा मरुत्वते \\ इति सादयति /
2.4.4.m: The two draw the two Marutvatīya cups with the two season-cups: the adhvaryu priest with 'O Indra accompanied by the Maruts, drink the soma here,' and the pratiprasthātṛ priest with 'Born fierce...'; with 'This is your womb; for Indra accompanied by the Maruts [I set] you,' he sets it down.

2.4.4.s: ukthyaṃ gṛhītvātipāvya rājānaṃ prapīḍya pavitram̐ siddham ā sarpaṇāt /
2.4.4.d: उक्थ्यं गृहीत्वातिपाव्य राजानं प्रपीड्य पवित्रम्̐ सिद्धम् आ सर्पणात् /
2.4.4.m: Having drawn the ukthya cup, having clarified King [Soma] thoroughly, and having squeezed out the strainer, [the procedure is] established up to the gliding forward.
With straight bellies, they glide forward for the midday pressing.

2.4.4.s: uttareṇa havirdhāne pūrvayā dvārā sadaḥ praviśya sadasi stuvante /
2.4.4.d: उत्तरेण हविर्धाने पूर्वया द्वारा सदः प्रविश्य सदसि स्तुवन्ते /
2.4.4.m: Having entered the sadas by the east door along the north of the two havirdhāna carts, they chant the stotra in the sadas.
Without stepping across the hearth mounds, the adhvaryu priest sits down.
The purification has been explained; likewise the bringing near of the pavamāna chant.

2.4.4.s: pañcahotāram̐ yajamāno japati purastān mādhyaṃdinasya pavamānasya jyotiṣe hiṅkuru \\ iti ca // suparṇo 'si triṣṭubchandās \\ anu tvārabhe \ svasti mā saṃpāraya \\ iti ca /
2.4.4.d: पञ्चहोतारम्̐ यजमानो जपति पुरस्तान् माध्यंदिनस्य पवमानस्य ज्योतिषे हिङ्कुरु \\ इति च // सुपर्णो ऽसि त्रिष्टुब्छन्दास् \\ अनु त्वारभे \ स्वस्ति मा संपारय \\ इति च /
2.4.4.m: Before the midday pavamāna chant, the sacrificer murmurs the Pañcahotṛ formula, and: 'Utter the sound hiṅ for the light,' and: 'You are the fair-winged bird, your metre is triṣṭubh; I take hold of you from behind; carry me safely across.'

2.4.4.s: stute \\ agnīd agnīn vihara \ barhiḥ stṛṇāhi \ puroḍāśaṃ alaṃkuru \ pratiprasthātar dadhigharmāya dadhy upakalpayasva \\ iti preṣyati /
2.4.4.d: स्तुते \\ अग्नीद् अग्नीन् विहर \ बर्हिः स्तृणाहि \ पुरोडाशं अलंकुरु \ प्रतिप्रस्थातर् दधिघर्माय दध्य् उपकल्पयस्व \\ इति प्रेष्यति /
2.4.4.m: When the stotra has been chanted, he summons: 'O āgnīdhra priest, distribute the fires! Spread the sacrificial grass! Adorn the sacrificial cake! O pratiprasthātṛ priest, prepare curd for the curd-gharma!'
The distribution [of the fires] and the reed-line have been explained.

2.4.4.s: vaiṣṇavyā pātrāṇi saṃmṛśya dadhigharmeṇa pracaranti yadi pravṛñjanti /
2.4.4.d: वैष्णव्या पात्राणि संमृश्य दधिघर्मेण प्रचरन्ति यदि प्रवृञ्जन्ति /
2.4.4.m: Having touched the vessels with the verse to Viṣṇu, they proceed with the curd-gharma if they perform the pravargya rite.
From the taking off of the savanīya oblations onward, [the ritual] is established up to the call.

2.4.4.s: mādhyaṃdinasya savanasyendrāya puroḍāśānām iti vikṛtaḥ saṃpraiṣaḥ /
2.4.4.d: माध्यंदिनस्य सवनस्येन्द्राय पुरोडाशानाम् इति विकृतः संप्रैषः /
2.4.4.m: The call is modified: 'For the midday pressing, of the sacrificial cakes for Indra.'

2.4.4.d: सवनीयैः प्रचर्य \\ उन्नीयमानेभ्यो ऽनुब्रूहि \\ इत्य नुवाचयति /
2.4.4.m: Having performed the ritual acts with the savanīya oblations, he prompts [the hotṛ] to recite: 'Recite for those [cups] being drawn!'
He draws the cups including the achāvāka's cup.

2.4.4.s: mādhyaṃdinasya savanasya śukravato manthivato niṣkevalyasya bhāgasyendrāya somān prasthitān preṣya \\ iti vikṛtaḥ saṃpraiṣaḥ /
2.4.4.d: माध्यंदिनस्य सवनस्य शुक्रवतो मन्थिवतो निष्केवल्यस्य भागस्येन्द्राय सोमान् प्रस्थितान् प्रेष्य \\ इति विकृतः संप्रैषः /
2.4.4.m: The call is modified: 'For the midday pressing, prompt [the hotṛ] for the soma juices set forth for Indra, containing the Śukra, containing the Manthin, the unmixed portion!'
The achāvāka offers first, before the āgnīdhra.

2.4.4.s: hotrā samudyamya samupahūya rudravadgaṇasya soma deva te mativido mādhyaṃdinasya savanasya triṣṭupchandaso 'gnihuta indrapītasya \\ iti vikṛto bhakṣamantraḥ /
2.4.4.d: होत्रा समुद्यम्य समुपहूय रुद्रवद्गणस्य सोम देव ते मतिविदो माध्यंदिनस्य सवनस्य त्रिष्टुप्छन्दसो ऽग्निहुत इन्द्रपीतस्य \\ इति विकृतो भक्षमन्त्रः /
2.4.4.m: Having lifted [the cups] together with the hotṛ and invited each other, the consumption mantra is modified: 'O divine soma, who knowest the mind, of the host accompanied by the Rudras, of the midday pressing having the triṣṭubh metre, offered in fire, drunk by Indra...'
In the āgnīdhra shed they consume the savanīya oblations. That has been explained.

2.4.5.s: śālāmukhīye dākṣiṇau juhoti /
2.4.5.d: शालामुखीये दाक्षिणौ जुहोति /
2.4.5.m: In the śālāmukhīya fire he offers the two dākṣiṇa oblations.

2.4.5.s: hiraṇyaṃ baddhvā darbheṇocyartiṃ caturgṛhīte 'vadadhāti /
2.4.5.d: हिरण्यं बद्ध्वा दर्भेणोच्यर्तिं चतुर्गृहीते ऽवदधाति /
2.4.5.m: Having tied a piece of gold with a darbha blade, he places the ucyarti into the four-times scooped clarified butter.

2.4.5.s: vyākhyātaṃ prachādanam /
2.4.5.d: व्याख्यातं प्रछादनम् /
2.4.5.m: The covering has been explained.

2.4.5.s: upasam̐yamya daśām̐ srugdaṇḍa ud u tyaṃ jātavedasam iti juhoti // citraṃ devānām iti dvitīyām /
2.4.5.d: उपसम्̐यम्य दशाम्̐ स्रुग्दण्ड उद् उ त्यं जातवेदसम् इति जुहोति // चित्रं देवानाम् इति द्वितीयाम् /
2.4.5.m: Having gathered up the fringe on the handle of the ladle, he offers [with the verse]: 'Up that all-knowing god...' [and] the second [offering] with: 'The wonderful [face] of the gods...'

2.4.5.s: tasyāṃ punar gṛhītvā dyāṃ gacha \ svar gacha \\ iti hiraṇyam uddharati /
2.4.5.d: तस्यां पुनर् गृहीत्वा द्यां गछ \ स्वर् गछ \\ इति हिरण्यम् उद्धरति /
2.4.5.m: Having scooped again in that [ladle], he extracts the gold with: 'Go to heaven! Go to the light!'

2.4.5.s: dakṣiṇām̐ vediśroṇiṃ pratyavasthitāsu hiraṇyam ājyaṃ ca dhārayamāṇas \\ rūpam̐ vo rūpeṇābhyemi \\ iti dakṣiṇā abhyeti //
2.4.5.d: दक्षिणाम्̐ वेदिश्रोणिं प्रत्यवस्थितासु हिरण्यम् आज्यं च धारयमाणस् \\ रूपम्̐ वो रूपेणाभ्येमि \\ इति दक्षिणा अभ्येति //
2.4.5.m: While [the cows] stand opposite the southern buttock of the vedi, holding the gold and the clarified butter, he approaches the sacrificial gifts with: 'With form I approach your form.'

2.4.5.s: tutho vo viśvavedā vibhajatu \\ iti vibhajati / yāvan madhyataḥkāribhyas tasyārdham ardhibhyas tṛtīyaṃ tṛtīyibhyas tuyam̐ pādibhyaḥ /
2.4.5.d: तुथो वो विश्ववेदा विभजतु \\ इति विभजति / यावन् मध्यतःकारिभ्यस् तस्यार्धम् अर्धिभ्यस् तृतीयं तृतीयिभ्यस् तुयम्̐ पादिभ्यः /
2.4.5.m: He distributes them with: 'May Tutha, the all-knower, distribute you.' As much as [is given] to the principal priests, half of that to the second-rank priests, a third to the third-rank priests, a fourth to the fourth-rank priests.

2.4.5.s: madhyataḥkāriṇo brahmodgātā hotādhvaryus teṣām ardhino brāhmaṇācham̐sī prastotā maitrāvaruṇaḥ pratiprasthātā tṛtīyina āgnīdhraḥ pratihartāchāvāko neṣṭā pādinaḥ potā subrahmaṇyo grāvastud unnetā /
2.4.5.d: मध्यतःकारिणो ब्रह्मोद्गाता होताध्वर्युस् तेषाम् अर्धिनो ब्राह्मणाछम्̐सी प्रस्तोता मैत्रावरुणः प्रतिप्रस्थाता तृतीयिन आग्नीध्रः प्रतिहर्ताछावाको नेष्टा पादिनः पोता सुब्रह्मण्यो ग्रावस्तुद् उन्नेता /
2.4.5.m: The principal priests are the brahman, the udgātṛ, the hotṛ, and the adhvaryu. Their second-rank priests are the brāhmaṇācchaṃsin, the prastotṛ, the maitrāvaruṇa, and the pratiprasthātṛ. The third-rank priests are the āgnīdhra, the pratihartṛ, the achāvāka, and the neṣṭṛ. The fourth-rank priests are the potṛ, the subrahmaṇya, the grāvastut, and the unnetṛ.

2.4.5.s: ajaṃ dadāty aviṃ māṣām̐s tilān kṛtānnam̐ vāso 'śvam̐ hiraṇyaṃ / gavām̐ saṃkhyā śataṃ dvādaśam̐ vāparimitā vaikavim̐śatyavarā /
2.4.5.d: अजं ददात्य् अविं माषाम्̐स् तिलान् कृतान्नम्̐ वासो ऽश्वम्̐ हिरण्यं / गवाम्̐ संख्या शतं द्वादशम्̐ वापरिमिता वैकविम्̐शत्यवरा /
2.4.5.m: He gives a goat, a sheep, black beans, sesame seeds, cooked food, a garment, a horse, [and] gold. The number of cows is one hundred and twelve, or unlimited, with twenty-one as the minimum.

2.4.5.s: aparārdhād dhiraṇyapāṇir dakṣiṇā nayaty agreṇa gārhapatyaṃ jaghanena sada āgnīdhrabhāgam agrataḥ / sam̐hatān itarān //
2.4.5.d: अपरार्धाद् धिरण्यपाणिर् दक्षिणा नयत्य् अग्रेण गार्हपत्यं जघनेन सद आग्नीध्रभागम् अग्रतः / सम्̐हतान् इतरान् //
2.4.5.m: Holding gold in his hand, he leads the sacrificial gifts from the western side, in front of the gārhapatya and behind the sadas, with the share for the āgnīdhra in front, [and] the others close together.

2.4.5.s: etat te agne rādhas \\ ity āgnīdhrabhāgam anumantrayate /
2.4.5.d: एतत् ते अग्ने राधस् \\ इत्य् आग्नीध्रभागम् अनुमन्त्रयते /
2.4.5.m: He accompanies the share for the āgnīdhra with the mantra: 'This is your wealth, O Agni.'

2.4.5.s: dakṣiṇato 'vasthitāsu \\ ayaṃ no agnir ity āgnīdhrīye juhoti // vaneṣu vy antarikṣam iti dvitīyām̐ yadi cakrīvatprājāpatyāṃ tṛtīyām̐ yadi hastinaṃ puruṣam̐ vā //
2.4.5.d: दक्षिणतो ऽवस्थितासु \\ अयं नो अग्निर् इत्य् आग्नीध्रीये जुहोति // वनेषु व्य् अन्तरिक्षम् इति द्वितीयाम्̐ यदि चक्रीवत्प्राजापत्यां तृतीयाम्̐ यदि हस्तिनं पुरुषम्̐ वा //
2.4.5.m: While [the cows] stand to the south, he offers into the āgnīdrīya fire with: 'May this fire of ours...'; a second [oblation] with: 'In the woods through the intermediate space...', if there is a vehicle; a third with a verse to Prajāpati if there is an elephant or a man.

2.4.5.s: ṛtasya pathā preta \\ ity antarā cātvālam āgnīdhraṃ codīcīr utsṛjati //
2.4.5.d: ऋतस्य पथा प्रेत \\ इत्य् अन्तरा चात्वालम् आग्नीध्रं चोदीचीर् उत्सृजति //
2.4.5.m: With: 'Go forth by the path of truth,' he releases [the cows] facing north between the pit and the āgnīdhra shed.

2.4.5.s: brāhmaṇam adya ṛdhyāsaṃ pitṛmantaṃ paitṛmatyam ṛṣim ārṣeyam̐ sudhātudakṣiṇam \ idaṃ candram imāś ca bhavate dakṣiṇā dadāmi \\ ity antarvedi tiṣṭhann ṛtvigbhyaḥ sahiraṇyā dakṣiṇā dadāty agnīdhe prathamaṃ tato madhyataḥkāribhyo 'nupūrvam̐ hotṛkebhyaś cāntataḥ pratihartre /
2.4.5.d: ब्राह्मणम् अद्य ऋध्यासं पितृमन्तं पैतृमत्यम् ऋषिम् आर्षेयम्̐ सुधातुदक्षिणम् \ इदं चन्द्रम् इमाश् च भवते दक्षिणा ददामि \\ इत्य् अन्तर्वेदि तिष्ठन्न् ऋत्विग्भ्यः सहिरण्या दक्षिणा ददात्य् अग्नीधे प्रथमं ततो मध्यतःकारिभ्यो ऽनुपूर्वम्̐ होतृकेभ्यश् चान्ततः प्रतिहर्त्रे /
2.4.5.m: Standing inside the vedi, he gives the sacrificial gifts accompanied by gold to the officiating priests with: 'May I today satisfy a brāhmaṇa who has fathers, whose father has fathers, a ṛṣi, of ṛṣi descent, with abundant sacrificial gifts. This shining [gold] and these sacrificial gifts I give to you, sir'—first to the āgnīdhra, then to the principal priests in order, and to the minor hotṛ priests, and finally to the pratihartṛ.

2.4.5.s: prāsarpakaṃ dakṣiṇāpathena nītvā sadasyaprathamebhyo dadyād ātreyāya tato hiraṇyam //
2.4.5.d: प्रासर्पकं दक्षिणापथेन नीत्वा सदस्यप्रथमेभ्यो दद्याद् आत्रेयाय ततो हिरण्यम् //
2.4.5.m: Having brought [the gifts] for the uninvited spectators along the southern path, he should give them first to those seated in the sadas, and then gold to the Ātreya.

2.4.5.s: vi svaḥ paśya \\ iti sadaḥ praviśya yajamānam̐ vācayati //
2.4.5.d: वि स्वः पश्य \\ इति सदः प्रविश्य यजमानम्̐ वाचयति //
2.4.5.m: Having entered the sadas, he has the sacrificer recite: 'Look upon the light!'

2.4.5.s: asmadrātās \\ iti dakṣiṇā anumantrayate /
2.4.5.d: अस्मद्रातास् \\ इति दक्षिणा अनुमन्त्रयते /
2.4.5.m: He accompanies the sacrificial gifts with: 'Given by us...'

2.4.5.s: cātvāle kṛṣṇaviṣāṇāṃ pravidhyati /
2.4.5.d: चात्वाले कृष्णविषाणां प्रविध्यति /
2.4.5.m: He throws away the black antelope horn into the pit.

2.4.5.s: nordhvaṃ marutvatīyābhyāṃ dadāti /
2.4.5.d: नोर्ध्वं मरुत्वतीयाभ्यां ददाति /
2.4.5.m: He does not give after the two Marutvatīya cups.

2.4.5.s: yebhyo 'tra na dadyād anūbandhyāyai hutāyām̐ vapāyāṃ tebhyo dadyāt /
2.4.5.d: येभ्यो ऽत्र न दद्याद् अनूबन्ध्यायै हुतायाम्̐ वपायां तेभ्यो दद्यात् /
2.4.5.m: To whomsoever he should not give at this point, he should give when the omentum of the anūbandhyā cow has been offered.

2.4.6.m: The two [adhvaryu and pratiprasthātṛ] proceed with the two Marutvatīya cups.
He prompts [the hotṛ] to recite: 'Recite for Indra accompanied by the Maruts!'

2.4.6.s: āśrāvya \\ indrāya marutvate preṣya \\ iti pracarati /
2.4.6.d: आश्राव्य \\ इन्द्राय मरुत्वते प्रेष्य \\ इति प्रचरति /
2.4.6.m: Having called for the response, he proceeds with: 'Prompt [the hotṛ] for Indra accompanied by the Maruts!'
Having offered at the second vaṣaṭ-call, the two pour out [the residue] together.

2.4.6.s: adhvaryuḥ pratiprasthāne sarvam ānayati / tasyāgra pratiprasthātādhvaryupātre 'vanayati //
2.4.6.d: अध्वर्युः प्रतिप्रस्थाने सर्वम् आनयति / तस्याग्र प्रतिप्रस्थाताध्वर्युपात्रे ऽवनयति //
2.4.6.m: The adhvaryu pours everything into the pratiprasthātṛ's vessel. Then the pratiprasthātṛ pours the first part into the adhvaryu's vessel.

2.4.6.s: sajoṣā indra \\ ity adhvaryuḥ svasmin pātre marutvatīyaṃ grahaṃ gṛhṇāti \\ eṣa te yonir \ indrāya tvā marutvate \\ iti sādayati /
2.4.6.d: सजोषा इन्द्र \\ इत्य् अध्वर्युः स्वस्मिन् पात्रे मरुत्वतीयं ग्रहं गृह्णाति \\ एष ते योनिर् \ इन्द्राय त्वा मरुत्वते \\ इति सादयति /
2.4.6.m: With: 'Unanimous, O Indra...', the adhvaryu draws the Marutvatīya cup into his own vessel. He sets it down with: 'This is your womb; for Indra accompanied by the Maruts thee!'
The adhvaryu carries the portion for consumption with the pratiprasthātṛ's vessel.

2.4.6.s: vāg devī somasya pibatu \\ iti bhakṣayanti samupahūya /
2.4.6.d: वाग् देवी सोमस्य पिबतु \\ इति भक्षयन्ति समुपहूय /
2.4.6.m: Having invited each other, they consume [the soma] with: 'May the divine speech drink of the soma!'
He places the vessel in front of the sadas.

2.4.6.s: pratiprasthātā savanīyān nirvapati saumyaṃ ca carum /
2.4.6.d: प्रतिप्रस्थाता सवनीयान् निर्वपति सौम्यं च चरुम् /
2.4.6.m: The pratiprasthātṛ apportions the savanīya oblations and the caru for Soma.
So that at the time of beginning the Māhendra chant, the preparer of the oblation may be summoned.
He sits down for the response. That has been explained.

2.4.6.s: marutvatīyam̐ śastraṃ pratigīrya grahādānaprabhṛti samānam aindrāgnenā bhakṣaṇāt //
2.4.6.d: मरुत्वतीयम्̐ शस्त्रं प्रतिगीर्य ग्रहादानप्रभृति समानम् ऐन्द्राग्नेना भक्षणात् //
2.4.6.m: Having responded to the Marutvatīya recitation, from the taking of the cup onward, it is the same as the offering to Indra and Agni, up to the consumption.

2.4.6.s: narāśam̐sapītasya soma deva te mativido mādhyaṃdinasya savanasya triṣṭupchandasaḥ pitṛpītasya \\ iti vikṛto bhakṣamantraḥ /
2.4.6.d: नराशम्̐सपीतस्य सोम देव ते मतिविदो माध्यंदिनस्य सवनस्य त्रिष्टुप्छन्दसः पितृपीतस्य \\ इति विकृतो भक्षमन्त्रः /
2.4.6.m: The consumption mantra is modified: 'O divine soma, who knowest the mind, drunk by Narāśaṃsa, of the midday pressing having the triṣṭubh metre, drunk by the fathers...'

2.4.6.s: mahaṃ indro nṛvad iti śukrapātre māhendraṃ gṛhṇāti \\ eṣa te yonir \ mahendrāya tvā \\ iti sādayati /
2.4.6.d: महं इन्द्रो नृवद् इति शुक्रपात्रे माहेन्द्रं गृह्णाति \\ एष ते योनिर् \ महेन्द्राय त्वा \\ इति सादयति /
2.4.6.m: With: 'Great Indra like men...', he draws the Māhendra cup into the Śukra vessel. He sets it down with: 'This is your womb; for Great Indra thee!'
[The ritual] up to the separate Ukthya drawings, other than what belongs to the sacrificer, has been explained by the Vaiśvadeva cup.

2.4.6.s: upayāmagṛhīto 'si \\ indrāya tvā \\ ity ukthyo vigṛhyata // eṣa te yonir \ indrāya tvā \\ iti sādayati /
2.4.6.d: उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \\ इन्द्राय त्वा \\ इत्य् उक्थ्यो विगृह्यत // एष ते योनिर् \ इन्द्राय त्वा \\ इति सादयति /
2.4.6.m: The Ukthya cup is drawn separately with: 'Thou art taken with a support; for Indra thee!' He sets it down with: 'This is your womb; for Indra thee!'
He pours out the pressed soma dregs onto the pressing stones.
He pours the jar of the third pressing into the ādhavanīya trough.
He pours the entire [contents] of the pūtabhṛt into the cups, beginning with the achāvāka's cup.

2.4.6.s: achāvākāya pratigīrya \\ uktham̐ vāci \\ iti brūyāt /
2.4.6.d: अछावाकाय प्रतिगीर्य \\ उक्थम्̐ वाचि \\ इति ब्रूयात् /
2.4.6.m: Having responded to the achāvāka, he should say: 'The praise has been spoken!'

2.4.6.s:
viśve devā maruta indro asmān \ asmin dvitīye savane na jahyuḥ /
sumedhasaḥ priyam eṣām̐ vadantas\ vayam̐ syāma patayo rayīṇām //
iti savanakaraṇiṃ juhoti /
yo drapso am̐śuḥ patitaḥ pṛthivyām\ parivāpāt puroḍāśāt karambhāt /
dhānāsomān manthina indraḥ śukrāt \ taṃ te juhomi manasā vaṣaṭkṛtam //
iti dvitīyām //
2.4.6.d:
विश्वे देवा मरुत इन्द्रो अस्मान् \ अस्मिन् द्वितीये सवने न जह्युः /
सुमेधसः प्रियम् एषाम्̐ वदन्तस्\ वयम्̐ स्याम पतयो रयीणाम् //
इति सवनकरणिं जुहोति /
यो द्रप्सो अम्̐शुः पतितः पृथिव्याम्\ परिवापात् पुरोडाशात् करम्भात् /
धानासोमान् मन्थिन इन्द्रः शुक्रात् \ तं ते जुहोमि मनसा वषट्कृतम् //
इति द्वितीयाम् //
2.4.6.m:
'May the All-gods, the Maruts, [and] Indra not forsake us / at this second pressing;

Wise, speaking what is dear to them, / may we be lords of riches!'

With this [verse] he offers the savanakaraṇī oblation.

'Whatever drop, whatever stalk has fallen to the earth / from the roasted barley grains, from the sacrificial cake, from the groats meal...'

from the parched-grain Soma, from the Manthin cup, Indra [partook] from the Śukra cup; / that of yours, made into the vaṣaṭ-call by the mind, I offer to you.
He directs: "Praśāstṛ, give the impulse!"
Impelled, they creep forward, they creep forward.

2.5.1.s: tṛtīyasavanāya prasarpanti /
2.5.1.d: तृतीयसवनाय प्रसर्पन्ति /
2.5.1.m: They creep forward for the third pressing.

2.5.1.s: ādityagrahaṃ gṛhṇāty apidhāya havirdhāne kadā cana starīr asi \\ ity ādityasthālyās tṛtīyam ādityapātre // yajño devānām iti tasmim̐s taptātaṅkyaṃ dadhi //
2.5.1.d: आदित्यग्रहं गृह्णात्य् अपिधाय हविर्धाने कदा चन स्तरीर् असि \\ इत्य् आदित्यस्थाल्यास् तृतीयम् आदित्यपात्रे // यज्ञो देवानाम् इति तस्मिम्̐स् तप्तातङ्क्यं दधि //
2.5.1.m: Having closed the two Soma-carts, he draws the Āditya cup with: "Never art thou barren..."—one third from the Āditya vessel into the Āditya cup. With: "The sacrifice of the gods...", [he puts] curd thickened while hot into it.

2.5.1.s: kadā cana prayuchasi \\ ity ādityasthālyā abhipūrayati //
2.5.1.d: कदा चन प्रयुछसि \\ इत्य् आदित्यस्थाल्या अभिपूरयति //
2.5.1.m: With: "Never dost thou neglect...", he fills it up from the Āditya vessel.

2.5.1.s: yā divyā vṛṣṭis tayā tvā śrīṇāmi \\ iti śītātaṅkyena dadhnā śrīṇāti //
2.5.1.d: या दिव्या वृष्टिस् तया त्वा श्रीणामि \\ इति शीतातङ्क्येन दध्ना श्रीणाति //
2.5.1.m: With: "With the heavenly rain I mix thee", he mixes it with curd thickened while cold.

2.5.1.s: vivasvann ādityaiṣa te somapīthas \\ ity upām̐śusavanena paryāsaṃ mekṣayati /
2.5.1.d: विवस्वन्न् आदित्यैष ते सोमपीथस् \\ इत्य् उपाम्̐शुसवनेन पर्यासं मेक्षयति /
2.5.1.m: With: "O brilliant Āditya, this is thy Soma-draught...", he stirs it around with the pressing stone for the Upāṃśu cup.

2.5.1.s: apidhāyopaniṣkrāmati darbhaiḥ pāṇinā ca //
2.5.1.d: अपिधायोपनिष्क्रामति दर्भैः पाणिना च //
2.5.1.m: Having covered it with darbha grass and with his hand, he steps out.

2.5.1.s: ahaṃ parastād iti yajamāno 'nvārabhate //
2.5.1.d: अहं परस्ताद् इति यजमानो ऽन्वारभते //
2.5.1.m: The sacrificer touches him from behind with: "I [follow] behind..."

2.5.1.s: ādityebhyaḥ priyebhyaḥ priyadhāmabhyaḥ priyavratebhyo mahaḥ svasarasya patibhya uror antarikṣasyādhyakṣebhyo 'nubrūhi \\ ity anuvācayati /
2.5.1.d: आदित्येभ्यः प्रियेभ्यः प्रियधामभ्यः प्रियव्रतेभ्यो महः स्वसरस्य पतिभ्य उरोर् अन्तरिक्षस्याध्यक्षेभ्यो ऽनुब्रूहि \\ इत्य् अनुवाचयति /
2.5.1.m: He causes [the hotṛ] to recite the invitatory verse: "To the Ādityas, the dear ones, whose abodes are dear, whose vows are dear, the lords of the great fold, the overseers of the broad intermediate space, recite!"

2.5.1.s: āśrāvya \\ ādityebhyaḥ priyebhyaḥ priyadhāmabhyaḥ priyavratebhyo mahaḥ svasarasya patibhya uror antarikṣasyādhyakṣebhyaḥ preṣya \\ iti pracarati /
2.5.1.d: आश्राव्य \\ आदित्येभ्यः प्रियेभ्यः प्रियधामभ्यः प्रियव्रतेभ्यो महः स्वसरस्य पतिभ्य उरोर् अन्तरिक्षस्याध्यक्षेभ्यः प्रेष्य \\ इति प्रचरति /
2.5.1.m: Having called for the śrauṣaṭ, he proceeds with the direction: "To the Ādityas, the dear ones, whose abodes are dear, whose vows are dear, the lords of the great fold, the overseers of the broad intermediate space, summon!"

2.5.1.s: prāsya darbhān anyatrekṣamāṇa unnambhaya \\ iti pratinigadya vaṣaṭkṛte na sarvaṃ juhoti //
2.5.1.d: प्रास्य दर्भान् अन्यत्रेक्षमाण उन्नम्भय \\ इति प्रतिनिगद्य वषट्कृते न सर्वं जुहोति //
2.5.1.m: Having thrown down the darbha blades while looking elsewhere, having repeated: "Cause [the cloud] to rise!", he does not offer all of it when the vaṣaṭ-call is uttered.

2.5.1.s: abhiṣotāro 'bhiṣuṇuta \\ agnīd āśiram̐ vinaya \ pratiprasthātar ya upām̐śupātre 'm̐śus tam ṛjīṣe 'pyasyābhiṣutyodañcam̐ hṛtvādhavanīye praskandayasva \\ iti preṣyati /
2.5.1.d: अभिषोतारो ऽभिषुणुत \\ अग्नीद् आशिरम्̐ विनय \ प्रतिप्रस्थातर् य उपाम्̐शुपात्रे ऽम्̐शुस् तम् ऋजीषे ऽप्यस्याभिषुत्योदञ्चम्̐ हृत्वाधवनीये प्रस्कन्दयस्व \\ इति प्रेष्यति /
2.5.1.m: He gives the direction: "Pressers, press! Agnīdh, pour out the milk mixture! Pratiprasthātṛ, having thrown the shoot that is in the Upāṃśu cup into the pressed Soma-residue, having pressed it, having carried it northwards, cause it to trickle into the Ādhavanīya trough!"

2.5.1.s: vasatīvarībhir abhiṣuṇvanti /
2.5.1.d: वसतीवरीभिर् अभिषुण्वन्ति /
2.5.1.m: They press with the Vasatīvarī waters.

2.5.1.s: paścād āgnīdhrīyasyāśiraṃ manthati /
2.5.1.d: पश्चाद् आग्नीध्रीयस्याशिरं मन्थति /
2.5.1.m: Behind the Āgnīdhra fire, he churns the milk mixture.

2.5.1.s: pūtabhṛti pavitram̐ vitatya śukradhārām̐ saṃpragṛhṇāti /
2.5.1.d: पूतभृति पवित्रम्̐ वितत्य शुक्रधाराम्̐ संप्रगृह्णाति /
2.5.1.m: Having spread the strainer over the Pūtabhṛt vat, he holds the stream of clear [Soma].

2.5.1.s: adhi viparyasyaty āgrāyaṇasthālīm ādityasthālīm ādityapātraṃ ca /
2.5.1.d: अधि विपर्यस्यत्य् आग्रायणस्थालीम् आदित्यस्थालीम् आदित्यपात्रं च /
2.5.1.m: He turns upside down the Āgrayaṇa vessel, the Āditya vessel, and the Āditya cup.

2.5.1.s: ādhavanīyāc codañcanena ye devā divy ekādaśa stha \\ ity āgrāyaṇaṃ catasṛbhyo dhārābhyo gṛhṇāti / sūccaistarām̐ hiṅkaroti /
2.5.1.d: आधवनीयाच् चोदञ्चनेन ये देवा दिव्य् एकादश स्थ \\ इत्य् आग्रायणं चतसृभ्यो धाराभ्यो गृह्णाति / सूच्चैस्तराम्̐ हिङ्करोति /
2.5.1.m: With the dipping-ladle from the Ādhavanīya trough, he draws the Āgrayaṇa cup from four streams with: "Ye gods who are eleven in heaven..." He sounds hiṅ very loudly.

2.5.1.s: nāgniṣṭome tṛtīyasavana ukthyaṃ gṛhṇāti /
2.5.1.d: नाग्निष्टोमे तृतीयसवन उक्थ्यं गृह्णाति /
2.5.1.m: In the Agniṣṭoma rite, he does not draw the Ukthya cup at the third pressing.

2.5.1.s: yadi ṣoḍaśy ukthyaṃ gṛhītvā \\ indram id dharī vahatas \\ ity āgrāyaṇāt ṣoḍaśinaṃ gṛhṇāti /
2.5.1.d: यदि षोडश्य् उक्थ्यं गृहीत्वा \\ इन्द्रम् इद् धरी वहतस् \\ इत्य् आग्रायणात् षोडशिनं गृह्णाति /
2.5.1.m: If it is a Ṣoḍaśin rite, having drawn the Ukthya cup, he draws the Ṣoḍaśin cup from the Āgrayaṇa vessel with: "Indra verily the two bay horses carry..."

2.5.1.s: aṣoḍaśika ukthyaṃ gṛhītvātipāvya rājānaṃ prapīḍya pavitram̐ siddham ā sarpaṇāt /
2.5.1.d: अषोडशिक उक्थ्यं गृहीत्वातिपाव्य राजानं प्रपीड्य पवित्रम्̐ सिद्धम् आ सर्पणात् /
2.5.1.m: In a non-Ṣoḍaśin rite, having drawn the Ukthya cup, having clarified King [Soma], having squeezed the strainer, the procedure is established up to the creeping forward.

2.5.1.s: ṛjudehīyāḥ sarpanty ārbhavaṃ pavamānam̐ yena mādhyaṃdinam /
2.5.1.d: ऋजुदेहीयाः सर्पन्त्य् आर्भवं पवमानम्̐ येन माध्यंदिनम् /
2.5.1.m: The priests with upright bodies creep forward for the Ārbhava-pavamāna laud along the path by which [they crept for] the midday [laud].

2.5.1.s: vyākhyātam̐ saṃpāvanaṃ / tathopākaraṇaṃ pavamānasya /
2.5.1.d: व्याख्यातम्̐ संपावनं / तथोपाकरणं पवमानस्य /
2.5.1.m: The mutual purification has been explained; likewise the preparation for the Pavamāna laud.

2.5.1.s: saptahotāram̐ yajamāno japati purastād ārbhavasya pavamānasya \\ āyuṣe hiṅkuru \\ iti ca // sakhāsi jagacchandās \\ anu tvārabhe \ svasti mā saṃpāraya \\ iti ca /
2.5.1.d: सप्तहोतारम्̐ यजमानो जपति पुरस्ताद् आर्भवस्य पवमानस्य \\ आयुषे हिङ्कुरु \\ इति च // सखासि जगच्छन्दास् \\ अनु त्वारभे \ स्वस्ति मा संपारय \\ इति च /
2.5.1.m: Before the Ārbhava-pavamāna laud, the sacrificer murmurs the Saptahotṛ formula, and: "Sound hiṅ for long life!", and: "Thou art a friend, possessing the jagatī meter; / I touch thee from behind; / bring me safely across!"

2.5.1.s: stute \\ agnīd agnīn vihara \ barhiḥ stṛṇāhi \ puroḍāśāṃ alaṃkuru \ pratiprasthātaḥ paśum̐ sam̐vadasva \\ iti preṣyati /
2.5.1.d: स्तुते \\ अग्नीद् अग्नीन् विहर \ बर्हिः स्तृणाहि \ पुरोडाशां अलंकुरु \ प्रतिप्रस्थातः पशुम्̐ सम्̐वदस्व \\ इति प्रेष्यति /
2.5.1.m: When [the laud] has been chanted, he gives the direction: "Agnīdh, distribute the fires! Strew the sacrificial grass! Adorn the sacrificial cakes! Pratiprasthātṛ, converse [concerning the parts] of the animal!"

2.5.1.s: vyākhyātam̐ viharaṇam ulaparājī ca /
2.5.1.d: व्याख्यातम्̐ विहरणम् उलपराजी च /
2.5.1.m: The distribution [of fires] and the row of reed-grass have been explained.

2.5.1.s: vaiṣṇavyā pātrāṇi saṃmṛśya pratiprasthātā patnī ca pūtabhṛti pavitram̐ vitatya \\ āśīr nā ūrjam ity āśiram avanayataḥ /
2.5.1.d: वैष्णव्या पात्राणि संमृश्य प्रतिप्रस्थाता पत्नी च पूतभृति पवित्रम्̐ वितत्य \\ आशीर् ना ऊर्जम् इत्य् आशिरम् अवनयतः /
2.5.1.m: Having touched the vessels with [the verse] to Viṣṇu, the Pratiprasthātṛ and the [sacrificer's] wife, having spread the strainer over the Pūtabhṛt vat, pour in the milk mixture with: "Milk mixture is our vigor..."

2.5.1.s: apaśunā pracarati sam̐vādaprabhṛtīḍāntena /
2.5.1.d: अपशुना प्रचरति सम्̐वादप्रभृतीडान्तेन /
2.5.1.m: He performs the rite without an animal victim, beginning with the conversation and ending with the iḍā portion.

2.5.1.s: savanīyānām udvāsanaprabhṛti siddham ā saṃpraiṣāt //
2.5.1.d: सवनीयानाम् उद्वासनप्रभृति सिद्धम् आ संप्रैषात् //
2.5.1.m: For the cakes of the pressings, the procedure is established from the taking off the fire up to the direction.

2.5.1.s: tṛtīyasya savanasyendrāya puroḍāśānām iti vikṛtaḥ saṃpraiṣaḥ /
2.5.1.d: तृतीयस्य सवनस्येन्द्राय पुरोडाशानाम् इति विकृतः संप्रैषः /
2.5.1.m: The modified direction is: "... of the sacrificial cakes for Indra of the third pressing."

2.5.1.s: savanīyaiḥ pracarya \\ unnīyamānebhyo 'nubrūhi \\ ity anuvācayati /
2.5.1.d: सवनीयैः प्रचर्य \\ उन्नीयमानेभ्यो ऽनुब्रूहि \\ इत्य् अनुवाचयति /
2.5.1.m: Having performed the rite with the pressings' cakes, he causes [the hotṛ] to recite the invitatory verse: "Recite for [the cups] being filled!"

2.5.1.s: sāchāvākacamasān unnayati /
2.5.1.d: साछावाकचमसान् उन्नयति /
2.5.1.m: He fills the cups including that of the Achāvāka.

2.5.1.s: siddham ā saṃpraiṣāt //
2.5.1.d: सिद्धम् आ संप्रैषात् //

2.5.1.s: tṛtīyasya savanasya ṛbhumato vibhumato vājavato bṛhaspativato viśvadevvyāvatas tīvraṃ āśīrvata indrāya somān prasthitān preṣya \\ iti siddham̐ yathā mādhyaṃdine //
2.5.1.d: तृतीयस्य सवनस्य ऋभुमतो विभुमतो वाजवतो बृहस्पतिवतो विश्वदेव्व्यावतस् तीव्रं आशीर्वत इन्द्राय सोमान् प्रस्थितान् प्रेष्य \\ इति सिद्धम्̐ यथा माध्यंदिने //
2.5.1.m: "To Indra, accompanied by the Ṛbhus, accompanied by Vibhvan, accompanied by Vāja, accompanied by Bṛhaspati, accompanied by all the gods, summon for the set-forth strong Soma-draughts accompanied by milk mixture of the third pressing!"—thus it is established as at the midday pressing.

2.5.1.s: ādityavadgaṇasya soma deva te matividas tṛtīyasya savanasya jagacchandaso 'gnihuta indrapītasya \\ iti vikṛto bhakṣamantraḥ /
2.5.1.d: आदित्यवद्गणस्य सोम देव ते मतिविदस् तृतीयस्य सवनस्य जगच्छन्दसो ऽग्निहुत इन्द्रपीतस्य \\ इति विकृतो भक्षमन्त्रः /
2.5.1.m: The modified formula for consuming is: "Of thee, divine Soma, who hast the Ādityas as troop, who knowest the thought, of the third pressing, possessing the jagatī meter, offered into the fire, drunk by Indra..."

2.5.1.s: siddham ā sādanāt /
2.5.1.d: सिद्धम् आ सादनात् /

2.5.1.s: [ dakṣiṇasya havirdhānasya paścān ] mārjālīyadeśe prācīnāvavītinaḥ puroḍāśapiṇḍān aṇumiśrān atra pitaro mādayadhvam̐ yathābhāgam āvṛṣāyadhvam iti paścāt praticamasaṃ trīm̐strīn piṇḍān upāsyanti svam̐svaṃ camasam̐ hotṛcamasam adhvaryavaḥ /
2.5.1.d: [ दक्षिणस्य हविर्धानस्य पश्चान् ] मार्जालीयदेशे प्राचीनाववीतिनः पुरोडाशपिण्डान् अणुमिश्रान् अत्र पितरो मादयध्वम्̐ यथाभागम् आवृषायध्वम् इति पश्चात् प्रतिचमसं त्रीम्̐स्त्रीन् पिण्डान् उपास्यन्ति स्वम्̐स्वं चमसम्̐ होतृचमसम् अध्वर्यवः /
2.5.1.m: [Behind the southern Soma-cart], in the place of the Mārjālīya fire, wearing the sacred thread over the right shoulder, behind each cup the adhvaryus throw down three balls of sacrificial cake mixed with small grains, for their respective cups, and for the hotṛ's cup, with: "Here, O fathers, rejoice; according to your portions, become exhilarated!"

2.5.1.s: visram̐sya prācīnāvavītāni yathāsthānaṃ camasān sādayanti /
2.5.1.d: विस्रम्̐स्य प्राचीनाववीतानि यथास्थानं चमसान् सादयन्ति /
2.5.1.m: Having rearranged the sacred thread [over the left shoulder], they place the cups in their respective positions.

2.5.1.s: āgnīdhre savanīyān bhakṣayanti / tad vyākhyātam /
2.5.1.d: आग्नीध्रे सवनीयान् भक्षयन्ति / तद् व्याख्यातम् /
2.5.1.m: In the Āgnīdhra fire chamber, they consume the pressings' offerings; that has been explained.

2.5.1.s: antaryāmapātre sāvitram āgrayaṇād adabdhebhiḥ savitar iti gṛhṇāti /
2.5.1.d: अन्तर्यामपात्रे सावित्रम् आग्रयणाद् अदब्धेभिः सवितर् इति गृह्णाति /
2.5.1.m: In the Antaryāma cup, he draws the Sāvitra cup from the Āgrayaṇa vessel with: "With undefiled [protections], O Savitṛ..."
