2.5.1.s: asanno hūyate //
2.5.1.d: असन्नो हूयते //

2.5.1.s: devāya savitre 'nubrūhi \\ ity anuvācayati /
2.5.1.d: देवाय सवित्रे ऽनुब्रूहि \\ इत्य् अनुवाचयति /
2.5.1.m: He causes [the hotṛ] to recite the invitatory verse: "Recite for the god Savitṛ!"

2.5.1.s: āśrāvya devāya savitre preṣya \\ iti pracarati /
2.5.1.d: आश्राव्य देवाय सवित्रे प्रेष्य \\ इति प्रचरति /
2.5.1.m: Having called for the śrauṣaṭ, he proceeds with the direction: "Summon for the god Savitṛ!"

2.5.1.s: vaṣaṭkṛte na sarvaṃ juhoti /
2.5.1.d: वषट्कृते न सर्वं जुहोति /
2.5.1.m: When the vaṣaṭ-call is uttered, he does not offer all of it.

2.5.1.s: sāvitrasam̐srave pūtabhṛto vaiśvadevaṃ gṛhṇāti //
2.5.1.d: सावित्रसम्̐स्रवे पूतभृतो वैश्वदेवं गृह्णाति //
2.5.1.m: Into the residue of the Sāvitra cup, he draws the Vaiśvadeva cup from the Pūtabhṛt vat.

2.5.1.s: upayāmagṛhīto 'si \ suśarmāsi supratiṣṭhānas \\ iti gṛhṇāti \\ eṣa te yonir \ viśvebhyas tvā devebhyas iti sādayati /
2.5.1.d: उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \ सुशर्मासि सुप्रतिष्ठानस् \\ इति गृह्णाति \\ एष ते योनिर् \ विश्वेभ्यस् त्वा देवेभ्यस् इति सादयति /
2.5.1.m: With: "Thou art taken with a support; thou art providing good shelter, well founded...", he draws it. With: "This is thy womb; for the All-gods thee!", he places it.

2.5.1.s: vaiśvadevaṃ pratigṛṇāti //
2.5.1.d: वैश्वदेवं प्रतिगृणाति //
2.5.1.m: He responds to the Vaiśvadeva recitation.

2.5.1.s: ekayā ca daśabhiś ca \\ ity ucyamāne pratiprasthātā dvidevatyapātrāṇi prakṣālya khare sādayati //
2.5.1.d: एकया च दशभिश् च \\ इत्य् उच्यमाने प्रतिप्रस्थाता द्विदेवत्यपात्राणि प्रक्षाल्य खरे सादयति //
2.5.1.m: While: "With one and with ten..." is being recited, the Pratiprasthātṛ, having washed the cups for the twin deities, places them on the mound.

2.5.1.s: pra dyāvā yajñaiḥ pṛthivī ṛtāvṛdhā \\ iti dyāvāpṛthivīyaṃ tasmin madā modaiva \ modā modaiva \\ iti madvān pratigaraḥ /
2.5.1.d: प्र द्यावा यज्ञैः पृथिवी ऋतावृधा \\ इति द्यावापृथिवीयं तस्मिन् मदा मोदैव \ मोदा मोदैव \\ इति मद्वान् प्रतिगरः /
2.5.1.m: To [the verse] to Heaven and Earth: "Forward, Heaven and Earth, with sacrifices, increasers of order...", the response containing the word mada is: "Joy, joy indeed! Exhilaration, exhilaration indeed!"

2.5.1.s: kṛtākṛtaḥ surūpakṛtnum ūtaye \\ itiprabhṛti samāpadyate pratigaraḥ /
2.5.1.d: कृताकृतः सुरूपकृत्नुम् ऊतये \\ इतिप्रभृति समापद्यते प्रतिगरः /
2.5.1.m: The response ends with [the verses] beginning with: "To him who makes fair forms for aid...", whether [certain verses are] recited or not.

2.5.1.s: samāpte śastre grahādānaprabhṛti samānam aindrāgnenā bhakṣaṇāt //
2.5.1.d: समाप्ते शस्त्रे ग्रहादानप्रभृति समानम् ऐन्द्राग्नेना भक्षणात् //
2.5.1.m: When the recitation is finished, the procedure from taking the cup up to consuming is the same as for the cup to Indra and Agni.

2.5.1.s: narāśam̐sīpītasya soma deva te matividas tṛtīyasya savanasya jagacchandasaḥ pitṛpītasya \\ iti vikṛto bhakṣamantraḥ /
2.5.1.d: नराशम्̐सीपीतस्य सोम देव ते मतिविदस् तृतीयस्य सवनस्य जगच्छन्दसः पितृपीतस्य \\ इति विकृतो भक्षमन्त्रः /
2.5.1.m: The modified formula for consuming is: "Of thee, divine Soma, who hast been drunk by the Narāśaṃsa, who knowest the thought, of the third pressing, possessing the jagatī meter, drunk by the fathers..."

2.5.1.s: siddham ā sādanāt /
2.5.1.d: सिद्धम् आ सादनात् /

2.5.2.s: abhyudāharati saumyam /
2.5.2.d: अभ्युदाहरति सौम्यम् /
2.5.2.m: He brings forward the boiled rice oblation for Soma.

2.5.2.s: ājyasyāvadāyāpareṇa srugdaṇḍān dakṣiṇātikramya dakṣiṇaṃ paridhisaṃdhiṃ pratyavasthāyāśrāvya ghṛtasya yaja \\ iti preṣyati / dakṣiṇārdhe juhoti /
2.5.2.d: आज्यस्यावदायापरेण स्रुग्दण्डान् दक्षिणातिक्रम्य दक्षिणं परिधिसंधिं प्रत्यवस्थायाश्राव्य घृतस्य यज \\ इति प्रेष्यति / दक्षिणार्धे जुहोति /
2.5.2.m: Having portioned out the clarified butter, having stepped past southwards behind the handles of the ladles, having stationed himself facing the southern junction of the enclosing sticks, having called for the śrauṣaṭ, he gives the direction: "Recite the offering verse for the clarified butter!" He offers on the southern half [of the fire].

2.5.2.s: ata eva tiṣṭhan prācīnāvavītī saumyasyāvadāyodaṅṅ atikramyottaraṃ paridhisaṃdhiṃ pratyavasthāyāśrāvya saumyasya yaja \\ iti preṣyati / dakṣiṇā tiṣṭhan madhye juhoti /
2.5.2.d: अत एव तिष्ठन् प्राचीनाववीती सौम्यस्यावदायोदङ्ङ् अतिक्रम्योत्तरं परिधिसंधिं प्रत्यवस्थायाश्राव्य सौम्यस्य यज \\ इति प्रेष्यति / दक्षिणा तिष्ठन् मध्ये जुहोति /
2.5.2.m: Standing right there, wearing the sacred thread over the right shoulder, having portioned out the boiled rice oblation for Soma, having stepped past northwards, having stationed himself facing the northern junction of the enclosing sticks, having called for the śrauṣaṭ, he gives the direction: "Recite the offering verse for the boiled rice oblation for Soma!" Standing facing south, he offers into the middle [of the fire].

2.5.2.s: pratiparikramya visram̐sya prācīnāvavītam ājyasyāvadāyodaṅṅ atikramyottaraṃ praidhisaṃdhiṃ pratyavasthāyāśrāvya ghṛtasya yaja \\ iti preṣyaty uttarārdhe juhoti /
2.5.2.d: प्रतिपरिक्रम्य विस्रम्̐स्य प्राचीनाववीतम् आज्यस्यावदायोदङ्ङ् अतिक्रम्योत्तरं प्रैधिसंधिं प्रत्यवस्थायाश्राव्य घृतस्य यज \\ इति प्रेष्यत्य् उत्तरार्धे जुहोति /
2.5.2.m: Having walked back around, having untied [the garment] worn over the right shoulder, having taken portions of clarified butter, having stepped across toward the north, having stationed himself facing the northern junction of the enclosing sticks, and having called for the śraushat, he gives the prompt: 'Recite the offering verse for the clarified butter'; he offers into the northern half [of the fire].

2.5.2.s: vyuduhya saumyam ājyasyābhipūrayati //
2.5.2.d: व्युदुह्य सौम्यम् आज्यस्याभिपूरयति //
2.5.2.m: Having pushed the Saumya [caru] aside, he fills it with clarified butter.

2.5.2.s: satrā ta etad yad u ta iha \\ iti yajamāno 'vekṣate /
2.5.2.d: सत्रा त एतद् यद् उ त इह \\ इति यजमानो ऽवेक्षते /
2.5.2.m: The sacrificer gazes at it with the mantra: 'Truly yours is this, and what is yours here...'

2.5.2.s: yadi na paripaśyed yan me mano yamaṃ gatam iti japet /
2.5.2.d: यदि न परिपश्येद् यन् मे मनो यमं गतम् इति जपेत् /
2.5.2.m: If he does not see [his reflection], he should whisper: 'Whatever mind of mine has gone to Yama...'

2.5.2.s: avekṣyodgātṛbhyaḥ prayachati /
2.5.2.d: अवेक्ष्योद्गातृभ्यः प्रयछति /
2.5.2.m: Having gazed at it, he hands it to the udgātṛ priests.

2.5.2.s: darbhamuṣṭīn aṣṭau śalākodgāḍhān kṛtvā pracaraṇyām aṣṭagṛhītenādhyadhi dhiṣṇyāñ jvalato dhriyamāṇān pratyaṅṅ āsīna upasthānair vyāghārayati /
2.5.2.d: दर्भमुष्टीन् अष्टौ शलाकोद्गाढान् कृत्वा प्रचरण्याम् अष्टगृहीतेनाध्यधि धिष्ण्याञ् ज्वलतो ध्रियमाणान् प्रत्यङ्ङ् आसीन उपस्थानैर् व्याघारयति /
2.5.2.m: Having made eight handfuls of darbha grass tied tightly with splints, seated facing west, he sprinkles [clarified butter] over the blazing dhiṣṇya hearths that are being maintained, with eight ladlings [of butter] in the pracaraṇī ladle, with the upasthāna formulas.

2.5.2.s: upām̐śupātre pātnīvatam āgrāyaṇād upayāmagṛhīto 'si \ bṛhaspatisutasya te \\ iti gṛhṇāti /
2.5.2.d: उपाम्̐शुपात्रे पात्नीवतम् आग्रायणाद् उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \ बृहस्पतिसुतस्य ते \\ इति गृह्णाति /
2.5.2.m: Into the upāṃśupātra vessel he draws the pātnīvata cup from the āgrāyaṇa vessel with: 'You are taken with a support; of you, pressed for Bṛhaspati...'

2.5.2.s: asanno hūyate //
2.5.2.d: असन्नो हूयते //

2.5.2.s: agnā3 patnīvān iti dhiṣṇyavyāghāraṇasaṃpātena śrīṇāti /
2.5.2.d: अग्ना3 पत्नीवान् इति धिष्ण्यव्याघारणसंपातेन श्रीणाति /
2.5.2.m: With the formula: 'O Agni, possessing a wife...', he mixes it with the residue from the sprinkling of the dhiṣṇya hearths.

2.5.2.s: āśrāvya \\ agnīt pātnīvatasya yaja \\ iti preṣyati /
2.5.2.d: आश्राव्य \\ अग्नीत् पात्नीवतस्य यज \\ इति प्रेष्यति /
2.5.2.m: Having called for the śraushat, he gives the prompt: 'O Āgnīdhra, recite the offering verse for the pātnīvata cup.'

2.5.2.s: vaṣaṭkṛte na sarvaṃ juhoti /
2.5.2.d: वषट्कृते न सर्वं जुहोति /
2.5.2.m: When the vaṣaṭ has been uttered, he does not offer all of it.

2.5.2.s: bhakṣam āgnīdhrāya prayachati /
2.5.2.d: भक्षम् आग्नीध्राय प्रयछति /
2.5.2.m: He hands the portion to be consumed to the āgnīdhra priest.

2.5.2.s: neṣṭur upastham āruhyodaṅṅ avasṛpya paścān neṣṭrīyasya vāg devī somasya pibatu \\ iti bhakṣayati /
2.5.2.d: नेष्टुर् उपस्थम् आरुह्योदङ्ङ् अवसृप्य पश्चान् नेष्ट्रीयस्य वाग् देवी सोमस्य पिबतु \\ इति भक्षयति /
2.5.2.m: Having mounted the lap of the neṣṭṛ priest, having crept away to the north, behind the neṣṭrīya hearth, he consumes it with: 'May the goddess Vāc drink of the soma.'

2.5.2.s: hotṛcamasamukhyā agniṣṭomacamasās teṣu sarvam unnayaty agniṣṭome /
2.5.2.d: होतृचमसमुख्या अग्निष्टोमचमसास् तेषु सर्वम् उन्नयत्य् अग्निष्टोमे /
2.5.2.m: The Agniṣṭoma drinking cups have the Hotṛ's cup as the primary one; he draws out all of it into them in the Agniṣṭoma sacrifice.

2.5.2.s: atiśam̐syād ukthye /
2.5.2.d: अतिशम्̐स्याद् उक्थ्ये /

2.5.2.s: hotṛcamase dhrauvasyāvakāśaṃ kṛtvāgniṣṭomastotram upākaroti / tasya purastāt saptahotāram̐ yajamāno japati /
2.5.2.d: होतृचमसे ध्रौवस्यावकाशं कृत्वाग्निष्टोमस्तोत्रम् उपाकरोति / तस्य पुरस्तात् सप्तहोतारम्̐ यजमानो जपति /
2.5.2.m: Having made room for the dhruva cup's portion in the Hotṛ's cup, he introduces the Agniṣṭoma stotra; before that, the sacrificer whispers the saptahotṛ formula.

2.5.2.s: ākarṇaprāvṛtāḥ stūyamāne sadasy āsīran /
2.5.2.d: आकर्णप्रावृताः स्तूयमाने सदस्य् आसीरन् /
2.5.2.m: Covered up to their ears, they should sit in the sadas while the praise song is being sung.

2.5.2.s: prastute patnī pānnejanaṃ kalaśam antarata ūruṇā dakṣiṇena samudraṃ gandharveṣṭhām ity udañcaṃ pravartayati /
2.5.2.d: प्रस्तुते पत्नी पान्नेजनं कलशम् अन्तरत ऊरुणा दक्षिणेन समुद्रं गन्धर्वेष्ठाम् इत्य् उदञ्चं प्रवर्तयति /
2.5.2.m: When the prelude has been sung, the wife rolls the foot-washing jar inside with her right thigh toward the north with: 'The ocean standing among the gandharvas...'

2.5.2.s: neṣṭā patnīm udgātrā tisṛṣu stotriyāsūdgīthaṃ prati prāk pratihārād vāmī te saṃdṛśi \\ iti triḥ samīkṣayati /
2.5.2.d: नेष्टा पत्नीम् उद्गात्रा तिसृषु स्तोत्रियासूद्गीथं प्रति प्राक् प्रतिहाराद् वामी ते संदृशि \\ इति त्रिः समीक्षयति /
2.5.2.m: The neṣṭṛ makes the wife look at the udgātṛ priest three times during the three stotra verses toward the udgītha before the pratihāra, with: 'Beautiful are they in your sight...'

2.5.2.s: abhyagram āgnimārutaṃ pratigṛṇāti / viyatam āpohiṣṭhīyaṃ / tasmin hotāram anvārabhante //
2.5.2.d: अभ्यग्रम् आग्निमारुतं प्रतिगृणाति / वियतम् आपोहिष्ठीयं / तस्मिन् होतारम् अन्वारभन्ते //
2.5.2.m: He responds to the beginning of the Āgnimāruta recitation; the āpohiṣṭhīya verses are recited separated; during it, they touch the hotṛ priest from behind.

2.5.2.s: svāduṣ kilāyam itiprabhṛti svāduṣkilīyaṃ / tasmin madvat pratigṛṇāti //
2.5.2.d: स्वादुष् किलायम् इतिप्रभृति स्वादुष्किलीयं / तस्मिन् मद्वत् प्रतिगृणाति //
2.5.2.m: The svāduṣkilīya hymn begins with: 'Sweet indeed is this...'; during it, he responds with the madvat formula.

2.5.2.s: yayor ojasā skabhitā rajām̐si \\ itiprabhṛti samāpadyate pratigaraḥ //
2.5.2.d: ययोर् ओजसा स्कभिता रजाम्̐सि \\ इतिप्रभृति समापद्यते प्रतिगरः //
2.5.2.m: Beginning with: 'By whose power the spaces were propped up...', the response is concluded.

2.5.2.s: evā na indro maghavā virapśī \\ iti paridhānīyā / tasyāḥ punarukte 'rdharce pratiprasthātā pratyaṅmukha ūrdhvas tiṣṭhann anvārabdhe yajamāne vācayan dhruvaṃ dhruveṇa \\ iti hotṛcamase dhruvam avanayati svayaṃbhūr asi śreṣṭho raśmir iti ca \\ evam aham̐ viśvadarśato bhūyāsam ityantena /
2.5.2.d: एवा न इन्द्रो मघवा विरप्शी \\ इति परिधानीया / तस्याः पुनरुक्ते ऽर्धर्चे प्रतिप्रस्थाता प्रत्यङ्मुख ऊर्ध्वस् तिष्ठन्न् अन्वारब्धे यजमाने वाचयन् ध्रुवं ध्रुवेण \\ इति होतृचमसे ध्रुवम् अवनयति स्वयंभूर् असि श्रेष्ठो रश्मिर् इति च \\ एवम् अहम्̐ विश्वदर्शतो भूयासम् इत्यन्तेन /
2.5.2.m: The concluding verse is: 'Thus may Indra, bounteous, exuberant...'; at its repeated half-verse, the pratiprasthātṛ priest, standing upright facing west, while the sacrificer holds onto him from behind and while making him recite: 'Firm with the firm...', pours down the dhruva soma into the Hotṛ's cup with: 'You are self-existent, the best ray...', ending with: '...thus may I become visible to all.'

2.5.2.s: uttamam̐ śastramṃ pratigīrya \\ uktham̐ vācīndrāya \\ iti brūyāt /
2.5.2.d: उत्तमम्̐ शस्त्रम्ं प्रतिगीर्य \\ उक्थम्̐ वाचीन्द्राय \\ इति ब्रूयात् /
2.5.2.m: Having responded to the last recitation, he should say: 'The recitation has been spoken for Indra.'

2.5.2.s: hotṛcamasam ādatte 'dhvaryuś camasādhvaryavaś camasān /
2.5.2.d: होतृचमसम् आदत्ते ऽध्वर्युश् चमसाध्वर्यवश् चमसान् /
2.5.2.m: The adhvaryu priest takes up the Hotṛ's cup, and the cup-adhvaryus take up their cups.

2.5.2.s: āśrāvya \\ ukthaśā yaja somānām iti preṣyati /
2.5.2.d: आश्राव्य \\ उक्थशा यज सोमानाम् इति प्रेष्यति /
2.5.2.m: Having called for the śraushat, he gives the prompt: 'O reciter of the uktha, recite the offering verse of the somas.'

2.5.2.s: vaṣaṭkṛtānuvaṣaṭkṛte juhoti camasādhvaryavaś ca /
2.5.2.d: वषट्कृतानुवषट्कृते जुहोति चमसाध्वर्यवश् च /
2.5.2.m: At the vaṣaṭ and the second vaṣaṭ, he offers, and the cup-adhvaryus also offer.

2.5.2.s: evam ata ūrdhvaṃ praiṣaḥ somānām̐ homaś ca //
2.5.2.d: एवम् अत ऊर्ध्वं प्रैषः सोमानाम्̐ होमश् च //
2.5.2.m: Such is the prompt and the offering of the somas from here onward.

2.5.2.s: vāg devī somasya pibatu \\ iti sarvabhakṣān bhakṣayanti /
2.5.2.d: वाग् देवी सोमस्य पिबतु \\ इति सर्वभक्षान् भक्षयन्ति /
2.5.2.m: With: 'May the goddess Vāc drink of the soma', they consume all the consumption portions.

2.5.2.s: mārjālīye prakṣālya cātvālānte sādayanty agniṣṭome / pūtabhṛto 'nte yady ukthyaḥ /
2.5.2.d: मार्जालीये प्रक्षाल्य चात्वालान्ते सादयन्त्य् अग्निष्टोमे / पूतभृतो ऽन्ते यद्य् उक्थ्यः /
2.5.2.m: Having rinsed [the cups] at the mārjālīya hearth, they set them down at the edge of the cātvāla trench in the Agniṣṭoma; at the edge of the pūtabhṛt vessel if it is an Ukthya.

2.5.3.s: yady ukthya ukthyo vigṛhyate \\ upayāmagṛhīto 'si \\ indrāvaruṇābhyāṃ tvā \\ iti prathamam upayāmagṛhīto 'si \\ indrābṛhaspatibhyāṃ tvā \\ iti dvitīyam upayāmagṛhīto 'si \\ indrāviṣṇubhyāṃ tvā \\ iti tṛtīyam /
2.5.3.d: यद्य् उक्थ्य उक्थ्यो विगृह्यते \\ उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \\ इन्द्रावरुणाभ्यां त्वा \\ इति प्रथमम् उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \\ इन्द्राबृहस्पतिभ्यां त्वा \\ इति द्वितीयम् उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \\ इन्द्राविष्णुभ्यां त्वा \\ इति तृतीयम् /
2.5.3.m: If it is an Ukthya, the Ukthya cup is drawn separately: the first with 'You are taken with a support; for Indra and Varuṇa, you...', the second with 'You are taken with a support; for Indra and Bṛhaspati, you...', the third with 'You are taken with a support; for Indra and Viṣṇu, you...'

2.5.3.d: समानम् अन्यत् /
सर्वम् उन्नयत्य् उक्थ्ये /
2.5.3.m: He draws out all of it in the Ukthya.

2.5.3.d: अतिशम्̐स्यात् षोडशिनि /
षोडशिचमसेषु सर्वम् उन्नयति /
2.5.3.m: He draws out all of it into the Ṣoḍaśin cups.

2.5.3.d: अतिशम्̐स्याद् अतिरात्रे /

2.5.3.s: samayādhyuṣite sūrye darbhābhyām̐ hiraṇyena ca \\ aindram̐ saho 'sarji \\ upāvartadhvam \ abhisarpa yajamāna \\ iti ṣoḍaśini stotram upākaroti /
2.5.3.d: समयाध्युषिते सूर्ये दर्भाभ्याम्̐ हिरण्येन च \\ ऐन्द्रम्̐ सहो ऽसर्जि \\ उपावर्तध्वम् \ अभिसर्प यजमान \\ इति षोडशिनि स्तोत्रम् उपाकरोति /
2.5.3.m: When the sun has just set, with two blades of darbha grass and gold, he introduces the stotra in the Ṣoḍaśin with: 'Indra's power has been released; turn toward it; creep forward, O sacrificer.'

2.5.3.d: प्रोथन्न् अश्वः श्याव उपतिष्ठते /
2.5.3.m: A snorting dark-brown horse stands near.

2.5.3.d: स्तोत्रापवर्ग उद्गात्रे ऽश्वतरीं ददाति /
2.5.3.m: At the conclusion of the stotra, he gives a she-mule to the udgātṛ priest.

2.5.3.d: शिक्ष्यः प्रतिगरस् तार्तीयसवनिकः /
2.5.3.m: The response belonging to the third pressing is to be learned.

2.5.3.s: ata ūrdhvaṃ bhakṣamantras \\ anuṣṭupchanadaso 'gnihuta indraharivatpītasya \\ iti vikṛtaḥ ṣoḍaśini /
2.5.3.d: अत ऊर्ध्वं भक्षमन्त्रस् \\ अनुष्टुप्छनदसो ऽग्निहुत इन्द्रहरिवत्पीतस्य \\ इति विकृतः षोडशिनि /
2.5.3.m: From here onward, the consumption formula is modified in the Ṣoḍaśin as: '...having the anuṣṭubh meter, offered in Agni, drunk by Indra possessing bay steeds...'

2.5.3.s: yady aṣoḍaśiko 'tirātra ukthyaiḥ pracaryāstamite rātriparyāyeṇa pracarati /
2.5.3.d: यद्य् अषोडशिको ऽतिरात्र उक्थ्यैः प्रचर्यास्तमिते रात्रिपर्यायेण प्रचरति /
2.5.3.m: If the Atirātra is without the Ṣoḍaśin, having performed [the rites] with the Ukthya cups, when the sun has set, he proceeds with the nocturnal round.

2.5.3.s: catvāraś camasagaṇāḥ stutaśastravantaḥ / teṣām̐ hotuḥ prathamas tato maitrāvaruṇasya brāhmaṇācham̐sino 'chāvākasya ca //
2.5.3.d: चत्वारश् चमसगणाः स्तुतशस्त्रवन्तः / तेषाम्̐ होतुः प्रथमस् ततो मैत्रावरुणस्य ब्राह्मणाछम्̐सिनो ऽछावाकस्य च //
2.5.3.m: There are four sets of cups accompanied by stotras and śastras; of them, the first belongs to the Hotṛ, then that of the Maitrāvaruṇa, of the Brāhmaṇācchaṃsin, and of the Acchāvāka.

2.5.3.s: upayāmagṛhīto 'si \\ indrāya tvābhiśarvarāya juṣṭaṃ gṛhṇāmi \\ iti mukhyaṃmukhyaṃ camasam unnayati //
2.5.3.d: उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \\ इन्द्राय त्वाभिशर्वराय जुष्टं गृह्णामि \\ इति मुख्यंमुख्यं चमसम् उन्नयति //
2.5.3.m: With: 'You are taken with a support; I take you pleasing to Indra, the night-dweller', he draws each primary cup.

2.5.3.d: अनुष्टुप्छन्दसो ऽग्निहुत इन्द्राभिशर्वरपीतस्य \\ इति विकृतो भक्षमन्त्रः /
2.5.3.m: The consumption formula is modified as: '...having the anuṣṭubh meter, offered in Agni, drunk by Indra, the night-dweller...'

2.5.3.s: evaṃ dvitīyaḥ paryāyo niśāyāṃ mahārātre tṛtīyaḥ /
2.5.3.d: एवं द्वितीयः पर्यायो निशायां महारात्रे तृतीयः /
2.5.3.m: Thus the second round is [performed] at night, and the third in the dead of night.

2.5.3.s: hotṛcamasamukhyāḥ saṃdhicamasās teṣu sarvam unnayaty atirātre /
2.5.3.d: होतृचमसमुख्याः संधिचमसास् तेषु सर्वम् उन्नयत्य् अतिरात्रे /
2.5.3.m: The twilight cups have the Hotṛ's cup as primary; he draws out all of it into them in the Atirātra.

2.5.3.d: अतिशम्̐स्याद् अप्तोर्याम्णि /
2.5.3.m: Except for what is to be recited over in the Aptoryāma.

2.5.3.s: upākṛte stotre pratiprasthātāśvinaṃ dvikapālaṃ tūṣṇīm upacaritam̐ sam̐skaroti /
2.5.3.d: उपाकृते स्तोत्रे प्रतिप्रस्थाताश्विनं द्विकपालं तूष्णीम् उपचरितम्̐ सम्̐स्करोति /
2.5.3.m: When the stotra has been introduced, the pratiprasthātṛ priest prepares the Āśvina cake on two potsherds, treated silently.

2.5.3.s: mahadāśvinaṃ pratigṛṇāti / param̐ sahasrāc cham̐saty ākramaṇād udite sauryāṇi /
2.5.3.d: महदाश्विनं प्रतिगृणाति / परम्̐ सहस्राच् छम्̐सत्य् आक्रमणाद् उदिते सौर्याणि /
2.5.3.m: He responds to the Great Āśvina recitation; he recites beyond a thousand [verses] until the stepping forward; when the sun has risen, [he recites] the solar verses.

2.5.3.s: samāpte śastre pratiprasthātāśvinam̐ sakṛt sarvam avadyati /
2.5.3.d: समाप्ते शस्त्रे प्रतिप्रस्थाताश्विनम्̐ सकृत् सर्वम् अवद्यति /
2.5.3.m: When the recitation is finished, the pratiprasthātṛ cuts off all of the Āśvina cake at once.

2.5.3.d: होतृचमसम् आदत्ते ऽध्वर्युश् चमसाध्वर्यवश् चमसान् //
2.5.3.m: The adhvaryu priest takes up the Hotṛ's cup, and the cup-adhvaryus take up their cups.

2.5.3.s: aśvibhyāṃ tiro'hnyānām̐ somānām anubrūhi \\ ity anuvācayati /
2.5.3.d: अश्विभ्यां तिरोऽह्न्यानाम्̐ सोमानाम् अनुब्रूहि \\ इत्य् अनुवाचयति /
2.5.3.m: He bids [the Hotṛ] recite the invitatory verse: 'Recite for the Aśvins for the somas left overnight.'

2.5.3.s: āśrāvya \\ aśvibhyāṃ tiro'hnyān somān prasthitān preṣya \\ iti pracarati /
2.5.3.d: आश्राव्य \\ अश्विभ्यां तिरोऽह्न्यान् सोमान् प्रस्थितान् प्रेष्य \\ इति प्रचरति /
2.5.3.m: Having called for the śraushat, he proceeds with the prompt: 'Prompt [the Hotṛ] for the Aśvins for the somas left overnight that have been set forth.'

2.5.3.d: पूर्वस्मिन् वषट्कारे प्रतिप्रस्थाताश्विनम्̐ सर्वहुतं करोति //
2.5.3.m: At the first vaṣaṭ-call, the pratiprasthātṛ makes the Āśvina cake offered wholly into the fire.

2.5.3.d: पङ्क्तिश् छन्दसो ऽग्निहुतो ऽश्विपीतस्य \\ इति विकृतो भक्षमन्त्रः /
2.5.3.m: The consumption formula is modified as: '...having the paṅkti meter, offered in Agni, drunk by the Aśvins...'

2.5.3.d: अप्तोर्यामा यथैको रात्रिपर्यायः /
2.5.3.m: The Aptoryāma is like a single night round.

2.5.3.d: तूष्णीं मुख्यान् उन्नयति //
2.5.3.m: He draws the primary cups silently.

2.5.3.s: atichandāś chandaso 'gnihutaḥ prajāpatipītasya \\ iti vikṛto bhakṣamantraḥ /
2.5.3.d: अतिछन्दाश् छन्दसो ऽग्निहुतः प्रजापतिपीतस्य \\ इति विकृतो भक्षमन्त्रः /
2.5.3.m: The consumption formula is modified as: '...having the atichandas meter, offered in Agni, drunk by Prajāpati...'

2.5.3.d: सम्̐स्थाचमसाम्̐श् चात्वालान्ते सादयन्ति /
2.5.3.m: They set down the concluding cups at the edge of the cātvāla trench.

2.5.4.s: ānuyājikīprabhṛti siddham ā srucām̐ vimocanāt /
2.5.4.d: आनुयाजिकीप्रभृति सिद्धम् आ स्रुचाम्̐ विमोचनात् /
2.5.4.m: ānuyājikīprabhṛti siddham ā srucām̐ vimocanāt

2.5.4.s: unnetā droṇakalaśe hāriyojanam āgrāyaṇād upayāmagṛhīto 'si \ harir asi hāriyojanas \\ iti sarvaṃ gṛhṇāti //
2.5.4.d: उन्नेता द्रोणकलशे हारियोजनम् आग्रायणाद् उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \ हरिर् असि हारियोजनस् \\ इति सर्वं गृह्णाति //
2.5.4.m: unnetā droṇakalaśe hāriyojanam āgrāyaṇād upayāmagṛhīto 'si \ harir asi hāriyojanas \\ iti sarvaṃ gṛhṇāti

2.5.4.s: haryor dhānā harivatīr iti dhānābhiḥ śrīṇāti /
2.5.4.d: हर्योर् धाना हरिवतीर् इति धानाभिः श्रीणाति /
2.5.4.m: haryor dhānā harivatīr iti dhānābhiḥ śrīṇāti

2.5.4.s: unnetā droṇakalaśam̐ śirasy avadhāya \\ indrāya harivate dhānāsomānām anubrūhi \\ ity anuvācayati /
2.5.4.d: उन्नेता द्रोणकलशम्̐ शिरस्य् अवधाय \\ इन्द्राय हरिवते धानासोमानाम् अनुब्रूहि \\ इत्य् अनुवाचयति /
2.5.4.m: unnetā droṇakalaśam̐ śirasy avadhāya \\ indrāya harivate dhānāsomānām anubrūhi \\ ity anuvācayati

2.5.4.s: āśrāvya \\ indrāya harivate dhānāsomān prasthitān preṣya \\ iti vikaṭībhūya pracarati /
2.5.4.d: आश्राव्य \\ इन्द्राय हरिवते धानासोमान् प्रस्थितान् प्रेष्य \\ इति विकटीभूय प्रचरति /
2.5.4.m: āśrāvya \\ indrāya harivate dhānāsomān prasthitān preṣya \\ iti vikaṭībhūya pracarati

2.5.4.s: vaṣaṭkṛtānuvaṣaṭkṛte juhoti /
2.5.4.d: वषट्कृतानुवषट्कृते जुहोति /
2.5.4.m: vaṣaṭkṛtānuvaṣaṭkṛte juhoti

2.5.4.s: vyunmarśam̐ hāriyojanam̐ sarve bhakṣayantaś cuścūṣākāraṃ dhānāḥ saṃdaśya rayyai tvā \ poṣāya tvā \\ ity uttaravedyām upavapanti //
2.5.4.d: व्युन्मर्शम्̐ हारियोजनम्̐ सर्वे भक्षयन्तश् चुश्चूषाकारं धानाः संदश्य रय्यै त्वा \ पोषाय त्वा \\ इत्य् उत्तरवेद्याम् उपवपन्ति //
2.5.4.m: vyunmarśam̐ hāriyojanam̐ sarve bhakṣayantaś cuścūṣākāraṃ dhānāḥ saṃdaśya rayyai tvā \ poṣāya tvā \\ ity uttaravedyām upavapanti

2.5.4.s: devakṛtasyainaso 'vayajanam asi \ pitṛkṛtasyainaso 'vayajanam asi \ manuṣyakṛtasyainaso 'vayajanam asi \\ ātmakṛtasyainaso 'vayajanam asi \\ anyakṛtasyainaso 'vayajanam asi \\ enasaenaso 'vayajanam asi svāhā \\ ity āhavanīye ṣaṭṣaḍ yūpaśakalāny abhyādadhate /
2.5.4.d: देवकृतस्यैनसो ऽवयजनम् असि \ पितृकृतस्यैनसो ऽवयजनम् असि \ मनुष्यकृतस्यैनसो ऽवयजनम् असि \\ आत्मकृतस्यैनसो ऽवयजनम् असि \\ अन्यकृतस्यैनसो ऽवयजनम् असि \\ एनसएनसो ऽवयजनम् असि स्वाहा \\ इत्य् आहवनीये षट्षड् यूपशकलान्य् अभ्यादधते /
2.5.4.m: devakṛtasyainaso 'vayajanam asi \ pitṛkṛtasyainaso 'vayajanam asi \ manuṣyakṛtasyainaso 'vayajanam asi \\ ātmakṛtasyainaso 'vayajanam asi \\ anyakṛtasyainaso 'vayajanam asi \\ enasaenaso 'vayajanam asi svāhā \\ ity āhavanīye ṣaṭṣaḍ yūpaśakalāny abhyādadhate

2.5.4.s:
yad vo devāś cakṛma jihvayā guru \ manaso vā prayutī devaheḍanam /
arāvā yo no abhi duchunāyate \ tasmim̐s tad eno vasavo nidhetana //
ity āhavanīyam upatiṣṭhante /
2.5.4.d:
यद् वो देवाश् चकृम जिह्वया गुरु \ मनसो वा प्रयुती देवहेडनम् /
अरावा यो नो अभि दुछुनायते \ तस्मिम्̐स् तद् एनो वसवो निधेतन //
इत्य् आहवनीयम् उपतिष्ठन्ते /
2.5.4.m:
yad vo devāś cakṛma jihvayā guru \ manaso vā prayutī devaheḍanam

arāvā yo no abhi duchunāyate \ tasmim̐s tad eno vasavo nidhetana

ity āhavanīyam upatiṣṭhante

2.5.4.s: dūrvāś camaseṣu saṃplavaṃplāvam apsu dhautasya te deva soma \\ ity avaghreṇa bhakṣayanti //
2.5.4.d: दूर्वाश् चमसेषु संप्लवंप्लावम् अप्सु धौतस्य ते देव सोम \\ इत्य् अवघ्रेण भक्षयन्ति //
2.5.4.m: dūrvāś camaseṣu saṃplavaṃplāvam apsu dhautasya te deva soma \\ ity avaghreṇa bhakṣayanti

2.5.4.s: svadhā pitre \ svadhā pitāmahāya \ svadhā prapitāmahāya \\ iti barhiṣy adhi cātvālaṃ prati camasaṃ ninayanti //
2.5.4.d: स्वधा पित्रे \ स्वधा पितामहाय \ स्वधा प्रपितामहाय \\ इति बर्हिष्य् अधि चात्वालं प्रति चमसं निनयन्ति //
2.5.4.m: svadhā pitre \ svadhā pitāmahāya \ svadhā prapitāmahāya \\ iti barhiṣy adhi cātvālaṃ prati camasaṃ ninayanti

2.5.4.s:
samudraṃ vaḥ prahiṇomi
achāyam̐ vo marutaḥ śloka etu\ achā viṣṇuṃ niṣiktapām avobhiḥ /
uta prajāyai gṛṇate vayo dhur \ yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ //
iti ninītā anumantrayate /
2.5.4.d:
समुद्रं वः प्रहिणोमि
अछायम्̐ वो मरुतः श्लोक एतु\ अछा विष्णुं निषिक्तपाम् अवोभिः /
उत प्रजायै गृणते वयो धुर् \ यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः //
इति निनीता अनुमन्त्रयते /
2.5.4.m:
samudraṃ vaḥ prahiṇomi

achāyam̐ vo marutaḥ śloka etu\ achā viṣṇuṃ niṣiktapām avobhiḥ

uta prajāyai gṛṇate vayo dhur \ yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ

iti ninītā anumantrayate

2.5.4.s:
mahā kavī yuvānā \ satyād ā dharmaṇas pari /
satyasya dharmaṇā \ vi sakhyāni visṛjāvahai //
iti dakṣiṇata āhavanīyasya sakhyāni visṛjante //
2.5.4.d:
महा कवी युवाना \ सत्याद् आ धर्मणस् परि /
सत्यस्य धर्मणा \ वि सख्यानि विसृजावहै //
इति दक्षिणत आहवनीयस्य सख्यानि विसृजन्ते //
2.5.4.m:
mahā kavī yuvānā \ satyād ā dharmaṇas pari

satyasya dharmaṇā \ vi sakhyāni visṛjāvahai

iti dakṣiṇata āhavanīyasya sakhyāni visṛjante

2.5.4.s: dadhikrāvṇo akāriṣam ity āgnīdhre dadhi bhakṣayanti /
2.5.4.d: दधिक्राव्णो अकारिषम् इत्य् आग्नीध्रे दधि भक्षयन्ति /
2.5.4.m: dadhikrāvṇo akāriṣam ity āgnīdhre dadhi bhakṣayanti

2.5.4.s: patnīsam̐yājaprabhṛti siddham ā samiṣṭayajurbhyaḥ /
2.5.4.d: पत्नीसम्̐याजप्रभृति सिद्धम् आ समिष्टयजुर्भ्यः /
2.5.4.m: patnīsam̐yājaprabhṛti siddham ā samiṣṭayajurbhyaḥ

2.5.4.s: navakṛtvo dhruvām āpyāyya dhātā rātir ity etena saṃtataṃ nava samiṣṭayajūm̐ṣi juhoti /
2.5.4.d: नवकृत्वो ध्रुवाम् आप्याय्य धाता रातिर् इत्य् एतेन संततं नव समिष्टयजूम्̐षि जुहोति /
2.5.4.m: navakṛtvo dhruvām āpyāyya dhātā rātir ity etena saṃtataṃ nava samiṣṭayajūm̐ṣi juhoti

2.5.4.s:
idaṃ tṛtīyam̐ savanaṃ kavīnām \ ṛtena ye camasam airayanta /
saudhanvanā amṛtam ānaśānāḥ \ sviṣṭaṃ no 'bhi vasyo nayantu //
iti savanakaraṇiṃ juhoti // drapsaś caskanda \\ iti dvitīyām /
2.5.4.d:
इदं तृतीयम्̐ सवनं कवीनाम् \ ऋतेन ये चमसम् ऐरयन्त /
सौधन्वना अमृतम् आनशानाः \ स्विष्टं नो ऽभि वस्यो नयन्तु //
इति सवनकरणिं जुहोति // द्रप्सश् चस्कन्द \\ इति द्वितीयाम् /
2.5.4.m:
idaṃ tṛtīyam̐ savanaṃ kavīnām \ ṛtena ye camasam airayanta

saudhanvanā amṛtam ānaśānāḥ \ sviṣṭaṃ no 'bhi vasyo nayantu

iti savanakaraṇiṃ juhoti // drapsaś caskanda \\ iti dvitīyām

2.5.4.s: vāruṇam ekakapālaṃ nirvapati /
2.5.4.d: वारुणम् एककपालं निर्वपति /
2.5.4.m: vāruṇam ekakapālaṃ nirvapati

2.5.4.s: siddham odvāsanāt //
2.5.4.d: सिद्धम् ओद्वासनात् //

2.5.4.s: āyurdā deva jarasam̐ vṛṇānas \\ ity abhijuhoti /
2.5.4.d: आयुर्दा देव जरसम्̐ वृणानस् \\ इत्य् अभिजुहोति /
2.5.4.m: āyurdā deva jarasam̐ vṛṇānas \\ ity abhijuhoti

2.5.4.s:
upasṛjan dharuṇaṃ mātre mātaraṃ dharuṇo dhayan /
rāyaspoṣam iṣam ūrjam asmāsu dīdharat //
ity audumbarīm utkhanaty udgātā vā /
2.5.4.d:
उपसृजन् धरुणं मात्रे मातरं धरुणो धयन् /
रायस्पोषम् इषम् ऊर्जम् अस्मासु दीधरत् //
इत्य् औदुम्बरीम् उत्खनत्य् उद्गाता वा /
2.5.4.m:
upasṛjan dharuṇaṃ mātre mātaraṃ dharuṇo dhayan

rāyaspoṣam iṣam ūrjam asmāsu dīdharat

ity audumbarīm utkhanaty udgātā vā

2.5.4.s: cātvāle 'vabhṛthāya samāyanti /
2.5.4.d: चात्वाले ऽवभृथाय समायन्ति /
2.5.4.m: cātvāle 'vabhṛthāya samāyanti

2.5.4.s: audumbarīm adhiṣavaṇaphalake cāsandyām ādadhāti somaliptāni cānyat somasthālībhyaḥ /
2.5.4.d: औदुम्बरीम् अधिषवणफलके चासन्द्याम् आदधाति सोमलिप्तानि चान्यत् सोमस्थालीभ्यः /
2.5.4.m: audumbarīm adhiṣavaṇaphalake cāsandyām ādadhāti somaliptāni cānyat somasthālībhyaḥ

2.5.4.s:
abhūd devaḥ savitā vandyo nu nas\ idānīm ahna upavācyo nṛbhiḥ /
vi yo ratnā bhajati mānavebhyaḥ \ śreṣṭhaṃ no atra draviṇam̐ yathā dadhat //
ā śarīraṃ payasā parādād \ anyadanyad bhavati rūpam asya /
tasmin vayam upahūtās tava sma\ ā no vīram̐ vahatā jāyamānāḥ //
yat te grāvṇā vichindat soma rājan \ dhruvam aṅgaṃ priyam̐ yat tanūs te /
tat saṃdhatsvota rohayasva \ viśvair viśvāṅgaiḥ saha saṃbhavāmi //
mā naḥ soma hvarito vihvaras tvammm\ mā naḥ param adhanaṃ mā rajo naiḥ /
mā no andhe tamasy antarādhāt\ mā no rudrāso adhigur vadhe nu //
sucakṣāḥ soma uta suśrud astu \ am̐śuś cāsya punar āpīno astu /
sa no rayim iha graheṣu dadhātu\ ūrjā sam̐rabdhā irayā madema //
ity etābhir ṛjīṣam adhiṣavaṇe dadhnābhijuhoti //
2.5.4.d:
अभूद् देवः सविता वन्द्यो नु नस्\ इदानीम् अह्न उपवाच्यो नृभिः /
वि यो रत्ना भजति मानवेभ्यः \ श्रेष्ठं नो अत्र द्रविणम्̐ यथा दधत् //
आ शरीरं पयसा परादाद् \ अन्यदन्यद् भवति रूपम् अस्य /
तस्मिन् वयम् उपहूतास् तव स्म\ आ नो वीरम्̐ वहता जायमानाः //
यत् ते ग्राव्णा विछिन्दत् सोम राजन् \ ध्रुवम् अङ्गं प्रियम्̐ यत् तनूस् ते /
तत् संधत्स्वोत रोहयस्व \ विश्वैर् विश्वाङ्गैः सह संभवामि //
मा नः सोम ह्वरितो विह्वरस् त्वम्म्म्\ मा नः परम् अधनं मा रजो नैः /
मा नो अन्धे तमस्य् अन्तराधात्\ मा नो रुद्रासो अधिगुर् वधे नु //
सुचक्षाः सोम उत सुश्रुद् अस्तु \ अम्̐शुश् चास्य पुनर् आपीनो अस्तु /
स नो रयिम् इह ग्रहेषु दधातु\ ऊर्जा सम्̐रब्धा इरया मदेम //
इत्य् एताभिर् ऋजीषम् अधिषवणे दध्नाभिजुहोति //
2.5.4.m:
abhūd devaḥ savitā vandyo nu nas\ idānīm ahna upavācyo nṛbhiḥ

vi yo ratnā bhajati mānavebhyaḥ \ śreṣṭhaṃ no atra draviṇam̐ yathā dadhat

ā śarīraṃ payasā parādād \ anyadanyad bhavati rūpam asya

tasmin vayam upahūtās tava sma\ ā no vīram̐ vahatā jāyamānāḥ

yat te grāvṇā vichindat soma rājan \ dhruvam aṅgaṃ priyam̐ yat tanūs te

tat saṃdhatsvota rohayasva \ viśvair viśvāṅgaiḥ saha saṃbhavāmi

mā naḥ soma hvarito vihvaras tvammm\ mā naḥ param adhanaṃ mā rajo naiḥ

mā no andhe tamasy antarādhāt\ mā no rudrāso adhigur vadhe nu

sucakṣāḥ soma uta suśrud astu \ am̐śuś cāsya punar āpīno astu

sa no rayim iha graheṣu dadhātu\ ūrjā sam̐rabdhā irayā madema

2.5.4.s: udgātaḥ sāma gāya \\ iti preṣyati prastotar iti vā /
2.5.4.d: उद्गातः साम गाय \\ इति प्रेष्यति प्रस्तोतर् इति वा /
2.5.4.m:
ity etābhir ṛjīṣam adhiṣavaṇe dadhnābhijuhoti

udgātaḥ sāma gāya \\ iti preṣyati prastotar iti vā

2.5.4.s: tasya sarve nidhanam upayanti / samayārdhe dvitīyaṃ prāpya tṛtīyam /
2.5.4.d: तस्य सर्वे निधनम् उपयन्ति / समयार्धे द्वितीयं प्राप्य तृतीयम् /
2.5.4.m: tasya sarve nidhanam upayanti / samayārdhe dvitīyaṃ prāpya tṛtīyam

2.5.4.s: vāruṇapraghāsiko 'vabhṛthaḥ /
2.5.4.d: वारुणप्रघासिको ऽवभृथः /
2.5.4.m: vāruṇapraghāsiko 'vabhṛthaḥ

2.5.4.s: ekakapālena varuṇam̐ yajaty āśayenāgnīvaruṇau /
2.5.4.d: एककपालेन वरुणम्̐ यजत्य् आशयेनाग्नीवरुणौ /
2.5.4.m: ekakapālena varuṇam̐ yajaty āśayenāgnīvaruṇau

2.5.4.s: ṛjīṣam̐ srucy avadhāya samudre te hṛdayam apsv antar iti saha srucopamārayati //
2.5.4.d: ऋजीषम्̐ स्रुच्य् अवधाय समुद्रे ते हृदयम् अप्स्व् अन्तर् इति सह स्रुचोपमारयति //
2.5.4.m: ṛjīṣam̐ srucy avadhāya samudre te hṛdayam apsv antar iti saha srucopamārayati

2.5.4.s: avabhṛtha nicuṅkuṇa \\ ity āsandīṃ prakirati somaliptāni ca /
2.5.4.d: अवभृथ निचुङ्कुण \\ इत्य् आसन्दीं प्रकिरति सोमलिप्तानि च /
2.5.4.m: avabhṛtha nicuṅkuṇa \\ ity āsandīṃ prakirati somaliptāni ca

2.5.4.s: utplutam ṛjīṣam apsu dhautasya te deva soma \\ ity avaghreṇa bhakṣayanti /
2.5.4.d: उत्प्लुतम् ऋजीषम् अप्सु धौतस्य ते देव सोम \\ इत्य् अवघ्रेण भक्षयन्ति /
2.5.4.m: utplutam ṛjīṣam apsu dhautasya te deva soma \\ ity avaghreṇa bhakṣayanti

2.5.4.s: āsyadeśe nigṛhṇāti /
2.5.4.d: आस्यदेशे निगृह्णाति /

2.5.4.s: priyatamāya kṛṣṇājinaṃ prayachati / tad adhi peṣaṇaṃ kurvanti //
2.5.4.d: प्रियतमाय कृष्णाजिनं प्रयछति / तद् अधि पेषणं कुर्वन्ति //
2.5.4.m: priyatamāya kṛṣṇājinaṃ prayachati / tad adhi peṣaṇaṃ kurvanti

2.5.4.s: vicṛtto varuṇasya pāśas \\ iti mekhalām̐ viṣyati vasanaṃ ca / tūṣṇīṃ patnī yoktraṃ jālaṃ ca /
2.5.4.d: विचृत्तो वरुणस्य पाशस् \\ इति मेखलाम्̐ विष्यति वसनं च / तूष्णीं पत्नी योक्त्रं जालं च /
2.5.4.m: vicṛtto varuṇasya pāśas \\ iti mekhalām̐ viṣyati vasanaṃ ca / tūṣṇīṃ patnī yoktraṃ jālaṃ ca

2.5.4.s: avabhṛthe snātāv anyo'nyasya pṛṣṭham prakṣālayataḥ /
2.5.4.d: अवभृथे स्नाताव् अन्योऽन्यस्य पृष्ठम् प्रक्षालयतः /
2.5.4.m: avabhṛthe snātāv anyo'nyasya pṛṣṭham prakṣālayataḥ

2.5.4.s: somopanahanam̐ yajamānaḥ paridhatte paryāṇahanaṃ patnī / te udavasānīyāyāṃ dakṣiṇākāle 'dhvaryave dattaḥ //
2.5.4.d: सोमोपनहनम्̐ यजमानः परिधत्ते पर्याणहनं पत्नी / ते उदवसानीयायां दक्षिणाकाले ऽध्वर्यवे दत्तः //
2.5.4.m: somopanahanam̐ yajamānaḥ paridhatte paryāṇahanaṃ patnī / te udavasānīyāyāṃ dakṣiṇākāle 'dhvaryave dattaḥ

2.5.4.s: unnetar vasīyas \\ ity āhonnetāram̐ yajamānaḥ //
2.5.4.d: उन्नेतर् वसीयस् \\ इत्य् आहोन्नेतारम्̐ यजमानः //
2.5.4.m: unnetar vasīyas \\ ity āhonnetāram̐ yajamānaḥ

2.5.4.s: udut te madhumattamā giras \\ ity unnetā prakramayati /
2.5.4.d: उदुत् ते मधुमत्तमा गिरस् \\ इत्य् उन्नेता प्रक्रमयति /
2.5.4.m: udut te madhumattamā giras \\ ity unnetā prakramayati

2.5.4.s: vyākhyātaṃ pratyasanaṃ mārjanaṃ ca /
2.5.4.d: व्याख्यातं प्रत्यसनं मार्जनं च /
2.5.4.m: vyākhyātaṃ pratyasanaṃ mārjanaṃ ca

2.5.4.s:
apāma somam amṛtā abhūma\ aganma jyotir avidāma devān /
kiṃ nūnam asmān kṛṇavad arātiḥ \ kim u dhūrtir amṛta martyasya //
iti japanti /
2.5.4.d:
अपाम सोमम् अमृता अभूम\ अगन्म ज्योतिर् अविदाम देवान् /
किं नूनम् अस्मान् कृणवद् अरातिः \ किम् उ धूर्तिर् अमृत मर्त्यस्य //
इति जपन्ति /
2.5.4.m:
"We have drunk the soma, we have become immortal; / we have reached the light, we have found the gods.

What now could hostility do to us, / or what, O immortal one, the malice of a mortal?" —

2.5.4.s: unnetāraṃ puraskṛtyānapekṣamāṇāḥ pratyāyanti / tad vyākhyātam /
2.5.4.d: उन्नेतारं पुरस्कृत्यानपेक्षमाणाः प्रत्यायन्ति / तद् व्याख्यातम् /
2.5.4.m: Placing the unnetṛ priest in front, they walk back without looking around. That has been explained.

2.5.5.s: prāyaṇīyenodayanīyo vyākhyātaḥ /
2.5.5.d: प्रायणीयेनोदयनीयो व्याख्यातः /
2.5.5.m: By the introductory rite the concluding rite is explained.

2.5.5.s: niṣkāṣe prāyaṇīyasyodayanīyam anunirvapati /
2.5.5.d: निष्काषे प्रायणीयस्योदयनीयम् अनुनिर्वपति /
2.5.5.m: Upon the scraped-off portion of the introductory rite he apportions [the materials of] the concluding rite.

2.5.5.s: śālāmukhīye pracarati /
2.5.5.d: शालामुखीये प्रचरति /
2.5.5.m: He performs the ritual at the śālāmukhīya fire.

2.5.5.s: prāg aditeḥ pathyām̐ svastiṃ pūrvārdhe yajati /
2.5.5.d: प्राग् अदितेः पथ्याम्̐ स्वस्तिं पूर्वार्धे यजति /
2.5.5.m: Before Aditi, he sacrifices to Pathyā Svasti in the eastern half.

2.5.5.s: anūbandhyāyai vedaṃ nidadhāti /
2.5.5.d: अनूबन्ध्यायै वेदं निदधाति /
2.5.5.m: He deposits the veda grass bundle for the anūbandhyā cow offering.

2.5.5.s: pāśubandhikam idhmābarhiḥ saṃnahyati /
2.5.5.d: पाशुबन्धिकम् इध्माबर्हिः संनह्यति /
2.5.5.m: He binds the sacrificial fuel and the sacrificial grass pertaining to the animal sacrifice.

2.5.5.s: maitrāvaruṇīm̐ vaśām anūbandhyām ālabhate /
2.5.5.d: मैत्रावरुणीम्̐ वशाम् अनूबन्ध्याम् आलभते /
2.5.5.m: He seizes the sterile cow dedicated to Mitra-Varuṇa as the anūbandhyā.

2.5.5.s: chāgakāle \\ usrāyās \\ iti saṃpraiṣaḥ /
2.5.5.d: छागकाले \\ उस्रायास् \\ इति संप्रैषः /
2.5.5.m: At the time for the goat, the call to recite is: "For the cow..."

2.5.5.s: siddham ā vapāyā homāt /
2.5.5.d: सिद्धम् आ वपाया होमात् /

2.5.5.s: hutāyām̐ vapāyāṃ cātvāle mārjayitvā dakṣiṇasyām̐ vediśroṇau pariśrite keśaśmaśru yajamāno vāpayate /
2.5.5.d: हुतायाम्̐ वपायां चात्वाले मार्जयित्वा दक्षिणस्याम्̐ वेदिश्रोणौ परिश्रिते केशश्मश्रु यजमानो वापयते /
2.5.5.m: When the omentum has been offered, having cleansed himself at the pit, the sacrificer has his hair and beard shaved in an enclosure on the southern buttress of the altar.

2.5.5.s: paśupuroḍāśam anu devikāhavīm̐ṣi nirvapaty anumatyai carū rākāyai sinīvālyai kuhvai dhātre dvādaśakapālam̐ somasthālīṣu śrapayati /
2.5.5.d: पशुपुरोडाशम् अनु देविकाहवीम्̐षि निर्वपत्य् अनुमत्यै चरू राकायै सिनीवाल्यै कुह्वै धात्रे द्वादशकपालम्̐ सोमस्थालीषु श्रपयति /
2.5.5.m: Following the animal sacrificial cake, he apportions the oblations for the Devikās: boiled oblations for Anumati, for Rākā, for Sinīvālī, [and] for Kuhū, and [a sacrificial cake] on twelve potsherds for Dhātṛ; he cooks them in the soma vessels.

2.5.5.s: siddham ā pracaraṇāt /
2.5.5.d: सिद्धम् आ प्रचरणात् /

2.5.5.s: paśupuroḍāśena pracaryopām̐śu devikāhavirbhiḥ pracarati /
2.5.5.d: पशुपुरोडाशेन प्रचर्योपाम्̐शु देविकाहविर्भिः प्रचरति /
2.5.5.m: Having performed the offering with the animal sacrificial cake, he performs the offering with the Devikā oblations in a whisper.

2.5.5.s: eṣo 'nvayane kalpaḥ /
2.5.5.d: एषो ऽन्वयने कल्पः /

2.5.5.s: paśupuroḍāśasya devikāhaviṣāṃ ca samavadāyāniruktena sviṣṭakṛtā pracarati /
2.5.5.d: पशुपुरोडाशस्य देविकाहविषां च समवदायानिरुक्तेन स्विष्टकृता प्रचरति /
2.5.5.m: Having cut portions together from the animal sacrificial cake and from the Devikā oblations, he performs the offering with the unexpressed Sviṣṭakṛt offering.

2.5.5.s: siddhaḥ paśubandhaḥ / payasyā vā /
2.5.5.d: सिद्धः पशुबन्धः / पयस्या वा /
2.5.5.m: The animal sacrifice is established, or else [he offers] a curd offering.

2.5.5.s: havirdhānayoḥ prathamakṛtān granthīn visram̐syodīcī pravartayanti pūrvārdhenānyad āhavanīyasya paścārdhenānyat /
2.5.5.d: हविर्धानयोः प्रथमकृतान् ग्रन्थीन् विस्रम्̐स्योदीची प्रवर्तयन्ति पूर्वार्धेनान्यद् आहवनीयस्य पश्चार्धेनान्यत् /
2.5.5.m: Having untied the knots tied first on the two soma-cart sheds, they roll them out northward, one along the eastern half of the āhavanīya fire, the other along the western half.

2.5.5.s:
yat kusīdam apratītaṃ mayeha \ yena yamasya nidhinā carāvaḥ /
etat tad agne anṛṇo bhavāmi \ jīvann eva pratidatte dadāmi //
ity āhavanīyād yajamāno vediṃ paryoṣati //
2.5.5.d:
यत् कुसीदम् अप्रतीतं मयेह \ येन यमस्य निधिना चरावः /
एतत् तद् अग्ने अनृणो भवामि \ जीवन्न् एव प्रतिदत्ते ददामि //
इत्य् आहवनीयाद् यजमानो वेदिं पर्योषति //
2.5.5.m:
"Whatever debt not repaid by me [remains] here, / with whatever deposit of Yama we two move about,

thereof, O Agni, I become free from debt: / living indeed, I give it back to him who gave it," —

with this the sacrificer scorches the altar [with fire brought] from the āhavanīya fire.

2.5.5.s: viśloka viśvadāvye tvā saṃjuhomi svāhā \\ iti pradāvye yajamānaḥ saktvañjaliṃ juhoti //
2.5.5.d: विश्लोक विश्वदाव्ये त्वा संजुहोमि स्वाहा \\ इति प्रदाव्ये यजमानः सक्त्वञ्जलिं जुहोति //
2.5.5.m: "O wide-striding one, in the all-consuming one I offer you, svāhā!" — with this the sacrificer offers a folded-handful of barley flour into the fire-place.

2.5.5.s: adhvād eko 'ddhād eko hutād eko 'hutād ekaḥ kṛtād ekaḥ kṛtākṛtād ekaḥ sanād ekaḥ sanāsanād ekas \ te naḥ kṛṇvantu bheṣajam \\ sadaḥ saho vareṇyam iti pradāvye yajamāna upatiṣṭhate /
2.5.5.d: अध्वाद् एको ऽद्धाद् एको हुताद् एको ऽहुताद् एकः कृताद् एकः कृताकृताद् एकः सनाद् एकः सनासनाद् एकस् \ ते नः कृण्वन्तु भेषजम् \\ सदः सहो वरेण्यम् इति प्रदाव्ये यजमान उपतिष्ठते /
2.5.5.m: "One from eating, one from not eating; one from offered, one from unoffered; one from made, one from made-and-unmade; one from old, one from not old: may they prepare healing for us, the assembly, strength, the choice portion!" — with this the sacrificer reveres [the fires] in the fire-place.

2.5.5.s:
etam̐ sadhastha pari te dadāmi \ yam āvahāc chevadhiṃ jātavedāḥ /
anvāgantā yajñapatir vo atra \ tam̐ sma jānīta parame vyoman //
jānītād enaṃ parame vyoman \ devāḥ sadhasthā vida rūpam asya /
ya āgachāt pathibhir devayānair \ iṣṭāpūrte kṛṇutād āvir asmāt //
iti yajamānaḥ paridadāti /
2.5.5.d:
एतम्̐ सधस्थ परि ते ददामि \ यम् आवहाच् छेवधिं जातवेदाः /
अन्वागन्ता यज्ञपतिर् वो अत्र \ तम्̐ स्म जानीत परमे व्योमन् //
जानीताद् एनं परमे व्योमन् \ देवाः सधस्था विद रूपम् अस्य /
य आगछात् पथिभिर् देवयानैर् \ इष्टापूर्ते कृणुताद् आविर् अस्मात् //
इति यजमानः परिददाति /
2.5.5.m:
"This [sacrifice], O assembly-place, I entrust to you, / which treasure Jātavedas shall bring;

the master of sacrifice will come after you here: / recognize him in the highest heaven!

Recognize him in the highest heaven, / O gods, companions of the seat; know his form!

He who shall come by the paths trodden by gods, / make manifest to him his sacrifices and charitable gifts!" —

2.5.5.s:
anṛṇā asminn anṛṇāḥ parasmin\ tṛtīye loke anṛṇāḥ syāma /
ye devayānāḥ pitṛyāṇāś ca lokāḥ \ sarvām̐l lokān anṛṇāḥ saṃcaremahi //
iti japati yajamānaḥ /
2.5.5.d:
अनृणा अस्मिन्न् अनृणाः परस्मिन्\ तृतीये लोके अनृणाः स्याम /
ये देवयानाः पितृयाणाश् च लोकाः \ सर्वाम्̐ल् लोकान् अनृणाः संचरेमहि //
इति जपति यजमानः /
2.5.5.m:
with this the sacrificer entrusts [it].

"Free from debt in this [world], free from debt in the other, / may we be free from debt in the third world!

Whatever worlds are trodden by gods and trodden by the fathers, / through all worlds may we wander free from debt!" —

2.5.5.s: samāropayaty aparāvagnī / yadi gataśrīḥ śālāmukhīyaṃ ca /
2.5.5.d: समारोपयत्य् अपरावग्नी / यदि गतश्रीः शालामुखीयं च /
2.5.5.m: He causes the two western fires to mount [into the churning sticks]; if he is of established prosperity, the śālāmukhīya fire as well.

2.5.5.s: udaṅṅ udavasāyāraṇibhyām agniṃ mathitvodavasānīyām iṣṭiṃ nirvapati /
2.5.5.d: उदङ्ङ् उदवसायारणिभ्याम् अग्निं मथित्वोदवसानीयाम् इष्टिं निर्वपति /
2.5.5.m: Having migrated northward and churned out fire with the two churning sticks, he apportions [the materials for] the departure sacrifice.

2.5.5.s: āgneyam eva pañcakapālam̐ vibhaktīḥ prayājānuyājeṣv āgneyāv ājyabhāgau /
2.5.5.d: आग्नेयम् एव पञ्चकपालम्̐ विभक्तीः प्रयाजानुयाजेष्व् आग्नेयाव् आज्यभागौ /
2.5.5.m: [It consists] of [a sacrificial cake] on five potsherds for Agni alone, divided [portions] in the fore-offerings and after-offerings, [and] two clarified butter portions for Agni.

2.5.5.s: anaḍvān dakṣiṇā /
2.5.5.d: अनड्वान् दक्षिणा /

2.5.5.s: api vā vaiṣṇavīṃ pūrṇāhutiṃ hutvā /
2.5.5.d: अपि वा वैष्णवीं पूर्णाहुतिं हुत्वा /
2.5.5.m: Or else having offered a full-spoon offering to Viṣṇu,

2.5.5.s:
agnir ajahitaḥ praitu prathamo yajñiyānām /
avasānaṃ me 'vasānapatir vindat /
dīdivām̐saṃ tvā vyam anvāgamemahi //
iti yajamāno vihāraṃ puraskṛtya gṛhān āgachaty āgachati /
2.5.5.d:
अग्निर् अजहितः प्रैतु प्रथमो यज्ञियानाम् /
अवसानं मे ऽवसानपतिर् विन्दत् /
दीदिवाम्̐सं त्वा व्यम् अन्वागमेमहि //
इति यजमानो विहारं पुरस्कृत्य गृहान् आगछत्य् आगछति /

3.1.0.s: brahmā prāyaścittāni sruveṇa juhoty ṛkto bhreṣe bhuḥ svāhā \\ iti gārhapatye yajuṣṭas \\ bhuvaḥ svāhā \\ iti dakṣiṇāgnau sāmataḥ svaḥ svāhā \\ ity āhavanīye sarvatas \\ bhūr bhuvaḥ svaḥ svāhā \\ ity āhavanīya eva /
3.1.0.d: ब्रह्मा प्रायश्चित्तानि स्रुवेण जुहोत्य् ऋक्तो भ्रेषे भुः स्वाहा \\ इति गार्हपत्ये यजुष्टस् \\ भुवः स्वाहा \\ इति दक्षिणाग्नौ सामतः स्वः स्वाहा \\ इत्य् आहवनीये सर्वतस् \\ भूर् भुवः स्वः स्वाहा \\ इत्य् आहवनीय एव /
3.1.0.m: The brahman priest offers expiations with the dipping spoon: in case of a flaw concerning a Ṛgverse, with "bhūḥ svāhā" in the gārhapatya fire; concerning a Yajus formula, with "bhuvaḥ svāhā" in the southern fire; concerning a Sāman chant, with "svaḥ svāhā" in the āhavanīya fire; concerning all, with "bhūr bhuvaḥ svaḥ svāhā" in the āhavanīya fire itself.

3.1.0.s: duṣṭam apo 'bhyavahared atha pātrāṇi parimṛjyāl lohaṃ nirlikhed dārumayaṃ niṣṭapen mārtikam adbhiḥ sauvarṇam̐ rājatam /
3.1.0.d: दुष्टम् अपो ऽभ्यवहरेद् अथ पात्राणि परिमृज्याल् लोहं निर्लिखेद् दारुमयं निष्टपेन् मार्तिकम् अद्भिः सौवर्णम्̐ राजतम् /
3.1.0.m: He should discard defiled water; then, wiping the vessels, he should scrape iron, heat wooden [vessels], [cleanse] earthenware with water, [as well as] gold and silver [vessels].

3.1.0.s: dravyāpacāre sāmānyam̐ yajñiyaṃ pratinidadhyāt /
3.1.0.d: द्रव्यापचारे सामान्यम्̐ यज्ञियं प्रतिनिदध्यात् /
3.1.0.m: In case of the loss of a substance, he should substitute a similar one fit for sacrifice.

3.1.0.s: karmāntaritaṃ kuryāt sam̐skārāntare prāyaścittam eva juhuyāt /
3.1.0.d: कर्मान्तरितं कुर्यात् सम्̐स्कारान्तरे प्रायश्चित्तम् एव जुहुयात् /
3.1.0.m: He should perform a omitted ritual act; if another consecratory act intervenes, he should simply offer an expiation.

3.1.0.s: dravyāvṛttau sahamantram āvartayet tūṣṇīm̐ vā /
3.1.0.d: द्रव्यावृत्तौ सहमन्त्रम् आवर्तयेत् तूष्णीम्̐ वा /
3.1.0.m: When a substance is repeated, he should repeat it together with the sacred formula, or silently.

3.1.0.s: devatāvadānayājyānuvākyāhavirmantrakarmaviparyāse 'nāmnātaprāyaścittānāṃ cāpadi tvaṃ no agne \ sa tvaṃ no agne \ ayāś cāgne 'si \\ ity etābhir juhuyād vyāhṛtibhiś cāthavā vyāhṛtibhir eva / homakāle 'pi sarvatrānāmnātaprāyaścitteṣu vyāhṛtibhir eva juhuyāt /
3.1.0.d: देवतावदानयाज्यानुवाक्याहविर्मन्त्रकर्मविपर्यासे ऽनाम्नातप्रायश्चित्तानां चापदि त्वं नो अग्ने \ स त्वं नो अग्ने \ अयाश् चाग्ने ऽसि \\ इत्य् एताभिर् जुहुयाद् व्याहृतिभिश् चाथवा व्याहृतिभिर् एव / होमकाले ऽपि सर्वत्रानाम्नातप्रायश्चित्तेषु व्याहृतिभिर् एव जुहुयात् /
3.1.0.m: In case of confusion of deity, portion, offering verse, invitatory verse, oblation, sacred formula, or ritual act, and in distress for which no expiations are prescribed, he should offer with these: "You to us, O Agni...", "So you to us, O Agni...", and "You are Ayās, O Agni...", and with the mystical utterances, or else with the mystical utterances alone. At the time of offering also, in all cases of expiations that are not prescribed, he should offer with the mystical utterances alone.

3.1.0.s: akāle vācam̐ visṛjya vaiṣṇavīṃ nigadya punar yachet /
3.1.0.d: अकाले वाचम्̐ विसृज्य वैष्णवीं निगद्य पुनर् यछेत् /
3.1.0.m: Having uttered speech out of time, having recited a verse to Viṣṇu, he should restrain it again.

3.1.0.s: vratopetasya ced āhavanīyo 'nugachet praṇīte manasā vratamupetya bhūr ity upatiṣṭheta /
3.1.0.d: व्रतोपेतस्य चेद् आहवनीयो ऽनुगछेत् प्रणीते मनसा व्रतमुपेत्य भूर् इत्य् उपतिष्ठेत /
3.1.0.m: If the āhavanīya fire goes out while he has undertaken the vow, when [the fires] have been carried forward, having mentally undertaken the vow, he should revere [the fire] with "bhūḥ".

3.1.0.s: yadi vatsā apākṛtā dhayeyur vāyavyā yavāgvā pracarya prātardohena pracared yadi prātardohe 'param̐ vāyavyā /
3.1.0.d: यदि वत्सा अपाकृता धयेयुर् वायव्या यवाग्वा प्रचर्य प्रातर्दोहेन प्रचरेद् यदि प्रातर्दोहे ऽपरम्̐ वायव्या /
3.1.0.m: If the calves, after being set apart, should suckle, having performed the ritual with barley gruel for Vāyu, he should perform the ritual with the morning milking; if in the case of the morning milking [another suckling occurs, he should perform the ritual] with [another barley gruel] for Vāyu.

3.1.0.s: yadi sāyaṃdoham apahared duṣyed vā prātardohaṃ dvaidhaṃ dohayitvārdham ātacya pracaret /
3.1.0.d: यदि सायंदोहम् अपहरेद् दुष्येद् वा प्रातर्दोहं द्वैधं दोहयित्वार्धम् आतच्य प्रचरेत् /
3.1.0.m: If they should take away the evening milking or it should become spoiled, having caused the morning milking to be milked in two parts and having curdled half of it, he should perform the ritual.

3.1.0.s: yadi sāyaṃdoha ārtim iyād indrāya vrīhīn nirvapec chvobhūte teṣv anunirpavet /
3.1.0.d: यदि सायंदोह आर्तिम् इयाद् इन्द्राय व्रीहीन् निर्वपेच् छ्वोभूते तेष्व् अनुनिर्पवेत् /
3.1.0.m: If the evening milking should suffer damage, he should apportion rice for Indra; on the next day he should apportion upon them.

3.1.0.s: yadi prātardoha aindraṃ puroḍāśam̐ yady ubhāv aindraṃ pañcaśarāv amodanaṃ paced ājyenāgniṃ prathamam̐ yajeta /
3.1.0.d: यदि प्रातर्दोह ऐन्द्रं पुरोडाशम्̐ यद्य् उभाव् ऐन्द्रं पञ्चशराव् अमोदनं पचेद् आज्येनाग्निं प्रथमम्̐ यजेत /
3.1.0.m: If the morning milking [suffers damage], [he should offer] a sacrificial cake for Indra; if both [suffer damage], he should cook a boiled rice oblation of five plates for Indra [and] sacrifice first to Agni with clarified butter.

3.1.0.s: hīneṣv ārtigate vā vatsān apākṛtya punar yajeta /
3.1.0.d: हीनेष्व् आर्तिगते वा वत्सान् अपाकृत्य पुनर् यजेत /
3.1.0.m: When [the offerings] are deficient or have suffered damage, having set apart the calves, he should sacrifice again.

3.1.0.s: yasya sāṃnāyyaṃ candramā abhyudiyād vatsān pratinudet /
3.1.0.d: यस्य सांनाय्यं चन्द्रमा अभ्युदियाद् वत्सान् प्रतिनुदेत् /
3.1.0.m: For whom the moon rises upon the curd and milk offering, he should drive the calves back.

3.1.0.s: sāyaṃdoho havirātañcanaṃ tadvrato yathākālam̐ yajeta /
3.1.0.d: सायंदोहो हविरातञ्चनं तद्व्रतो यथाकालम्̐ यजेत /
3.1.0.m: The evening milking is the oblation-curdling agent; having undertaken that vow, he should sacrifice at the proper time.

3.1.0.s: vratam anutsahamānasyābhyuditeṣṭir nirupteṣu ca vatsān apākṛtya punar yajeta /
3.1.0.d: व्रतम् अनुत्सहमानस्याभ्युदितेष्टिर् निरुप्तेषु च वत्सान् अपाकृत्य पुनर् यजेत /
3.1.0.m: For one incapable of [observing] the vow, there is the sacrifice on the moonrise; and when [the portions] have been apportioned, having set apart the calves, he should sacrifice again.

3.1.0.s: yadi havīm̐ṣy apahareyur duṣyeyur vājyena sam̐sthāpya punar yajeta /
3.1.0.d: यदि हवीम्̐ष्य् अपहरेयुर् दुष्येयुर् वाज्येन सम्̐स्थाप्य पुनर् यजेत /
3.1.0.m: If they should take away the oblations or they should become spoiled, having concluded [the rite] with clarified butter, he should sacrifice again.

3.1.0.s: yadi havīm̐ṣi muhyeyuḥ pātryām̐ samadhā vibhajyānupūrveṇa pracaret /
3.1.0.d: यदि हवीम्̐षि मुह्येयुः पात्र्याम्̐ समधा विभज्यानुपूर्वेण प्रचरेत् /
3.1.0.m: If the oblations become confused, he should divide [them] equally into vessels and proceed successively in order.

3.1.0.s: sarvaskanne naṣṭe duṣṭe vā yathāpūrvaṃ punaḥ sam̐skaraṇam //
3.1.0.d: सर्वस्कन्ने नष्टे दुष्टे वा यथापूर्वं पुनः सम्̐स्करणम् //
3.1.0.m: If all has spilled, been lost, or corrupted, the preparation takes place anew as before.

3.1.0.s: devāñ janam agan yajñas \\ iti skannam abhimantryāpo ninayet /
3.1.0.d: देवाञ् जनम् अगन् यज्ञस् \\ इति स्कन्नम् अभिमन्त्र्यापो निनयेत् /
3.1.0.m: Addressing the spilled portion with the mantra, "The sacrifice has gone to the divine people," he should pour water on it.

3.1.0.s: ājye skanne dadāty anutpūte citram utpūyamāne prāṇy utpūte varam /
3.1.0.d: आज्ये स्कन्ने ददात्य् अनुत्पूते चित्रम् उत्पूयमाने प्राण्य् उत्पूते वरम् /
3.1.0.m: When the clarified butter spills before being purified, he gives a spotted [cow]; while being purified, a living animal; after being purified, a boon.

3.1.0.s: duḥśṛtayor avadānamātre suśṛtena prāyaścittaṃ tathā kṣāmayoḥ /
3.1.0.d: दुःशृतयोर् अवदानमात्रे सुशृतेन प्रायश्चित्तं तथा क्षामयोः /
3.1.0.m: If two portions are ill-cooked, only as much as an oblation portion is the expiation with a well-cooked [portion]; likewise if two are burnt.

3.1.0.s: adakṣiṇeneṣṭvorvarām̐ samṛddhāṃ dadyāt /
3.1.0.d: अदक्षिणेनेष्ट्वोर्वराम्̐ समृद्धां दद्यात् /
3.1.0.m: Having sacrificed without a sacrificial gift, he should give a fertile, rich field.

3.1.0.s: yadi kapālaṃ bhidyeta gāyatryā tvā śatākṣarayā saṃdadhāmi \\ iti saṃdhānakaraiḥ śucidravyaiḥ saṃdhāyāthaitat kapālam \\ dhātā dhātuḥ pituḥ pitābhinno gharmo viśvāyur yato jātaṃ tad apyagāt svāhā \\ ity apsu prahared athānyat kapālam āhṛtya sādanābhimarśanaprokṣaṇādi kṛtvā pūrvayukteṣu kapāleṣv apisṛjet / upahitasya bhede tu tasya saṃdhānādi pūrvavat kṛtvānyat sam̐skṛtyopahitaṃ kapālam upadhānakāle yena mantreṇopahitaṃ tenaivopadadhyāt tatsthāne /
3.1.0.d: यदि कपालं भिद्येत गायत्र्या त्वा शताक्षरया संदधामि \\ इति संधानकरैः शुचिद्रव्यैः संधायाथैतत् कपालम् \\ धाता धातुः पितुः पिताभिन्नो घर्मो विश्वायुर् यतो जातं तद् अप्यगात् स्वाहा \\ इत्य् अप्सु प्रहरेद् अथान्यत् कपालम् आहृत्य सादनाभिमर्शनप्रोक्षणादि कृत्वा पूर्वयुक्तेषु कपालेष्व् अपिसृजेत् / उपहितस्य भेदे तु तस्य संधानादि पूर्ववत् कृत्वान्यत् सम्̐स्कृत्योपहितं कपालम् उपधानकाले येन मन्त्रेणोपहितं तेनैवोपदध्यात् तत्स्थाने /
3.1.0.m: If a potsherd breaks, having joined it with clean substances that join [it] with the mantra, "I unite you with the hundred-syllabled Gāyatrī," he should throw this potsherd into water with the mantra, "Dhātṛ, father of the dispenser, the father, the unbroken cauldron, possessing all life, has gone back to that from which it was born, svāhā!" Then, bringing another potsherd and performing the setting down, touching, sprinkling, and other rites, he should place it among the previously arranged potsherds. But when an already set down potsherd breaks, having performed its joining and other rites as before, having prepared another potsherd, he should place it in its spot at the time of placing potsherds with the very mantra with which it had been set down.

3.1.0.s: yadi kapālaṃ naśyed brāhmaṇavyākhyātaṃ // dhātā dhātuḥ pituḥ pitānaṣṭo dharmas \\ iti naṣṭādhigatam apsu prahṛtya namas te rudrāyate \ namo 'stu parāyate \ namo yatra niṣīdasi \\ iti cābhimantrayeta /
3.1.0.d: यदि कपालं नश्येद् ब्राह्मणव्याख्यातं // धाता धातुः पितुः पितानष्टो धर्मस् \\ इति नष्टाधिगतम् अप्सु प्रहृत्य नमस् ते रुद्रायते \ नमो ऽस्तु परायते \ नमो यत्र निषीदसि \\ इति चाभिमन्त्रयेत /
3.1.0.m: If a potsherd is lost, it has been explained in the Brāhmaṇa. Having thrown into water that which was found after being lost, with the mantra, "Dhātṛ, father of the dispenser, the father, the lost law...," he should address it with the verse: "Homage to you as you approach; / homage be to you as you depart; / homage to where you sit down!"

3.1.0.s: yadi prāk prayājebhyo bahiṣparidhy aṅgāraḥ skandet tam abhimantrayeta \\ adhvaryuṃ mā him̐sīr \ yajñaṃ mā him̐sīr iti purastād brahmāṇaṃ mā him̐sīḥ \ prajāṃ mā him̐sīr iti dakṣiṇatas \\ hotāraṃ mā him̐sīḥ \ patnīṃ mā him̐sīr iti paścād āgnīdhraṃ mā him̐sīḥ \ paśūn mā him̐sīr ity uttaratas \\ yajamānaṃ mā him̐sīr iti sarvatrānuṣajati /
3.1.0.d: यदि प्राक् प्रयाजेभ्यो बहिष्परिध्य् अङ्गारः स्कन्देत् तम् अभिमन्त्रयेत \\ अध्वर्युं मा हिम्̐सीर् \ यज्ञं मा हिम्̐सीर् इति पुरस्ताद् ब्रह्माणं मा हिम्̐सीः \ प्रजां मा हिम्̐सीर् इति दक्षिणतस् \\ होतारं मा हिम्̐सीः \ पत्नीं मा हिम्̐सीर् इति पश्चाद् आग्नीध्रं मा हिम्̐सीः \ पशून् मा हिम्̐सीर् इत्य् उत्तरतस् \\ यजमानं मा हिम्̐सीर् इति सर्वत्रानुषजति /
3.1.0.m: If an ember spills outside the enclosing sticks before the fore-offerings, he should address it: with "Do not harm the adhvaryu priest; do not harm the sacrifice" on the east; with "Do not harm the brahman priest; do not harm the offspring" on the south; with "Do not harm the hotṛ priest; do not harm the wife" on the west; with "Do not harm the āgnīdhra priest; do not harm the cattle" on the north; everywhere he subjoins: "Do not harm the sacrificer."

3.1.0.s:
sruvabudhnenāktvā
āham̐ yajñaṃ dadhe nirṛter upasthāt \ taṃ deveṣu paridadāmi vidvān /
suprajāstvam̐ śatam̐ hi māmadantas \\ iha no devā mayi śarma yachata //
ity ādatte /
3.1.0.d:
स्रुवबुध्नेनाक्त्वा
आहम्̐ यज्ञं दधे निरृतेर् उपस्थात् \ तं देवेषु परिददामि विद्वान् /
सुप्रजास्त्वम्̐ शतम्̐ हि मामदन्तस् \\ इह नो देवा मयि शर्म यछत //
इत्य् आदत्ते /
3.1.0.m:
"I have taken the sacrifice from the lap of Nirṛti; / knowing, I entrust it to the gods.

A hundred [years] of good offspring have delighted me; / here, O gods, bestow peace upon me!"—

3.1.0.s:
sahasraśṛṅgo vṛṣabho jātavedās \\ ghṛtāhutaḥ stomapṛṣṭhaḥ suvīraḥ /
mā mā hāsīr nāthito na tvā jahāmi \ gopoṣaṃ ca no vīrapoṣaṃ ca dhehi //
mā no mahāntam uta mā no arbhakam \\ mā na ukṣantam uta mā na ukṣitam /
mā no vadhīḥ pitaraṃ mota mātaram \\ mā naḥ priyās tanvo rudra rīriṣaḥ //
ity anupraharati //
3.1.0.d:
सहस्रशृङ्गो वृषभो जातवेदास् \\ घृताहुतः स्तोमपृष्ठः सुवीरः /
मा मा हासीर् नाथितो न त्वा जहामि \ गोपोषं च नो वीरपोषं च धेहि //
मा नो महान्तम् उत मा नो अर्भकम् \\ मा न उक्षन्तम् उत मा न उक्षितम् /
मा नो वधीः पितरं मोत मातरम् \\ मा नः प्रियास् तन्वो रुद्र रीरिषः //
इत्य् अनुप्रहरति //
3.1.0.m:
"The thousand-horned bull, Jātavedas, / offered with clarified butter, having praises on his back, rich in heroes,

do not abandon me who am seeking aid, nor do I abandon you; / grant us increase of cattle and increase of heroes!

Neither our great one nor our small one, / neither our youth nor our full-grown man,

do not slay our father, nor our mother; / do not harm our dear bodies, O Rudra!"—

3.1.0.s:
vṛṣabhaṃ carṣaṇīnām \\ viśvarūpam adābhyam \\ bṛhaspatim̐ vareṇyaṃ // ud uttamam̐ varuṇa pāśam asmat ud uttamaṃ mumugdhi mad \ vi pāśaṃ madhyamaṃ cṛta / \ avādhamāni jīvase //
iti ṣaḍbhir abhijuhoti /
3.1.0.d:
वृषभं चर्षणीनाम् \\ विश्वरूपम् अदाभ्यम् \\ बृहस्पतिम्̐ वरेण्यं // उद् उत्तमम्̐ वरुण पाशम् अस्मत् उद् उत्तमं मुमुग्धि मद् \ वि पाशं मध्यमं चृत / \ अवाधमानि जीवसे //
इति षड्भिर् अभिजुहोति /
3.1.0.m:
"The bull of the peoples, / multiform, invulnerable, / Bṛhaspati, the desirable... / Untie the highest fetter from us, O Varuṇa, / loosen the highest from me, undo the middle fetter, / and the lowest, that we may live!"—

with these six [formulas] he offers across [the fire].

3.1.0.s: yady anabhiniruptām āvāhayed yathāvāhitam ājyenopām̐śu yajeta / bhāginīṃ cen nāvāhayed upotthāyāvāhayet /
3.1.0.d: यद्य् अनभिनिरुप्ताम् आवाहयेद् यथावाहितम् आज्येनोपाम्̐शु यजेत / भागिनीं चेन् नावाहयेद् उपोत्थायावाहयेत् /
3.1.0.m: If he invokes [a deity] for whom no oblation was apportioned, he should sacrifice with clarified butter in a whisper just as invoked. If he does not invoke a [deity] entitled to a portion, he should stand near and invoke [that deity].

3.1.0.s: yadi bahiṣparidhy āhutiḥ skanded agnīdhaṃ brūyād etām̐ saṃkuṣya juhudhi \\ iti / sa yathāvadānam̐ saṃpādya vaṣaṭkṛte madhye pāṇinā juhoti / tasmai pūrṇapātraṃ dadyāt //
3.1.0.d: यदि बहिष्परिध्य् आहुतिः स्कन्देद् अग्नीधं ब्रूयाद् एताम्̐ संकुष्य जुहुधि \\ इति / स यथावदानम्̐ संपाद्य वषट्कृते मध्ये पाणिना जुहोति / तस्मै पूर्णपात्रं दद्यात् //
3.1.0.m: If an oblation spills outside the enclosing sticks, he should say to the āgnīdhra priest: "Having scraped this together, sacrifice it." Having gathered it to the amount of an oblation-portion, he offers it with his hand into the center [of the fire] upon the vaṣaṭ-call. To him he should give a full vessel.

3.1.0.s: bhūpataye svāhā \ bhuvanapataye svāhā \ bhūtānāṃ pataye svāhā \\ iti bahiṣparidhi skannam abhimantrayate /
3.1.0.d: भूपतये स्वाहा \ भुवनपतये स्वाहा \ भूतानां पतये स्वाहा \\ इति बहिष्परिधि स्कन्नम् अभिमन्त्रयते /
3.1.0.m: "To the lord of the earth, svāhā! To the lord of the world, svāhā! To the lord of beings, svāhā!"—with these formulas he addresses that which has spilled outside the enclosing sticks.

3.1.0.s: kālātipattau pāthikṛty anāgate ca /
3.1.0.d: कालातिपत्तौ पाथिकृत्य् अनागते च /
3.1.0.m: When the proper time has passed, there is an offering to Agni Pathikṛt, and also when [the time] has not yet arrived.

3.1.0.s: yadi prāṅ nirvapaṇāt paurṇamāsyām amāvāsyāyām̐ vā kālapravṛttim̐ sparśayed āgneyam aṣṭākapālaṃ pathikṛtā vyañjayet /
3.1.0.d: यदि प्राङ् निर्वपणात् पौर्णमास्याम् अमावास्यायाम्̐ वा कालप्रवृत्तिम्̐ स्पर्शयेद् आग्नेयम् अष्टाकपालं पथिकृता व्यञ्जयेत् /
3.1.0.m: If, prior to the apportioning, on a full-moon day or a new-moon day, he should touch upon an inappropriate onset of time, he should supplement an eight-potsherd cake to Agni with one to [Agni] Pathikṛt.

3.1.0.s: utsṛṣṭe ced brāhmaudanike sahāgniḥ prayāyād anugachet kālam̐ vātinayet punar brahmaudanaṃ paktvānaktāḥ samadhi ādadhyāt /
3.1.0.d: उत्सृष्टे चेद् ब्राह्मौदनिके सहाग्निः प्रयायाद् अनुगछेत् कालम्̐ वातिनयेत् पुनर् ब्रह्मौदनं पक्त्वानक्ताः समधि आदध्यात् /
3.1.0.m: If, when [the mess of cooked rice for the Brahmans] has been abandoned, the fire of the brahmaudana rite should move away together, go out, or exceed the time, having cooked the brahmaudana again, he should place unctuous firewood on [the fire].

3.2.0.s:
agnihotrāya ced upasṛṣṭā niṣīdet
yasmād bhītā niṣīdasi \ tato no abhayaṃ kṛdhi /
paśūn asmākaṃ mā him̐sīr \ namo rudrāya mīḍhuṣe //
ity abhimantrayate /
udasthād devy aditir \ āyur yajñapatāv adhāt /
indrāya kṛṇvatī bhāgam \\ mitrāya varuṇāya ca //
ity utthāpyodapātram ūdhasi mukhe copagṛhṇīyād yasyānnaṃ nādyāt tasmai tāṃ dadyāt /
3.2.0.d:
अग्निहोत्राय चेद् उपसृष्टा निषीदेत्
यस्माद् भीता निषीदसि \ ततो नो अभयं कृधि /
पशून् अस्माकं मा हिम्̐सीर् \ नमो रुद्राय मीढुषे //
इत्य् अभिमन्त्रयते /
उदस्थाद् देव्य् अदितिर् \ आयुर् यज्ञपताव् अधात् /
इन्द्राय कृण्वती भागम् \\ मित्राय वरुणाय च //
इत्य् उत्थाप्योदपात्रम् ऊधसि मुखे चोपगृह्णीयाद् यस्यान्नं नाद्यात् तस्मै तां दद्यात् /
3.2.0.m:
If the cow let loose for the agnihotra sits down,

"Being afraid of which you sit down, / from that make us free from fear;

do not harm our cattle; / homage to Rudra the bountiful!"—

"The goddess Aditi has arisen; / she has placed lifespan in the lord of the sacrifice,

preparing a share for Indra, / for Mitra and Varuṇa"—

having made her stand up with this formula, he should hold a vessel of water near her udder and mouth; he should give her to someone whose food he would not eat.

3.2.0.s:
agnihotraṃ cet prāg adhiśrayaṇāt skandet samudram̐ vaḥ prahiṇomi \\ ity apa upaninīya
yad adya dugdhaṃ pṛthivīm abhakta \ yad oṣadhīr atyasṛpad yad āpaḥ /
payaḥ pṛthivyāṃ paya oṣadhīṣu \ payo aghnyāsu payo vatseṣu /
payo gṛheṣu payo 'stu tan naḥ //
ity abhimantrayate /
3.2.0.d:
अग्निहोत्रं चेत् प्राग् अधिश्रयणात् स्कन्देत् समुद्रम्̐ वः प्रहिणोमि \\ इत्य् अप उपनिनीय
यद् अद्य दुग्धं पृथिवीम् अभक्त \ यद् ओषधीर् अत्यसृपद् यद् आपः /
पयः पृथिव्यां पय ओषधीषु \ पयो अघ्न्यासु पयो वत्सेषु /
पयो गृहेषु पयो ऽस्तु तन् नः //
इत्य् अभिमन्त्रयते /
3.2.0.m:
If the agnihotra milk spills before being set on the fire, having poured water near with the formula, "I send you to the ocean,"

"The milk that has fallen today upon the earth, / that has spread over the plants, that over the waters,

milk on earth, milk in plants, / milk in the cows that must not be slain, milk in the calves,

milk in our houses—may that milk be ours!"—

3.2.0.s: yadi duhyamānāvabhindyād anyām āryakṛtīṃ prakṣālya punar dohayet /
3.2.0.d: यदि दुह्यमानावभिन्द्याद् अन्याम् आर्यकृतीं प्रक्षाल्य पुनर् दोहयेत् /
3.2.0.m: If [the pot] should break while being milked, having washed another vessel made by an Ārya, he should have her milked again.

3.2.0.s: yady adhiśritam̐ skanded iti vyākhyātam̐ vāruṇīṃ nigadya vāruṇyājyaṃ juhuyāt /
3.2.0.d: यद्य् अधिश्रितम्̐ स्कन्देद् इति व्याख्यातम्̐ वारुणीं निगद्य वारुण्याज्यं जुहुयात् /
3.2.0.m: If it spills while set on the fire, it has been explained: having recited a verse to Varuṇa, he should offer clarified butter with a verse to Varuṇa.

3.2.0.s: yadi prācīnaṃ hriyamāṇam̐ skandet prajāpater viśvabhṛti tanvām̐ hutam asi svāhā \\ ity abhimṛśec chvāvalīḍhavac ca ninayet /
3.2.0.d: यदि प्राचीनं ह्रियमाणम्̐ स्कन्देत् प्रजापतेर् विश्वभृति तन्वाम्̐ हुतम् असि स्वाहा \\ इत्य् अभिमृशेच् छ्वावलीढवच् च निनयेत् /
3.2.0.m: If it spills while being carried eastwards, he should touch it with the formula, "You are offered into Prajāpati's all-supporting body, svāhā!" and pour [water] on it as in the case of [milk] licked by a dog.

3.2.0.s: yady adhiśritam̐ śiraśirāyat syāt samoṣāmum iti brūyād yaṃ dviṣyāt /
3.2.0.d: यद्य् अधिश्रितम्̐ शिरशिरायत् स्यात् समोषामुम् इति ब्रूयाद् यं द्विष्यात् /
3.2.0.m: If, while set on the fire, it should make a hissing sound, he should say, "Burn completely so-and-so!"—naming the one whom he hates.

3.2.0.s: viṣyaṇṇaṃ madhyamaparṇena dyāvāpṛthivyayarcāntaḥparidhy avanayet kīṭāvapannaṃ prājāpatyarcā valmīkavapāyām avanīya bhūr ity upatiṣṭheta / viṣyaṇṇam̐ vā valmīkavapāyāṃ kīṭāvapannam antaḥparidhi /
3.2.0.d: विष्यण्णं मध्यमपर्णेन द्यावापृथिव्ययर्चान्तःपरिध्य् अवनयेत् कीटावपन्नं प्राजापत्यर्चा वल्मीकवपायाम् अवनीय भूर् इत्य् उपतिष्ठेत / विष्यण्णम्̐ वा वल्मीकवपायां कीटावपन्नम् अन्तःपरिधि /
3.2.0.m: With the middle palāśa leaf and a verse to Heaven and Earth, he should pour out what has overflowed inside the enclosing sticks; having poured out what has been fallen into by insects into an anthill's earth-mound with a verse to Prajāpati, he should attend upon the fire with "Bhūḥ!"; or what has overflowed into the anthill's earth-mound, and what has been fallen into by insects inside the enclosing sticks.

3.2.0.s:
avavṛṣṭe
mitro janān yātayati bruvāṇas \\ mitro dādhāra pṛthivīm uta dyām /
mitraḥ kṛṣṭīr animiṣābhicaṣṭe \ mitrāya havyaṃ ghṛtavaj juhota //
iti pūrvām āhutiṃ juhuyād anyāṃ dugdhvātha punar agnihotraṃ juhuyāt /
3.2.0.d:
अववृष्टे
मित्रो जनान् यातयति ब्रुवाणस् \\ मित्रो दाधार पृथिवीम् उत द्याम् /
मित्रः कृष्टीर् अनिमिषाभिचष्टे \ मित्राय हव्यं घृतवज् जुहोत //
इति पूर्वाम् आहुतिं जुहुयाद् अन्यां दुग्ध्वाथ पुनर् अग्निहोत्रं जुहुयात् /

3.2.0.s: yadi pūrvasyām̐ hutāyām āhavanīyo 'nugached agnir dārau dārāv agnir iti hiraṇyaṃ nidhāyottarāṃ juhuyād anyāṃ dugdhvātha punar agnihotraṃ juhuyāt /
3.2.0.d: यदि पूर्वस्याम्̐ हुतायाम् आहवनीयो ऽनुगछेद् अग्निर् दारौ दाराव् अग्निर् इति हिरण्यं निधायोत्तरां जुहुयाद् अन्यां दुग्ध्वाथ पुनर् अग्निहोत्रं जुहुयात् /
3.2.0.m: If, when the first [libation] has been offered, the āhavanīya fire should go out, having deposited gold with the formula, "Agni is in wood, in wood is Agni," he should offer the second libation; then, having milked another [cow], he should offer the agnihotra again.

3.2.0.s:
yadi pūrvasyām̐ hutāyām̐ skandet
yatra vettha vanaspate \ devānāṃ guhyā nāmāni / \ tatra havyāni gāmaya //
iti samidham ādhāyottarāṃ juhuyād anyāṃ dugdhvātha punar agnihotraṃ juhuyāt /
3.2.0.d:
यदि पूर्वस्याम्̐ हुतायाम्̐ स्कन्देत्
यत्र वेत्थ वनस्पते \ देवानां गुह्या नामानि / \ तत्र हव्यानि गामय //
इति समिधम् आधायोत्तरां जुहुयाद् अन्यां दुग्ध्वाथ पुनर् अग्निहोत्रं जुहुयात् /
3.2.0.m:
If it spills when the first [libation] has been offered,

"Where you know, O Tree, / the secret names of the gods, / make the oblations go there!"—

having placed sacrificial fuel [on the fire] with this formula, he should offer the second libation; then, having milked another [cow], he should offer the agnihotra again.

3.2.0.s: yadi rudraḥ paśūn abhimanyeta dvayor gavoḥ sthālyā dohanena ca dohayitvā samānīya sajūr jātavedas \\ iti pūrvām āhutiṃ juhuyād anyāṃ dugdhvātha punar agnihotraṃ juhuyāt /
3.2.0.d: यदि रुद्रः पशून् अभिमन्येत द्वयोर् गवोः स्थाल्या दोहनेन च दोहयित्वा समानीय सजूर् जातवेदस् \\ इति पूर्वाम् आहुतिं जुहुयाद् अन्यां दुग्ध्वाथ पुनर् अग्निहोत्रं जुहुयात् /
3.2.0.m: If Rudra should design evil against the cattle, having had two cows milked with an earthen pot and milking pail, and having brought [the milk] together, he should offer the first libation with the formula, "United, O Jātavedas..."; then, having milked another [cow], he should offer the agnihotra again.

3.2.0.s: yadi saptāham atiśamāyeta \\ agne duḥśīrtatano iti purastāj juhuyād anyāṃ dugdhvātha punar agnihotraṃ juhuyād yadi tad atiśamāyeta dvādaśa rātrīḥ sāyam̐sāyam ājyaṃ juhuyāt /
3.2.0.d: यदि सप्ताहम् अतिशमायेत \\ अग्ने दुःशीर्ततनो इति पुरस्ताज् जुहुयाद् अन्यां दुग्ध्वाथ पुनर् अग्निहोत्रं जुहुयाद् यदि तद् अतिशमायेत द्वादश रात्रीः सायम्̐सायम् आज्यं जुहुयात् /
3.2.0.m: If it should die down for seven days, he should offer beforehand with: 'O Agni of broken-down body…'; having milked another [cow], he should then offer the Agnihotra again; if it dies down beyond that, he should offer clarified butter every evening for twelve nights.

3.2.0.s: yadi rudraḥ prajā abhiśamayetottarapūrvasyāṃ diśi śatarudriyaṃ japam̐ś caṅkramyeta /
3.2.0.d: यदि रुद्रः प्रजा अभिशमयेतोत्तरपूर्वस्यां दिशि शतरुद्रियं जपम्̐श् चङ्क्रम्येत /
3.2.0.m: If Rudra should afflict the offspring, he should wander about pacing in the northeastern direction, muttering the Śatarudriya.

3.2.0.s: yasyāgnim anuddhṛtam̐ sūryo 'bhinimroced unnīte 'gnihotre brāhmaṇo bahuvid uddhared dhiraṇyaṃ baddhvā darbheṇāgrato haret paścād agnihotreṇānviyād varo dakṣiṇā /
3.2.0.d: यस्याग्निम् अनुद्धृतम्̐ सूर्यो ऽभिनिम्रोचेद् उन्नीते ऽग्निहोत्रे ब्राह्मणो बहुविद् उद्धरेद् धिरण्यं बद्ध्वा दर्भेणाग्रतो हरेत् पश्चाद् अग्निहोत्रेणान्वियाद् वरो दक्षिणा /
3.2.0.m: When the sun sets upon his [āhavanīya] fire which has not been brought forward, the Agnihotra milk having been drawn, a learned brāhmaṇa should bring [the fire] forward; having tied gold with a darbha blade, he should carry it in front; he should follow behind with the Agnihotra; a boon is the sacrificial gift.

3.2.0.s: anuddhṛtaṃ ced abhyudiyād vyākhyātaṃ praṇayanaṃ / caturgṛhītam ājyam agrato hared uṣāḥ ketunā juṣatām̐ svāhā \\ iti purastāt pratyaṅmukha ājyaṃ juhuyād upasādyā tamitor āsītā homāt /
3.2.0.d: अनुद्धृतं चेद् अभ्युदियाद् व्याख्यातं प्रणयनं / चतुर्गृहीतम् आज्यम् अग्रतो हरेद् उषाः केतुना जुषताम्̐ स्वाहा \\ इति पुरस्तात् प्रत्यङ्मुख आज्यं जुहुयाद् उपसाद्या तमितोर् आसीता होमात् /
3.2.0.m: If [the sun] should rise upon it not brought forward, the bringing forward is explained [as before]; he should carry four-times-scooped clarified butter in front; facing westward, he should offer the clarified butter in the east with: 'May the dawn take pleasure with her banner, svāhā!'; having set it down, he should remain seated until they are exhausted, until the offering.
[The case of one] whose both fires have gone out is explained.

3.3.0.s: yasyāhute 'gnihotre pūrvo 'gnir anugached agninā ca sahāgnihotreṇa coddraved ita eva prathamaṃ jajñe \\ ity uddhṛtam abhimantrayata // iṣe rāye ramasva \\ ity ādhāsyamāne samrāḍ asi \\ ity ādadhāti // sārasvatau tvotsau prāvatām ity āhitam̐ hute [ 'gnihotre ] 'gnaye jyotiṣmate 'ṣṭākapālaṃ nirvaped vāruṇam̐ yavamayaṃ carum /
3.3.0.d: यस्याहुते ऽग्निहोत्रे पूर्वो ऽग्निर् अनुगछेद् अग्निना च सहाग्निहोत्रेण चोद्द्रवेद् इत एव प्रथमं जज्ञे \\ इत्य् उद्धृतम् अभिमन्त्रयत // इषे राये रमस्व \\ इत्य् आधास्यमाने सम्राड् असि \\ इत्य् आदधाति // सारस्वतौ त्वोत्सौ प्रावताम् इत्य् आहितम्̐ हुते [ ऽग्निहोत्रे ] ऽग्नये ज्योतिष्मते ऽष्टाकपालं निर्वपेद् वारुणम्̐ यवमयं चरुम् /
3.3.0.m: If, while the Agnihotra is not yet offered, his eastern fire goes out, he should run forward together with the fire and the Agnihotra; he addresses the [newly] brought forward fire with: 'From here only it was first born…'; when it is about to be placed, he [addresses it] with: 'Delight in food and wealth…'; he places it with: 'You are the sovereign'; [he addresses] it when placed with: 'May the two fountains belonging to Sarasvatī protect you'; when [the Agnihotra] is offered, he should apportion an eight-potsherd [cake] to Agni possessing light, and a boiled oblation of barley to Varuṇa.

3.3.0.s: yasyāhute 'gnihotre 'paro 'gnir anugached anugamayya pūrvam aparasmān mathitvā praṇayed yadi tvareta tata eva prāñcam uddhṛtya dakṣiṇāgnim anvānīya sāyaṃprātar juhuyāc chvo bhūte 'gnim̐ samāropya mathitvāgnaye tapasvate janadvate pākkavate 'ṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapet /
3.3.0.d: यस्याहुते ऽग्निहोत्रे ऽपरो ऽग्निर् अनुगछेद् अनुगमय्य पूर्वम् अपरस्मान् मथित्वा प्रणयेद् यदि त्वरेत तत एव प्राञ्चम् उद्धृत्य दक्षिणाग्निम् अन्वानीय सायंप्रातर् जुहुयाच् छ्वो भूते ऽग्निम्̐ समारोप्य मथित्वाग्नये तपस्वते जनद्वते पाक्कवते ऽष्टाकपालं निर्वपेत् /
3.3.0.m: If, while the Agnihotra is not yet offered, his western fire goes out, having caused the eastern one to go out and having churned [fire] from the western [fire-hearth], he should bring it forward; if he is in haste, having brought it forward to the east from there itself, having brought along the southern fire, he should offer [the Agnihotra] evening and morning; on the next day, having mounted the fire [upon the kindling sticks] and churned it, he should apportion an eight-potsherd cake to Agni tapasvat, janadvat, and pāvakavat.

3.3.0.s:
sarvānugameṣu ca
yo agniṃ devavītaye \ haviṣmaṃ āvivāsati / \ tasmai pāvaka mṛḍaya //
ity etayā sadyaḥ pūrṇāhutiṃ juhuyāt /
3.3.0.d:
सर्वानुगमेषु च
यो अग्निं देववीतये \ हविष्मं आविवासति / \ तस्मै पावक मृडय //
इत्य् एतया सद्यः पूर्णाहुतिं जुहुयात् /
3.3.0.m:
'He who, having oblations, attends upon Agni for the feast of the gods, / to him, O Purifier, be gracious!'

With this [verse] he should immediately offer a full-spoon offering.

3.3.0.s: yasyāgnā agnim abhyuddhareyur bhavataṃ naḥ samanasau \\ ity abhimantryāgnaye 'gnimate 'ṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapet /
3.3.0.d: यस्याग्ना अग्निम् अभ्युद्धरेयुर् भवतं नः समनसौ \\ इत्य् अभिमन्त्र्याग्नये ऽग्निमते ऽष्टाकपालं निर्वपेत् /
3.3.0.m: Upon whose fire they bring forward another fire, having addressed [the two fires] with: 'Be of one mind with us…', he should apportion an eight-potsherd [cake] to Agni agnimat.

3.3.0.s: sāyam agnihotrasya cet kālo 'tipadyeta doṣā vastor namaḥ svāhā \\ iti pūrvasyām āhutāv antato 'nuṣajet /
3.3.0.d: सायम् अग्निहोत्रस्य चेत् कालो ऽतिपद्येत दोषा वस्तोर् नमः स्वाहा \\ इति पूर्वस्याम् आहुताव् अन्ततो ऽनुषजेत् /
3.3.0.m: If the time of the evening Agnihotra should pass by, he should attach at the end of the first oblation: 'In the evening and at dawn, homage, svāhā!'

3.3.0.s: prātar agnihotraṃ ced abhyudiyād anv agnir uṣasām agram akśad ity unnītam abhimantrayata āhavanīyam̐ yajamāna ihaiva kṣemya edhi mā prahāsīr mām amum iti nāma gṛhṇāti \\ āmuṣyāyaṇam iti gotraṃ // prātar vastor namaḥ svāhā \\ iti pūrvasyām āhutāv antato 'nuṣajed dhute [ 'gnihotre ] maitraṃ caruṃ nirvapet sauryam ekakapālam api vendhānau daṃpatī vāgyatāv anaśnantau sarvāhṇam upāsīyātāṃ / dvayor gavoḥ sāyam agnihotraṃ juhuyāc chvobhūte 'gnaye vratapataye 'ṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapet /
3.3.0.d: प्रातर् अग्निहोत्रं चेद् अभ्युदियाद् अन्व् अग्निर् उषसाम् अग्रम् अक्शद् इत्य् उन्नीतम् अभिमन्त्रयत आहवनीयम्̐ यजमान इहैव क्षेम्य एधि मा प्रहासीर् माम् अमुम् इति नाम गृह्णाति \\ आमुष्यायणम् इति गोत्रं // प्रातर् वस्तोर् नमः स्वाहा \\ इति पूर्वस्याम् आहुताव् अन्ततो ऽनुषजेद् धुते [ ऽग्निहोत्रे ] मैत्रं चरुं निर्वपेत् सौर्यम् एककपालम् अपि वेन्धानौ दंपती वाग्यताव् अनश्नन्तौ सर्वाह्णम् उपासीयातां / द्वयोर् गवोः सायम् अग्निहोत्रं जुहुयाच् छ्वोभूते ऽग्नये व्रतपतये ऽष्टाकपालं निर्वपेत् /
3.3.0.m: If the sun should rise upon the morning Agnihotra, he addresses the drawn [milk] with: 'Agni has seen the foremost part of the dawns'; the sacrificer [addresses] the āhavanīya fire with: 'Be secure here; do not abandon me, so-and-so'—he utters the name—'belonging to the lineage of so-and-so'—he utters the gotra; he should attach at the end of the first oblation: 'In the morning and at dawn, homage, svāhā!'; the [Agnihotra] having been offered, he should apportion a boiled oblation to Mitra, or a one-potsherd [cake] to Sūrya; or the husband and wife, kindling [the fire], restraining their speech and not eating, should wait upon [it] throughout the whole day; he should offer the evening Agnihotra from two cows; on the next day he should apportion an eight-potsherd cake to Agni vratapati.

3.4.0.s:
yady arvāk śamyāprāsād agnir apakṣāyet
idaṃ ta ekaṃ para ū ta ekam \\ tṛtīyena jyotiṣā sam̐viśasva /
iti sarvam̐ saṃbhṛtyāharati /
sam̐veśanas tanve cārur edhi \ priyo devānāṃ parame janitre /
iti nivapati /
3.4.0.d:
यद्य् अर्वाक् शम्याप्रासाद् अग्निर् अपक्षायेत्
इदं त एकं पर ऊ त एकम् \\ तृतीयेन ज्योतिषा सम्̐विशस्व /
इति सर्वम्̐ संभृत्याहरति /
सम्̐वेशनस् तन्वे चारुर् एधि \ प्रियो देवानां परमे जनित्रे /
इति निवपति /
3.4.0.m:
If the fire should blaze away on this side of the peg's throw:

'This one is yours, that one over there is yours; / enter together with the third light!'

Reciting this, having gathered all of it, he brings it.

'Being the couch, be agreeable to the body, / dear to the gods in their highest birthplace!'

3.4.0.s: yadi parastaram itarāv anvānīya sāyaṃprātar juhuyāc chvo bhūte 'gnaye pathikṛte 'ṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapet patho 'ntikād barhir anaḍvām̐ś ca dakṣiṇā /
3.4.0.d: यदि परस्तरम् इतराव् अन्वानीय सायंप्रातर् जुहुयाच् छ्वो भूते ऽग्नये पथिकृते ऽष्टाकपालं निर्वपेत् पथो ऽन्तिकाद् बर्हिर् अनड्वाम्̐श् च दक्षिणा /
3.4.0.m: If further away, having brought the other two [fires] along, he should offer evening and morning; on the next day he should apportion an eight-potsherd cake to Agni pathikṛt; sacrificial grass from the edge of the path and a draft ox are the sacrificial gift.

3.4.0.s: yo 'nyāgniṣu yajeta yasya vānye 'gniṣu yajeran so 'gnaye vaiśvānarāya dvādaśakapālaṃ [ puroḍāśaṃ ] nirvapet /
3.4.0.d: यो ऽन्याग्निषु यजेत यस्य वान्ये ऽग्निषु यजेरन् सो ऽग्नये वैश्वानराय द्वादशकपालं [ पुरोडाशं ] निर्वपेत् /
3.4.0.m: He who sacrifices on the fires of another, or on whose fires others sacrifice, should apportion a twelve-potsherd [cake] to Agni vaiśvānara.

3.4.0.s: yasyāgnayaḥ sam̐sṛjyeran mitho 'nyair veṣṭisaṃnipāte vaivicī pūrvā /
3.4.0.d: यस्याग्नयः सम्̐सृज्येरन् मिथो ऽन्यैर् वेष्टिसंनिपाते वैविची पूर्वा /
3.4.0.m: When his fires mingle with each other, or with others, or when sacrifices coincide, the Vivici offering is the first.
[The offering] to Agni śuci is explained.
[The section beginning with] 'Of him who has set up the sacred fires…' is explained.
[The section beginning with] 'Whose fire should go out…' is explained.

3.4.0.s: yasyājasram avachidyetāntaritān homān hutvāgnaye tantumate 'ṣṭākapālaṃ [ puroḍāśaṃ ] nirvaped api vā pūrṇāhutim̐ hutvā nādriyeta homān sāyam̐homena pratipadyeta /
3.4.0.d: यस्याजस्रम् अवछिद्येतान्तरितान् होमान् हुत्वाग्नये तन्तुमते ऽष्टाकपालं [ पुरोडाशं ] निर्वपेद् अपि वा पूर्णाहुतिम्̐ हुत्वा नाद्रियेत होमान् सायम्̐होमेन प्रतिपद्येत /
3.4.0.m: If his perpetual [fire] is interrupted, having offered the omitted offerings, he should apportion an eight-potsherd [cake] to Agni tantumat; or having offered a full-spoon offering, he should disregard the [omitted] offerings and resume with the evening offering.

3.4.0.s: yasyādhiśrite 'gnihotre haviṣi vā nirupte some vā pratate 'no ratho 'śvaḥ puruṣaḥ śvā kṛṣṇaḥ śakunir anyad vā sattvam antarā viyāyāt trayastrim̐śat tantavas \\ ity āhavanīye hutvā gām anvāvṛtyāvartayati \\ idam̐ viṣṇur vicakrame \\ iti padam̐ yopayaty apo 'nvatiṣiñced api vā gārhapatyād bhasmādāya vaiṣṇavyarcāhavanīyāt padam anudhvam̐sayann uddravet /
3.4.0.d: यस्याधिश्रिते ऽग्निहोत्रे हविषि वा निरुप्ते सोमे वा प्रतते ऽनो रथो ऽश्वः पुरुषः श्वा कृष्णः शकुनिर् अन्यद् वा सत्त्वम् अन्तरा वियायात् त्रयस्त्रिम्̐शत् तन्तवस् \\ इत्य् आहवनीये हुत्वा गाम् अन्वावृत्यावर्तयति \\ इदम्̐ विष्णुर् विचक्रमे \\ इति पदम्̐ योपयत्य् अपो ऽन्वतिषिञ्चेद् अपि वा गार्हपत्याद् भस्मादाय वैष्णव्यर्चाहवनीयात् पदम् अनुध्वम्̐सयन्न् उद्द्रवेत् /
3.4.0.m: For whom, when the Agnihotra has been placed on the fire, or the oblation apportioned, or the Soma spread out, a cart, a chariot, a horse, a man, a dog, a black bird, or another creature crosses between [the fires], having offered on the āhavanīya fire with: 'Thirty-three threads…', he makes a cow walk across following it; he obliterates the footprint with: 'Through this Viṣṇu stepped…'; he should sprinkle water along it; or, having taken ashes from the gārhapatya fire, he should run forward from the āhavanīya fire with a verse to Viṣṇu, covering the footprints.

3.4.0.s:
anugamayya pūrvam aparasmāt praṇayet /
yad agne pūrvaṃ nihitaṃ padam̐ hi te \ sūryasya raśmīn anvātatantha /
tatra rayiṣṭhām anusaṃbharetām \\ saṃ naḥ sṛja sumatyā vājavatyā //
ity ādadhāti /
3.4.0.d:
अनुगमय्य पूर्वम् अपरस्मात् प्रणयेत् /
यद् अग्ने पूर्वं निहितं पदम्̐ हि ते \ सूर्यस्य रश्मीन् अन्वाततन्थ /
तत्र रयिष्ठाम् अनुसंभरेताम् \\ सं नः सृज सुमत्या वाजवत्या //
इत्य् आदधाति /
3.4.0.m:
Having caused the eastern [fire] to go out, he should bring [it] forward from the western [fire].

'Since, O Agni, your former footprint has been set down, / you have stretched along the rays of the sun;'

'May the two bring together there that which rests on wealth; / unite us with your favor accompanied by vigor!'

3.5.0.s: yadi pṛṣadājyam̐ skanded dhiraṇyam antardhāya bhūyo 'bhyunnīyāśvenopaghrāpya mano jyotir \ vardhatāṃ bhūtir ity etābhyām āhutī juhuyāt /
3.5.0.d: यदि पृषदाज्यम्̐ स्कन्देद् धिरण्यम् अन्तर्धाय भूयो ऽभ्युन्नीयाश्वेनोपघ्राप्य मनो ज्योतिर् \ वर्धतां भूतिर् इत्य् एताभ्याम् आहुती जुहुयात् /
3.5.0.m: If the clotted butter spills, having held gold in between and having drawn more [butter] and made a horse smell it, he should offer two oblations with: 'Mind [is] the light…' and 'May prosperity increase!'

3.5.0.s: yadi paśur upākṛtaḥ palāyetānyam̐ vā bhāvam āpadyeta vāyavyām̐ yavāgūṃ nirupyāthānyaṃ tadrūpaṃ tadvarṇaṃ tadvayasam upākaroti / vāyavyayā yavāgvā pracarya paśupuroḍāśena pracaret saha sviṣṭakṛdiḍām̐ vāyavyāyāḥ paśupuroḍāśasya caiṣa eva mṛte kalpaḥ /
3.5.0.d: यदि पशुर् उपाकृतः पलायेतान्यम्̐ वा भावम् आपद्येत वायव्याम्̐ यवागूं निरुप्याथान्यं तद्रूपं तद्वर्णं तद्वयसम् उपाकरोति / वायव्यया यवाग्वा प्रचर्य पशुपुरोडाशेन प्रचरेत् सह स्विष्टकृदिडाम्̐ वायव्यायाः पशुपुरोडाशस्य चैष एव मृते कल्पः /
