3.5.0.m: If the dedicated animal should flee or undergo another condition, having apportioned barley gruel sacred to Vāyu, he then dedicates another of the same appearance, same color, and same age; having performed the rite with the barley gruel sacred to Vāyu, he should perform the rite with the animal-cake; the Sviṣṭakṛt and iḍā portions of the barley gruel sacred to Vāyu and of the animal-cake are combined; this very procedure applies if it has died.

3.5.0.s: sa cet pratyānīyeta tvaṃ no agne \ sa tvaṃ no agne \\ ity etābhyām āhutī juhuyād etāv ādinoptasya paśor avadyet sa tāvantam eva kālaṃ tiṣṭhed yāvad itaraḥ śeṣo bhavati /
3.5.0.d: स चेत् प्रत्यानीयेत त्वं नो अग्ने \ स त्वं नो अग्ने \\ इत्य् एताभ्याम् आहुती जुहुयाद् एताव् आदिनोप्तस्य पशोर् अवद्येत् स तावन्तम् एव कालं तिष्ठेद् यावद् इतरः शेषो भवति /
3.5.0.m: If that [first animal] is brought back, he should offer two oblations with: 'You to us, O Agni…' and 'So you to us, O Agni…'; he should cut portions from this [original] animal that had previously been sprinkled; it should stand for as long a time as remains for the other.

3.5.0.s: yady ūrdhvam utpated ud u tiṣṭha svadhvara \\ ūrdhva ū ṣu ṇas \\ ity etābhyām āhutī juhuyāt /
3.5.0.d: यद्य् ऊर्ध्वम् उत्पतेद् उद् उ तिष्ठ स्वध्वर \\ ऊर्ध्व ऊ षु णस् \\ इत्य् एताभ्याम् आहुती जुहुयात् /
3.5.0.m: If it should leap upward, he should offer two oblations with: 'Stand upright, O you of true ritual…' and 'Upright unto us…'

3.5.0.s: yadi yūpam ābṛhec cālayed vā nitānas tvā māruto nihantu \\ iti yathāvasitam asya pariṣekaṃ kuryāt /
3.5.0.d: यदि यूपम् आबृहेच् चालयेद् वा नितानस् त्वा मारुतो निहन्तु \\ इति यथावसितम् अस्य परिषेकं कुर्यात् /
3.5.0.m: If it should uproot the sacrificial post or shake it, he should sprinkle water around its base with: 'May Nitāna, the son of Marut, strike you down!'

3.5.0.s: yadi raśanāṃ bhindyād druhyed daśed vā trayastrim̐śat tantavas \\ ity etayā granthim̐ saṃdhāyaitayaiva juhuyāt /
3.5.0.d: यदि रशनां भिन्द्याद् द्रुह्येद् दशेद् वा त्रयस्त्रिम्̐शत् तन्तवस् \\ इत्य् एतया ग्रन्थिम्̐ संधायैतयैव जुहुयात् /
3.5.0.m: If it breaks, damages, or bites the rope, having tied the knot with: 'Thirty-three threads…', he should offer with this very [formula].

3.5.0.s:
yadi svarur naśyet svadhitir vānyam̐ yūpaśakalaṃ juhvām aktvā svaruṃ kuryāt tathā svadhitim añjyād evam eva caṣālam /
iṣṭasya duriṣṭasya \ ye yajñam abhirakṣantaḥ /
paśūn asmākaṃ mā him̐sīr \ yajñam anvabhirakṣatām //
iti juhuyāt /
3.5.0.d:
यदि स्वरुर् नश्येत् स्वधितिर् वान्यम्̐ यूपशकलं जुह्वाम् अक्त्वा स्वरुं कुर्यात् तथा स्वधितिम् अञ्ज्याद् एवम् एव चषालम् /
इष्टस्य दुरिष्टस्य \ ये यज्ञम् अभिरक्षन्तः /
पशून् अस्माकं मा हिम्̐सीर् \ यज्ञम् अन्वभिरक्षताम् //
इति जुहुयात् /
3.5.0.m:
If the chip of the sacrificial post or the knife is lost, having anointed another chip from the sacrificial post in the juhū ladle, he should make it the chip; likewise he should anoint the knife; precisely in this manner the head-ring.

'Those who, guarding the sacrifice / of what is well-offered and what is ill-offered,'

'Do not harm our animals; / let them protect the sacrifice!'

3.5.0.s: yadi śakṛn mūtram̐ vā kuryāt punar upapāyyābhyukṣya vyāhṛtibhir eva juhuyāt //
3.5.0.d: यदि शकृन् मूत्रम्̐ वा कुर्यात् पुनर् उपपाय्याभ्युक्ष्य व्याहृतिभिर् एव जुहुयात् //
3.5.0.m: If [the sacrificial animal] should void dung or urine, having made it drink again and sprinkled it [with water], he should make an offering with the vyāhṛtis alone.

3.5.0.s: yasmād bhīta udaproṣṭa \\ ity utplavamāne juhuyāt //
3.5.0.d: यस्माद् भीत उदप्रोष्ट \\ इत्य् उत्प्लवमाने जुहुयात् //
3.5.0.m: With: 'Afraid of what it leapt up...', he should make an offering if it leaps up.
With: 'Afraid of what it trembled...', if it trembles.
With: 'Afraid of what it lowed...', if it lows.

3.5.0.s:
yasmād bhīto niṣīdasi \ tato no abhayaṃ kṛdhi /
paśūn asmākaṃ mā him̐sīr \ namo rudrāya mīḍhuṣe //
iti niṣaṇṇe /
3.5.0.d:
यस्माद् भीतो निषीदसि \ ततो नो अभयं कृधि /
पशून् अस्माकं मा हिम्̐सीर् \ नमो रुद्राय मीढुषे //
इति निषण्णे /
3.5.0.m:
'Afraid of what you sit down, / make safety for us from that!

Do not harm our cattle; / homage to Rudra the bountiful!'

3.5.0.s:
agnir bhagaḥ savitedaṃ juṣantām \\ prajāpatir varuṇo ... ya ... mahyam //
yo no dveṣṭi tanūm̐ rabhasva \\ anāgaso yajamānasya vīrān //
iti ramamāṇe juhuyāt /
3.5.0.d:
अग्निर् भगः सवितेदं जुषन्ताम् \\ प्रजापतिर् वरुणो ... य ... मह्यम् //
यो नो द्वेष्टि तनूम्̐ रभस्व \\ अनागसो यजमानस्य वीरान् //
इति रममाणे जुहुयात् /
3.5.0.m:
'May Agni, Bhaga, Savitṛ enjoy this; / Prajāpati, Varuṇa... to me;

whoever hates us, seize his body, / [protect] the blameless men of the sacrificer!'

3.5.0.s:
yadi paśūkhā sravet
ukhām̐ sravantīm agadām akarma \\ agnir hotā pṛthivy antarikṣam /
yatra cuścutad agnāv eva tat \\ nābhiprāpnuyur nirṛtiṃ parastāt //
ity abhimantrayate /
3.5.0.d:
यदि पशूखा स्रवेत्
उखाम्̐ स्रवन्तीम् अगदाम् अकर्म \\ अग्निर् होता पृथिव्य् अन्तरिक्षम् /
यत्र चुश्चुतद् अग्नाव् एव तत् \\ नाभिप्राप्नुयुर् निरृतिं परस्तात् //
इत्य् अभिमन्त्रयते /
3.5.0.m:
'The leaking pot we have made sound; / Agni the hotṛ, earth, atmosphere;

where it dripped, right there in the fire it is; / may they not encounter destruction in the future.'

3.5.0.s:
yadi śyeno vapām̐ hared anyad vā sattvam anyad vāvadānam
yad avāmṛkṣac chakunir \ mukhena nirṛte tava /
agniṣ ṭad rakṣatu \ havyavāḍ ghṛtasūdanaḥ //
iti juhuyāt /
3.5.0.d:
यदि श्येनो वपाम्̐ हरेद् अन्यद् वा सत्त्वम् अन्यद् वावदानम्
यद् अवामृक्षच् छकुनिर् \ मुखेन निरृते तव /
अग्निष् टद् रक्षतु \ हव्यवाड् घृतसूदनः //
इति जुहुयात् /
3.5.0.m:
If a hawk or another animal should carry off the omentum or another cut-off portion,

'What the bird has touched / with its mouth, O Destruction, belonging to you,

may Agni protect that, / the bearer of oblations, who consumes the clarified butter.'

3.5.0.s: yad avadānaṃ na vindet tad ājyasyāvadyed dhṛdayanāśe 'nyaṃ paśum ālabheta / hiraṇye dvir ājyasyāvadyet /
3.5.0.d: यद् अवदानं न विन्देत् तद् आज्यस्यावद्येद् धृदयनाशे ऽन्यं पशुम् आलभेत / हिरण्ये द्विर् आज्यस्यावद्येत् /
3.5.0.m: If he does not find a cut-off portion, he should cut that from clarified butter. If the heart is lost, he should seize another animal. In the case of gold, he should cut twice from clarified butter.

3.5.0.s: yadi kāmayeta te paśum̐ vyamathiṣata ta ārtim ārcheyur iti kuvid aṅga yavamanto yavaṃ cid iti namauktim atyarcāgnīdhrīye juhuyāt /
3.5.0.d: यदि कामयेत ते पशुम्̐ व्यमथिषत त आर्तिम् आर्छेयुर् इति कुविद् अङ्ग यवमन्तो यवं चिद् इति नमौक्तिम् अत्यर्चाग्नीध्रीये जुहुयात् /
3.5.0.m: If he should desire: 'They tore apart the animal, may they meet with misfortune', he should make an offering on the āgnīdhrīya fire having transgressed the recitation [of the sacred formula] with the namoukti: 'Surely the barley-growers [cut] the barley...'

3.5.0.s: yady aṣṭāpadī syād aṣṭāpadyā garbham̐ śūle kṛtvā mṛdā pralipya śāmitrīye nikhānayet tasyādhastād ayaspātram upakṛṣya śrapayet tasya rasena prāk sviṣṭakṛtas \\ hiraṇyagarbhas \\ ity aṣṭābhiḥ pratyṛcam ā[jyā]hutīr juhuyād dhiraṇyam aṣṭāpṛḍaṃ dakṣiṇā / sam̐sthite mahī dyauḥ pṛthivī ca nas \\ iti paśuśrapaṇe garbham upavapati // namo mahimne \\ iti pañcabhir upatiṣṭhate /
3.5.0.d: यद्य् अष्टापदी स्याद् अष्टापद्या गर्भम्̐ शूले कृत्वा मृदा प्रलिप्य शामित्रीये निखानयेत् तस्याधस्ताद् अयस्पात्रम् उपकृष्य श्रपयेत् तस्य रसेन प्राक् स्विष्टकृतस् \\ हिरण्यगर्भस् \\ इत्य् अष्टाभिः प्रत्यृचम् आ[ज्या]हुतीर् जुहुयाद् धिरण्यम् अष्टापृडं दक्षिणा / सम्̐स्थिते मही द्यौः पृथिवी च नस् \\ इति पशुश्रपणे गर्भम् उपवपति // नमो महिम्ने \\ इति पञ्चभिर् उपतिष्ठते /
3.5.0.m: If it is an eight-footed [pregnant animal], having put the fetus of the eight-footed [animal] on a spit and smeared it with clay, he should have it buried in the place of the slaughtering fire; having drawn an iron vessel beneath it, he should cook it. With its juice, before the Sviṣṭakṛt offering, he should offer clarified butter oblations with the eight [verses beginning with]: 'The golden embryo...', verse by verse. The sacrificial gift is gold weighing eight pṛḍas. When it is completed, with: 'Great heaven and earth for us...', he scatters the fetus into the animal-cooking fire. With the five [formulas beginning with]: 'Homage to greatness...', he pays reverence.
